## Our Story

We've been proudly serving Italian food since 1905, sourcing 100% organic ingredients from local
Italian farms from Sicily to Tuscany.

Our imported Italian foods are grown naturally, produced with traditional methods and packaged fresh
in Italy. We make it easy to cook healthy, flavorful dishes with staple ingredients for any Italian
meal, such as olive oil, balsamic vinegars, tomato sauces, Italian toppings, condiments, and pasta.
And of course, our prefect Italian meal isn’t complete without lingering over hot espresso with
cookies and candy.

At Acme-Hardesty, our word is our bond. We **[prioritize sustainability][33]** in the bio-based
chemical sourcing industry and provide renewable, sustainable alternatives for manufacturers.

Acme-Hardesty understands **[relationships matter][34]**, and no one in this business does it alone.
Our relationships are built on trust, innovation and sustainable performance. We call upon our
deeply valued relationships to meet the needs of suppliers and customers as well as provide a
dependable, cost-effective flow of quality products from source to end user.

[oleochemicals][42] and materials manufacturers need to create superior products to make life better

customers are fully supported at all times.

derivatives. We provide innovative bio-based products and solutions for industrial and regulated
markets, maintain preferred relationships with suppliers and exceed customer expectations with
optimized logistics. Plus, our attention to detail is unmatched and allows us to manage risk
consistently.

[ Let us contact you ][268]


AAK specializes in plant-based oils and fats, the value-adding ingredients in many products
people love to consume. 

Our solutions enable our customers to be successful in a better way.

## What we do

We co-develop with our customers for...

Better Performance
We help you drive better performance by reducing resource use, simplifying processes, and enhancing
efficiency across the value chain. This includes extending shelf life to cut food waste, improving
throughput, conserving resources, and boosting product performance with functional ingredients and
optimized processing.

## What inspires us?

When people around the world can achieve better lives for themselves, their families, and their
communities, we all benefit. By fostering a secure global environment, we contribute to a safe,
peaceful, and prosperous world for all.

## a legacy of global impact

ACDI/VOCA is a global nonprofit development design and delivery partner based in Washington, D.C. We
have implemented effective economic and social development projects since 1963. We address issues of
food security, economic prosperity, and social engagement by facilitating the creation of durable,
locally driven market, food, and social systems in communities around the world.

## The systems we design and implement result in:

## **Thriving Economies**

We connect people with businesses to create jobs
and strengthen economic market systems.

## **Fair societies**

We support social systems that engage, benefit, and empower all members: women and men, youth and
adults, and rural as well as urban families.

## **Resilient Communities**

We help communities build resilience to conflict,
extreme weather, and other shocks and stresses.

## **Sustainable Food Systems**

We enhance food security among poor
and vulnerable populations.

## Revolutionising Healthy Cooking in India

In the lush orchards of Kenya, where avocados flourish, begins the journey of our cold-pressed,
extra-virgin avocado oil. Unrefined and unprocessed, our oil captures the pure essence of avocados,
preserving all their natural nutrients and Flavors.
For years, our kitchens have relied on refined sunflower and mustard oils, which can harm heart
health and release harmful chemicals when heated. Our avocado oil is a refreshing change, offering a
healthier alternative rich in heart-friendly monounsaturated fats that withstand high heat.
Use our Avocado oil for general Indian cooking (Tadka to Pasta) to enhances flavor and supports your
wellness journey. By choosing our avocado oil, you're prioritizing your well-being with a touch of
nature's finest.
Join us in this culinary revolution. Let our avocado oil be the beacon of health in your kitchen and
the freshest innovation in the Indian oil industry. From the heartland of Kenya to your home,

# The Africa-Europe Innovation Platform (AEIP) connects stakeholders of the innovation value chain
# across Africa and Europe.

The AEIP creates a “network of networks”, aligning with the priorities of the [AU-EU Innovation
Agenda][32] to strengthen cooperation and maximise the impact of innovation initiatives.

## Our Objectives

Enhance dialogue
Foster partnerships
Improve access to funding
Boost skills & mobility
Foster inclusivity

## Become part of the network of networks

[**Join the AEIP**][33]

## Our target groups

The Africa-Europe Innovation Platform connects a broad spectrum of stakeholders, including:

Policy makers
Academia
Start-ups, SMEs & corporates
Business Support Organisations
Investors & funders
Civil society

## Our approach in 3 phases

Create a gathering place for all innovation stakeholders
Invite all innovation stakeholders from Africa and Europe to join the platform and create
partnerships.
Animate the community
Drive engagement across the innovation value chain through events, trainings and matchmaking
initiatives.
Ensure efficiency and outreach
The Platform ensures long-term engagement through visibility, strategic partnerships and by
leveraging AEIP’s extensive network of networks.

## 5 WAYS TO ANIMATE THE COMMUNITY

1
A network of networks

The Platform serves as a central hub, connecting and amplifying innovation networks across Africa
and Europe.

2
Community management and partnerships

Fostering collaboration through events, thematic challenges, matchmaking

3
Knowledge exchange and capacity building

Through training sessions, capacity building for citizens and support for higher education and
researcher institutions, AEIP strengthens skills and innovation ecosystems.

4
A library of resources

Produced knowledge policy briefs, and recommendations will be showcased online and will be made
available to a broad audience.

5
Access to financial support

Providing access to soft and hard capital support, helping start-ups and SMEs to scale
internationally while navigating regulatory landscapes.

## Sustainability is at the core of the AEIP

Designed for long-term impact, the platform will be maintained to ensure that new activities and
partnerships continue well beyond the project’s duration.

By strengthening networks and aligning with stakeholder needs, **the AEIP will contribute to:**

Sustainable and inclusive development
Economic growth and job creation
Resilient and connected innovation ecosystems

The AEIP marks a significant step towards a more collaborative, innovative, and shared future for
Africa and Europe.

of trusted brands, strong scale, and deep operational capability, we serve consumers across key

for our customers, partners, and shareholders, powering everyday life, today and for the future.

[Water & Food]
Water & Food

Agthia’s Water & Food business delivers scale, reliability, and category leadership across the
region. With 1.35 million m³ of bottled water capacity, a strong HOS platform, and a fleet of 288+
vehicles, we serve households and businesses daily. Our portfolio spans 75+ SKUs and includes market
leaders such as the UAE’s #1 Water, Arabic Coffee and Tomato Paste brands.

[Snacks]
[Snacks]
Snacks
[ More Details ][30]
[Snacks]
Snacks

Agthia’s Snacking business brings together leading regional brands across dates, coffee, chocolate,
and savory snacks. With an annual processing capacity of 256,500 tons, presence in 60+ export
markets, and a portfolio of 2,500+ SKUs across 3,500+ points of sale, the business supports over
20,000 farmers while delivering high-quality products to consumers worldwide.

[Protein&Frozen]
[Protein & Frozen]
Protein & Frozen
[ More Details ][31]
[Protein & Frozen]
Protein & Frozen

Agthia’s Protein business is a leading regional platform in frozen and processed protein, anchored
by Egypt’s and Jordan’s #1 frozen protein brands. With annual capacity of 119,000 tons and a 95,000
sqm manufacturing facility, the business serves regional and export markets through a growing
distribution network.

[Agri-business]
[Agri Business]
Agri-Business
[ More Details ][32]
[Agri Business]
Agri-Business

Agthia’s Agri-Business is a cornerstone of the UAE’s food security ecosystem, anchored by the
country’s #1 flour and #1 animal feed brands. With annual capacity of 950,000 tons, the ability to
unload 1,600 tons per hour, and a portfolio of 105+ SKUs and 100+ feed types, the business serves
customers nationwide.

Guangdong Aobang Curtain Wall Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional curtain wall manufacturer and

complete facade solutions for commercial and residential projects worldwide.

We manufacture and supply a wide range of curtain wall systems, including:

Glass Curtain Wall Aluminum Panel Curtain Wall Stone Curtain Wall Ceramic Panel Curtain Wall Metal

Yes.Our company has more than **400 professional installation workers** with extensive experience in
domestic and international construction projects.

On-site installation Curtain wall replacement Facade renovation Project management Technical

Yes.Our products and services have been supplied to clients in **more than 20 countries**.

We provide:

Engineering consultation Shop drawings Material fabrication International logistics On-site
installation support

Our manufacturing base covers **180,000 square meters**, with an annual production capacity of
**over 3,000,000㎡**.

This enables us to efficiently deliver both small and large-scale curtain wall projects while
maintaining stable quality and on-time delivery.

6. Can you customize curtain wall systems?

Absolutely.

Architectural Drawings Shop Drawings BIM Models Project Specifications

# ABOUT US

Aperoliva is a company specialized in th** Import and Export of olive and avocado oil in bul** of
the best quality.Our work begins with the selection of the best fruits to ensure that our oils meet
the highest quality standards. Therefore, we select our suppliers from among the best oil producers
in **Spain, Portugal, Greece and Italy** and we make sure that the elaboration of the oils is
carried out following the production protocols.

Aperoliva’s team consists of professionals with proven knowledge in the interpretation and analysis
of the physicochemical parameters of purity and organoleptic parameters of the oil and is trained to
offer the best service to our customers.

Currently, we export our oils in bulk to companies throughout **Europe, Asia, USA, Canada, South
America, Australia, Russia and the United Arab Emirate**.

As for what identifies us, we like to define ourselves as a **quality company**: quality in the
selection of suppliers, quality in the product and quality in the service we offer.

## CUSTOMERS ARE THE FOCUS OF EVERYTHING WE DO.

We support growth. We create opportunities. We grow communities.


### About Alex Lee  

Alex Lee, Inc., is one of the largest grocery retail and wholesale distribution companies in the
southeastern United States. We are the parent company of wholesale distributors Merchants
Distributors (MDI), Souto Foods, W. Lee Flowers, and Import Mex, as well as grocery banners Lowes
Foods and Kj’s Market. In total, we operate in 13 states; own over 140 retail stores; serve over
1,960 stores in wholesale; and count close to 15,000 people as part of the Alex Lee family.

### History  

Alex Lee has remained privately held for over 90 years and now spans four generations. We benefit
from a history of always doing what is best for our customers, as well as our Alex Lee values. While
we continue to build onto our strong foundation and look to our past for guidance, we are
future-facing. We are passionate about embracing innovation and growth as we look to the future as a
trusted partner for our customers.

[Learn More][17]

### Careers at Alex Lee  

Growth is our only option – this applies to our business, our customers, and our people. We want
Alex Lee to be a place where people want to stay and grow their careers, which is why we offer
pathways for professional advancement and continued education and development. This is why Alex Lee
is recognized by our employees as being a place where they see themselves crafting a lifelong
career.

[See Career Listings][18]

representatives are knowledgeable in the confectionery, baking, dairy, dry blending, fruit &

## Simplify Sourcing

American International Foods takes pride in making the process of sourcing ingredients and managing
inventory easy for our clients. We offer competitive pricing, complete documentation, and on-time
delivery. Need a price quote? Contact us first.

[Request a Quote][85]

## Availability

We help supply chain professionals ensure continuity of supply for raw ingredients and materials,
navigating market dynamics, price fluctuations, and sourcing challenges with ease. Enjoy transparent
pricing, traceable sourcing, and reliable delivery, all supported by our global capacity, advanced
logistics, and complete documentation.

Request a quote or check availability today!

[Check Availability][86]

## Ingredient Documentation

We provide our customers with full specifications, traceability, and documentation for every
ingredient and material we deliver. From quality certificates and compliance reports to detailed
product specifications, our goal is to make your purchasing, auditing, and quality assurance
processes effortless.

Request your order documentation —get all the information you need with every delivery.

recent Market Reports for Dairy, Eggs, and Wheat? Sign up for our Weekly Market Reports, delivered

## Research & Development

The food industry is dynamic – it is always changing, growing, and expanding into cutting-edge
ingredient categories and innovations. At American International Foods, Inc. we research and source
new and emerging ingredients to offer our clients the opportunity to sample “new to the market”
ingredients and innovations. Our full-service portfolio of over 2500 different ingredients continues
to grow and expand into new food ingredient categories so that you can design and develop new
products.

[Learn More About Our R&D Support][89]

## Product Formulation

With a robust product line of over 2500 different ingredients, American International Foods, Inc. is
wholly equipped to be your reliable ingredient supplier while you reformulate and/or create a new
product line. Our ingredient experts stay up-to-date on industry trends and requirements to best
assist our clients as they grow and perfect their trade. Looking to reformulate? Visit our
formulation page to learn more.

## Simplify Sourcing

American International Foods takes pride in making the process of sourcing ingredients and managing
inventory easy for our clients. We offer competitive pricing, complete documentation, and on-time
delivery. Need a price quote? Contact us first.

[Request a Quote][85]

## Availability

We help supply chain professionals ensure continuity of supply for raw ingredients and materials,
navigating market dynamics, price fluctuations, and sourcing challenges with ease. Enjoy transparent
pricing, traceable sourcing, and reliable delivery, all supported by our global capacity, advanced
logistics, and complete documentation.

Request a quote or check availability today!

[Check Availability][86]

## Ingredient Documentation

We provide our customers with full specifications, traceability, and documentation for every
ingredient and material we deliver. From quality certificates and compliance reports to detailed
product specifications, our goal is to make your purchasing, auditing, and quality assurance
processes effortless.

Request your order documentation —get all the information you need with every delivery.

 

[Request Documentation][87]

## Market Insights

Looking to catch up on industry news? Want to learn more about the current trends? Need the most
recent Market Reports for Dairy, Eggs, and Wheat? Sign up for our Weekly Market Reports, delivered
every Friday straight to your inbox.

[Sign Up for Weekly Market Reports][88]

## Research & Development

The food industry is dynamic – it is always changing, growing, and expanding into cutting-edge
ingredient categories and innovations. At American International Foods, Inc. we research and source
new and emerging ingredients to offer our clients the opportunity to sample “new to the market”
ingredients and innovations. Our full-service portfolio of over 2500 different ingredients continues
to grow and expand into new food ingredient categories so that you can design and develop new
products.

[Learn More About Our R&D Support][89]

## Product Formulation

With a robust product line of over 2500 different ingredients, American International Foods, Inc. is
wholly equipped to be your reliable ingredient supplier while you reformulate and/or create a new
product line. Our ingredient experts stay up-to-date on industry trends and requirements to best
assist our clients as they grow and perfect their trade. Looking to reformulate? Visit our
formulation page to learn more.

### ABOUT US

The Anchor Foods story began in 1854 when an enterprising young mariner and merchant from the
Shetland Isles, Gilbert Wood, took possession of an unpaid cargo. Where others would have seen ruin,
he saw opportunity and with great initiative, on-sold the groceries to recover debts.

 

Opting to leave his life on the high seas, Gilbert started his own grocery store and chose the sign
of the Anchor as its symbol. From humble beginnings, the company prospered and quickly gained the
reputation of being a first class supplier of quality grocery foods across Australia.

 

For well over 100 years the port city of Fremantle has been the home of Anchor Foods. Australians
have grown up with Anchor Foods products. The business is one of Australia's oldest grocery food
companies and is a pantry icon representing a significant piece of Australia's history. Anchor Foods
portfolio of brands include household names like Lighthouse, Lion and Spencers Spices.


Anchor Foods is guided by its following values that bring delight to its consumers.
* Innovation
* Speed
* BRC Quality
* Real Value
* Relationships with Integrity

[Anchor.jpg]

### RESPONSIBILITY

###### CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY

[[worksafeplan_gold_200x157.png]][37]

Anchor Foods has a long-term commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility and for the impact of our
business decisions and activities on society and the environment, consumers, employees and
communities. Anchor Foods monitors and ensures its support to WHS, ethical standards, laws and
international norms, and embraces its responsibility for the impact of its activities on the
environment.

We commit to this with transparent and ethical behaviour that:
* Contributes to sustainable development, including the health and the welfare of society
* Eliminates or minimises risk and provides a workplace that enables all work activities to be
  carried out safely;
* Takes into account the expectations of stakeholders
* Is in compliance with applicable laws and consistent with international norms of behaviour, and
* Is integrated throughout the organisation and practised in its relationships.

 

Gold Workspace Plan Certificate 

###### COMMUNITY INVESTMENT

We believe communities work better when everyone gives something back. At Anchor Foods, the culture
of giving back is deeply embedded in our everyday business and we strive to make a difference by
contributing to the community to help create a brighter future. We proudly support a range of
community organisations and charities including:

* Foodbank
* Ronald McDonald House (PMH)
* McGrath Foundation
* Australia's Biggest Morning Tea
* Starlight Children's Foundation
* Local sporting groups
* Local community groups and schools

###### SUPPORT FOR LOCAL SUPPLIERS

Local (Australian) food represents an alternative to the global food model, a model which often sees
food traveling long distances before it reaches the consumer. A local food network involves
relationships between food producers, suppliers, retailers, and consumers in a particular place
where they work together to increase food security and ensure economic, ecological and social
sustainability of a community.

Anchor Foods chooses when available, to source raw materials and packaging from suppliers in
Australia in order to develop more self-reliant and resilient food networks, improve local
economies, and for greater environmental, community and social impact.

### ABOUT US

The Anchor Foods story began in 1854 when an enterprising young mariner and merchant from the
Shetland Isles, Gilbert Wood, took possession of an unpaid cargo. Where others would have seen ruin,
he saw opportunity and with great initiative, on-sold the groceries to recover debts.

 

Opting to leave his life on the high seas, Gilbert started his own grocery store and chose the sign
of the Anchor as its symbol. From humble beginnings, the company prospered and quickly gained the
reputation of being a first class supplier of quality grocery foods across Australia.

 

For well over 100 years the port city of Fremantle has been the home of Anchor Foods. Australians
have grown up with Anchor Foods products. The business is one of Australia's oldest grocery food
companies and is a pantry icon representing a significant piece of Australia's history. Anchor Foods
portfolio of brands include household names like Lighthouse, Lion and Spencers Spices.


Anchor Foods is guided by its following values that bring delight to its consumers.
* Innovation
* Speed
* BRC Quality
* Real Value
* Relationships with Integrity

[Anchor.jpg]
Responsibility

### RESPONSIBILITY

###### CORPORATE SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY

[[worksafeplan_gold_200x157.png]][37]

Anchor Foods has a long-term commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility and for the impact of our
business decisions and activities on society and the environment, consumers, employees and
communities. Anchor Foods monitors and ensures its support to WHS, ethical standards, laws and
international norms, and embraces its responsibility for the impact of its activities on the
environment.

We commit to this with transparent and ethical behaviour that:
* Contributes to sustainable development, including the health and the welfare of society
* Eliminates or minimises risk and provides a workplace that enables all work activities to be
  carried out safely;
* Takes into account the expectations of stakeholders
* Is in compliance with applicable laws and consistent with international norms of behaviour, and
* Is integrated throughout the organisation and practised in its relationships.

 

Gold Workspace Plan Certificate 

###### COMMUNITY INVESTMENT

We believe communities work better when everyone gives something back. At Anchor Foods, the culture
of giving back is deeply embedded in our everyday business and we strive to make a difference by
contributing to the community to help create a brighter future. We proudly support a range of
community organisations and charities including:

* Foodbank
* Ronald McDonald House (PMH)
* McGrath Foundation
* Australia's Biggest Morning Tea
* Starlight Children's Foundation
* Local sporting groups
* Local community groups and schools

###### SUPPORT FOR LOCAL SUPPLIERS

Local (Australian) food represents an alternative to the global food model, a model which often sees
food traveling long distances before it reaches the consumer. A local food network involves
relationships between food producers, suppliers, retailers, and consumers in a particular place
where they work together to increase food security and ensure economic, ecological and social
sustainability of a community.

Anchor Foods chooses when available, to source raw materials and packaging from suppliers in
Australia in order to develop more self-reliant and resilient food networks, improve local
economies, and for greater environmental, community and social impact.

###### MANAGING OUR ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT

In recognition of Triple Bottom Line reporting (People, Planet, Profit), Anchor Foods is committed
to protecting the community and the environment and recognises the relationship of food
manufacturing operations to our global and local environments.

Anchor Foods is a signatory to the National Packaging Covenant. The Covenant is a voluntary
initiative developed by the Australian Government and Industry to reduce the environmental impacts
arising from the use and disposal of packaging.


As a signatory, Anchor Foods is required to demonstrate a commitment to the sustainable manufacture,
use and recovery of packaging through better design, manufacture and recycling process. Anchor Foods
is committed to caring for the environment and reducing its carbon foot print wherever possible. A
continuous improvement action plan has been implemented reviewing product packaging design,
manufacturing process and recycling procedures across all divisions of the business, with the
objective of reducing our impact on the environment.

###### FOOD LABELS

Food labels can provide a wide range of information to help consumers make food choices. Food labels
also help to protect public health and safety by displaying information such as use by dates,
ingredients, certain allergens, instructions for storage and preparation, and advisory and warning
statements. FSANZ sets standards for what information must be on food labels.


For more information about reading food labels, visit the FSANZ website:

[http://www.foodstandards.gov.au/consumer/labelling/Pages/default.aspx][38]


Best Before dates are shown on packaged foods that should be consumed within a specific timeframe,
although you may not find one on foods that have a long shelf life. Use By dates are only used on
perishable foods.

###### GLOBAL ACCREDITATION

Anchor Foods has achieved British Retail Consortium (BRC) quality standard certification.
(Certificate registration number GB08/73864).

A high level of focus and commitment to Food Safety and Quality is required to obtain and maintain
BRC certification. The BRC standard is considered to be the highest level of Food Safety and Quality
Standard accreditation issued globally and is considered the optimal food standard accreditation in
countries such as Europe, the UK and Asia. Few companies in Australia have managed to obtain the BRC
level of certification and it demonstrates Anchor Foods continued commitment to Food Safety and
Quality.


Anchor Foods has been certified to HACCP Food Safety accreditation certificate registration
FSAU02/330 since 2001.

This is the foundation that Anchor Foods has based its Food Safety system on. Anchor Foods continues
to strive for new levels of Food Safety and Quality and will always remain focussed on the safety of
its products.

###### CONFIDENTIAL REPORTING

Anchor Foods is committed to the maintaining a high standard of ethical business practice and
corporate governance, and the highest possible standards of openness, honesty and accountability. 
Anchor Foods require its directors, officers and employees to observe high standards of business
conduct and ethics, as well as compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, corporate reporting
and disclosure, accounting practices and controls, auditing practices and other matters relating to
fraud. 

In line with that commitment, we expect anyone who has serious concerns about any aspect of the work
within Anchor Foods relating to product safety, integrity, quality & legality to come forward and
inform us of those concerns.

 

Anchor Foods has a Confidential Reporting procedure that provides a mechanism through which such
concerns can be reported and investigated. This Confidential Reporting Procedure applies to all
members of staff and contractors working for Anchor Foods. It also covers suppliers and those
providing services under a contract with Anchor Foods on their own premises. See link below for our
Confidential Reporting Procedure. To make a report see “whistleblowing” contact email address
contained.

## Your normal salt doesn’t have to be just *normal salt.*

*“My go-to salt for nutrient-rich flavor without overpowering foods. One pinch transforms everything
from wild-caught fish to steamed kale, which makes Colima Sea Salt™ a mainstay in my kitchen.”*

**- JJ Virgin**, NYT Best-Selling Author

## Colima Sea Salt^{tm}

Ava Jane’s Colima Sea Salt is a coarse, crunchy, moist sea salt. Unrefined, Ocean-Borne
Microplastics free, all natural, and packed with trace minerals your body needs.

Harvested by hand just 16 weeks each year, it actually tastes good and is good for you.

Enhances every bite with an explosion of crunchy, salty goodness. Perfect for pinching.

[ Learn More ][17]
[Bottle of Ava Jane's Kitchen Avocado Oil with a bowl of green oil sitting in front of the
bottle][Bottle of Ava Jane's Kitchen Avocado Oil with a bowl of green oil sitting in front of the
bottle]

## Avocado Oil

Ava Jane’s Avocado Oil features an ideal fat profile that helps you absorb maximum nutrition from
your food. It’s also naturally packed with over 20 vitamins and minerals: including vitamin E and
magnesium.

Enjoy the soft and delicate flavor profile that enhances rather than overpowers your food, making it
ideal for salad dressing, sautéing, grilling or dipping.

A high smoke point of 480°F makes Ava Jane’s Avocado Oil the perfect companion for grilling or
pan-searing meats and vegetables.

[ Learn More ][18]
[Bag of Ava Jane's Kitchen's Caramelized Cacao Beans with a bowl of the beans sitting in front of
the bag][Bag of Ava Jane's Kitchen's Caramelized Cacao Beans with a bowl of the beans sitting in
front of the bag]

## Caramelized Cacao

Take all that nonsense about chocolate being healthy for you and throw it out the window. All the
studies that have been done don’t use chocolate, they use cacao.

Cacao is good for you, full of antioxidants. Chocolate is cacao that has been processed, broken
down, mixed with refined sugar and artificial ingredients, and then marketed to you as a “health
food”.

Meet the world’s first guilt-free chocolate. It’s real, decadent cacao beans lightly dusted with
pure caramelized cane sugar. Finally you can eat all the delicious chocolate you want without the
fat, or calories.

[ Learn More ][19]

## ARTISAN SPICE BLENDS

Ava Jane’s Spices are ground fresh and mixed by a flavor mastermind just weeks before they are
delivered to your door.

My Colima Sea Salt is fantastic on its own, however, I’ve always dreamed of doing more with it. Of
creating something you could just sprinkle on some meat or veggies and have a quick, healthy, tasty
meal.

Read the whole story, hit the learn more button. You won’t find spices this fresh in the store. And
the flavors, well, you have to taste them…

[ Learn More ][20]

### What customers are saying

“Makes Everything Taste Better”

***“Explodes With Flavor”***

“The Best Oil For Cooking”

“Go-To Kitchen Salt”

## **Our Story**

Ava Jane is the inspiration for our artisanal food. She’s also our daughter, whose zest for life
inspires us to keep sharing our kitchen secrets with the world. The journey began with Ava’s Nana,
who sparked our love affair with all things edible. From tending to her garden, to long nature
walks, to sacred family dinners, she taught us to infuse our life and food with the same values of
patience, integrity and honesty. No shortcuts.

And then came our engagement in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, many years ago. It led to annual surf
vacations ever since. A few years ago, we discovered hand-harvested sea salt produced by local
entrepreneurs called “salineros” (salt-farmers). After successfully bringing this wonderfully pure
and flavorful salt to kitchens across America, our purpose became clear: we would spend our days
searching for even more hidden gastronomical treasures. And sharing the joy of the most unusually
delicious, nutritious and wholesome food Mother Earth has to offer.

searching for even more hidden gastronomical treasures. And sharing the joy of the most unusually
delicious, nutritious and wholesome food Mother Earth has to offer.

## Your normal salt doesn’t have to be just *normal salt.*

*“My go-to salt for nutrient-rich flavor without overpowering foods. One pinch transforms everything
from wild-caught fish to steamed kale, which makes Colima Sea Salt™ a mainstay in my kitchen.”*

**- JJ Virgin**, NYT Best-Selling Author

[ Shop Now! ][16]
[Bag of Colima Sea Salt with a Ramekin of Salt Sitting In front of the Bag][Bag of Colima Sea Salt
with a Ramekin of Salt Sitting In front of the Bag]

## Colima Sea Salt^{tm}

Ava Jane’s Colima Sea Salt is a coarse, crunchy, moist sea salt. Unrefined, Ocean-Borne
Microplastics free, all natural, and packed with trace minerals your body needs.

Harvested by hand just 16 weeks each year, it actually tastes good and is good for you.

Enhances every bite with an explosion of crunchy, salty goodness. Perfect for pinching.

[ Learn More ][17]
[Bottle of Ava Jane's Kitchen Avocado Oil with a bowl of green oil sitting in front of the
bottle][Bottle of Ava Jane's Kitchen Avocado Oil with a bowl of green oil sitting in front of the
bottle]

## Avocado Oil

Ava Jane’s Avocado Oil features an ideal fat profile that helps you absorb maximum nutrition from
your food. It’s also naturally packed with over 20 vitamins and minerals: including vitamin E and
magnesium.

Enjoy the soft and delicate flavor profile that enhances rather than overpowers your food, making it
ideal for salad dressing, sautéing, grilling or dipping.

A high smoke point of 480°F makes Ava Jane’s Avocado Oil the perfect companion for grilling or
pan-searing meats and vegetables.

[ Learn More ][18]
[Bag of Ava Jane's Kitchen's Caramelized Cacao Beans with a bowl of the beans sitting in front of
the bag][Bag of Ava Jane's Kitchen's Caramelized Cacao Beans with a bowl of the beans sitting in
front of the bag]

## Caramelized Cacao

Take all that nonsense about chocolate being healthy for you and throw it out the window. All the
studies that have been done don’t use chocolate, they use cacao.

Cacao is good for you, full of antioxidants. Chocolate is cacao that has been processed, broken
down, mixed with refined sugar and artificial ingredients, and then marketed to you as a “health
food”.

Meet the world’s first guilt-free chocolate. It’s real, decadent cacao beans lightly dusted with
pure caramelized cane sugar. Finally you can eat all the delicious chocolate you want without the
fat, or calories.

[ Learn More ][19]

## ARTISAN SPICE BLENDS

Ava Jane’s Spices are ground fresh and mixed by a flavor mastermind just weeks before they are
delivered to your door.

My Colima Sea Salt is fantastic on its own, however, I’ve always dreamed of doing more with it. Of
creating something you could just sprinkle on some meat or veggies and have a quick, healthy, tasty
meal.

Read the whole story, hit the learn more button. You won’t find spices this fresh in the store. And
the flavors, well, you have to taste them…

[ Learn More ][20]

### What customers are saying

“Makes Everything Taste Better”

***“Explodes With Flavor”***

“The Best Oil For Cooking”

“Go-To Kitchen Salt”

## **Our Story**

Ava Jane is the inspiration for our artisanal food. She’s also our daughter, whose zest for life
inspires us to keep sharing our kitchen secrets with the world. The journey began with Ava’s Nana,
who sparked our love affair with all things edible. From tending to her garden, to long nature
walks, to sacred family dinners, she taught us to infuse our life and food with the same values of
patience, integrity and honesty. No shortcuts.

And then came our engagement in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, many years ago. It led to annual surf
vacations ever since. A few years ago, we discovered hand-harvested sea salt produced by local
entrepreneurs called “salineros” (salt-farmers). After successfully bringing this wonderfully pure
and flavorful salt to kitchens across America, our purpose became clear: we would spend our days
searching for even more hidden gastronomical treasures. And sharing the joy of the most unusually
delicious, nutritious and wholesome food Mother Earth has to offer.

Serving Independent Grocers Since 1940

[ BECOME A MEMBER RETAILER ][18]

# Our Purpose

In 1940 the grocery industry was a rough place for independent retailers. Strong competition from
national chains, increased prices from wholesalers and low margins left many families and
independently-owned businesses with boarded windows. Determined to succeed against the competition,
34 independent retailers and Donald P. Lloyd, the then president of the Utah Grocers Association,
joined together to combine their buying power and open a warehouse, leading to the birth of AFS.

# OUr HISTORY

# **The Story of AFS**

Since 1940 we have grown from 34 retailers in Utah to nearly 450 independent grocers across Utah,
Idaho, Colorado, Wyoming, Montana, Nevada, Arizona, New Mexico, and Oregon.

[ LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR HISTORY ][19]

# **AvoHealth** – **Avocado Oil Specialists**

**We provide Advisory Services to ensure you have an excellent business case to start manufacturing
***or*** marketing Avocado Oil.**

**AvoHealth** **also market/distribute **(often bulk)** Avocado Oil products all over the world.**
For our client production companies, w*e can handle 100% of your avocado oil marketing &
distribution.*

In 2025 we can supply:
1. **Bulk Unrefined CRUDE (raw) Avocado Oil **– *Shipped in 24,000 liter Flexitanks. Use as a food,*
   *nutraceutical or cosmetic ingredient.* We are confident our Crude Oil is such high quality,
   there is no chance the ‘toxins’ known as 3-MCPD ,or Glycidyl Esters will form in the refining
   process.
2. **Extra Virgin Avocado Oil** – *usually shipped in 1,000 liter IBC’s/Totes*

In future we will supply:
3. **Refined Avocado Oil **– RBD & RBDW – not before 2026

4. **Retail Avocado Oil** – packed to your requirements in dark glass bottles or Hi-Tech plastic
bottles designed for on-line retail (e.g. Amazon).
* Your Private Label, *or*
* AvoHealth brand

Andrew Logan – Presenter at World Avocado Congress 2023. Avocado Africa Congress 2024 + 2025

## **Personal service, best prices and the highest quality Avocado Oil**

Avocado Oil is a Functional Food, made from the healthiest fruit on earth. This new generation
Super-Food provides additional health benefits and anti-oxidant activity in the fights against
obesity, heart disease, dementia, blindness, skincare and a range of cancers. Read more about the
amazing [health benefits of AvoHealth Avocado Oil][15].

**AvoHealth** [provides advice][16] on every aspect of the Avocado Oil business; from feasibility
studies to the Agri-Tech processing technology required, to advising on product packaging & branding
to meet your target markets.

We advise on the optimum production machinery and plant design, to maximize oil quality & yields.
* New production plants are in constant planning and development.
* Each new production facility improves our supply of ‘clean label’, minimally processed, finest
  quality Avocado Oil.

[ripe avocado]

**Avocado Health Limited**, (**AvoHealth**), is incorporated in New Zealand. **Avocado Processors
EPZ Limited,** is incorporated in Kenya and trades as **AvoHealth Kenya.**  We receive regular
inquiry for assistance on new Avocado Oil Production Projects from Mexico & South America.
Currently, we are working on NEW projects in Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Uganda & Rwanda.  
* **November 2022:** – Held a seminar on the Avocado Oil industry for 43 participants in Nairobi,
  Kenya. Extensive meetings with many clients.

**Presentation #1:** Is there a good business case to press Avocado Oil?

**Presentation #2:** Avocado Oil Processing – a model for self-regulation.


**May 2024 + May 2025 – Avocado Africa Congress** in Nairobi – a lead presenter always focussed on:

bring you the safest and highest quality products. We only engage in socially, environmentally, and
economically responsible practices in order to benefit everyone that handles our avocados in any
stage of the process—from the farm, to you.

###### Avopro EPZ Ltd is located in Sagana, Kirinyaga District, in Central Kenya. This is right in
###### the heart of the highly fertile and productive agricultural zone of the Mt Kenya region.

The Avopro network consists of nearly 5,000 Kenyan farmers. You can count on us for consistency.

#### 100% Natural

Our avocado oil is naturally refined. We are 100% transparent with what goes into our oils—pure
avocados, purely from our farms.

#### Sustainable

Avopro gives back to the planet and the community by making a positive impact in Sagana, Central
Kenya, and providing employment opportunities.

### Our Story

###### Avopro EPZ is dedicated to education and agronomy to build a sustainable business—for our
###### employees and our farmers. We have dedicated the time it takes to create organic growing
###### conditions at our farms. This creates a better product for you and a long-lasting economy for
###### our region.
###### 
###### Avopro was incorporated in 2020 and holds an EPZA license under Kenyan regulations.

[ More About Us ][19]

## Our farmers pride themselves in knowing what it takes to grow a good fruit.

We are partnered with 80% female-owned farms, from which we ethically source our avocados to always
bring you the safest and highest quality products. We only engage in socially, environmentally, and
economically responsible practices in order to benefit everyone that handles our avocados in any
stage of the process—from the farm, to you.

### In the Ideal Growing Conditions of Kenya

###### Avopro EPZ Ltd is located in Sagana, Kirinyaga District, in Central Kenya. This is right in
###### the heart of the highly fertile and productive agricultural zone of the Mt Kenya region.
###### 
###### The volcanic soils in this expansive zone, coupled with good climate, offer conditions that
###### are very conducive for agriculture. Most of our avocados are farmed in this region

# **unlock the ****full potential**** of avocado oil production.**

AvoVenture Consulting specializes in guiding both aspiring entrepreneurs and established
manufacturers through every step of the avocado oil production process. Whether you’re looking to
set up an avocado oil factory or seeking to optimize your existing operations, we’re here to help
you achieve success.

[ about us ][19]

### **for ****aspiring entrepreneurs**

Looking to establish an avocado oil factory? We’ll provide expert guidance from conception to
implementation.
* #### consultation and planning
  
  We’ll guide you from conception to execution, and work closely with you to develop a customized
  roadmap that aligns with your vision, budget, and timeline.
* #### factory setup
  
  From selecting the right equipment to designing efficient layouts, we'll ensure your avocado oil
  factory is set up for maximum productivity and profitability.
* #### supply chain management
  
  We'll assist you in sourcing high-quality avocados, optimizing logistics, and establishing
  reliable partnerships to support your production needs.

[ Learn more ][20]

### **for ****established manufacturers**

Looking to optimize operations at your existing avocado oil factory? We’ll help you strategize ways
to drive your business forward.
* #### process optimization
  
  We’ll conduct a thorough assessment of your current operations to identify areas for improvement
  and implement strategies to enhance efficiency and quality.
* #### product diversification
  
  Looking to expand your product line? We'll help you explore new avenues for innovation and develop
  unique avocado oil products to meet evolving consumer preferences.
* #### market expansion
  
  With our strategic guidance, you can tap into new markets, both domestically and internationally,
  to grow your customer base and increase profitability.

[ Learn more ][21]

Whether you’re ready to begin working with us or you’d like to learn more about what we can do to
help you make your mark in the avocado oil industry, we’re happy to help.

[Contact us][22] today to start your AvoVenture experience.

**phone: **[+1 (289) 644-7277][23]

**email: **[hasan@avoventure.co][24]

**location: **Amman, Jordan · Toronto, Canada

# The SPF 50 natural tinted moisturiser.

Your SPF, moisturiser and foundation in one with all natural & naturally derived ingredients.

[ Shop Now ][158]
Pause slideshow

Key Benefits

100% Natural and Skin-Loving

Every ingredient is carefully selected with your skin in mind. There are no chemical actives,
preservatives, or synthetic fragrances. Just pure, plant-based ingredients that nourish, protect,
and calm even the most sensitive skin.

Broad-Spectrum Physical Protection

Made with non-nano Zinc Oxide to provide safe and effective protection against both UVA and UVB
rays. This mineral SPF sits on the surface of the skin to reflect the sun’s rays rather than absorb
them.

Lightweight, Non-Greasy Finish

Our formula blends in easily without leaving a white cast. It delivers a moisturised, dewy glow and
works beautifully as a daily primer under makeup.

Family Friendly and Reef Safe

Gentle enough for babies and suitable for use during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Free from
reef-harming ingredients, it’s a safe choice for your skin and the environment.

# The SPF 50 natural tinted moisturiser.

Your SPF, moisturiser and foundation in one with all natural & naturally derived ingredients.

[ Shop Now ][158]
Pause slideshow

Key Benefits

100% Natural and Skin-Loving

Every ingredient is carefully selected with your skin in mind. There are no chemical actives,
preservatives, or synthetic fragrances. Just pure, plant-based ingredients that nourish, protect,
and calm even the most sensitive skin.

Broad-Spectrum Physical Protection

Made with non-nano Zinc Oxide to provide safe and effective protection against both UVA and UVB
rays. This mineral SPF sits on the surface of the skin to reflect the sun’s rays rather than absorb
them.

Lightweight, Non-Greasy Finish

Our formula blends in easily without leaving a white cast. It delivers a moisturised, dewy glow and
works beautifully as a daily primer under makeup.

Family Friendly and Reef Safe

Gentle enough for babies and suitable for use during pregnancy and breastfeeding. Free from
reef-harming ingredients, it’s a safe choice for your skin and the environment.

# Avocado Oil Manufacturers in Thiruvananthapuram

Trusted avocado oil manufacturers in Thiruvananthapuram supplying premium, food-grade, refined and
crude avocado oil nationwide.

[ APPROACH US ][15]
[Avocado Oil Manufacturers in Thiruvananthapuram]
ABOUT US

## Best Avocado Oil Manufacturers in Thiruvananthapuram

At [**AvoFresh Processors** ][16], we take pride in producing pure and nutrient-rich avocado oil,
using a world-class extraction process that ensures the highest level of purity. Our oil maintains
its delicate aroma, vibrant color, and smooth texture, making it an ideal choice for both culinary
and cosmetic applications.

AvoFresh Processors specializes in the global distribution of premium avocado oil, ensuring that
businesses and consumers **worldwide** have access to pure, natural, and high-quality cooking oil.

### Bulk Avocado Oil Supply in Hyderabad

[Avocado Oil Manufacturers in Thiruvananthapuram]
Crude Avocado oil

AvoFresh Processors offers high-quality Crude Avocado Oil, extracted from the finest Kenyan avocados
to retain its natural nutrients, vibrant green color, and rich aroma.

[ KNOW MORE ][17]
[Avocado Oil Manufacturers in Thiruvananthapuram]
Refined avocado oil

AvoFresh Processors offers premium Refined Avocado Oil, carefully processed to maintain its purity,
light texture, and high smoke point, making it ideal for everyday cooking and food manufacturing.

[ KNOW MORE ][18]

#### Premium Avocado Oil Supplier in Hyderabad

Premium Quality & 100% Pure

Our avocado oil is made from carefully selected, ripe Kenyan avocados, ensuring pure, natural, and
nutrient-rich oil with a smooth texture and rich flavor.

Nutrient-Rich

We use an advanced extraction method to retain maximum nutrients, antioxidants, and essential fatty
acids, making our oil one of the healthiest cooking oils available.

High Smoke Point – Perfect for Cooking

AvoFresh Processors Avocado Oil has a high smoke point, making it ideal for frying, sautéing,
roasting, and baking without breaking down or losing its nutritional value.

International Standards & Certifications

We ensure that our oil meets global food safety and export regulations, making it a trusted choice
for worldwide distribution.

Worldwide Exports & Reliable Supply Chain

With a strong logistics network and export expertise, we guarantee timely and secure delivery to
international markets.

Custom Packaging & Bulk Supply Options

We offer various packaging sizes to meet the needs of wholesalers, retailers, and food
manufacturers, ensuring maximum convenience and quality preservation.

##### Cold Pressed Avocado Oil Hyderabad

[Avocado Oil Manufacturers in Thiruvananthapuram]

##### Avocado Oil Dealers in Thiruvananthapuram

###### Refined Avocado Oil in Hyderabad

At **AvoFresh Processors** , we take pride in being a **trusted global supplier** of **premium Crude
and Refined Avocado Oil**. With a commitment to **quality, sustainability, and excellence**, we
cater to the growing needs of **food manufacturers, wholesalers and distributors** across
international markets.

Our state-of-the-art processing methods ensure that our avocado oil retains its **natural nutrients,
rich flavor, and high purity**, making it the preferred choice for culinary applications worldwide.

# Pure Avocado Oil...

Purity • Precision • Global Excellence
enhance the flavour of your life

## About Avoprime

AvoPrime Ltd is a regional agro‑industrial company specializing in premium cold‑pressed avocado oil
and fresh export fruit. We operate integrated facilities in Tanzania and Kenya, combining farmer
partnerships, modern processing technology, and strict quality systems to deliver world‑class
products to global markets.
* Integrated operations in Tanzania and Kenya
* Farmer partnerships & modern processing technology
* Strict quality systems for world‑class products

[More About Us][18]
[Premium avocado oil]

### Our Mission

To build a fully integrated, farmer‑centered avocado value chain — delivering premium cold‑pressed
oil and fresh export fruit with consistency, integrity and technical excellence.

[Read More →][19]

### CEO Vision

To become East Africa's most trusted avocado oil producer — standing for purity, precision and
prosperity, from Njombe orchards to global markets.

Mr. Adan A. Mohamed
CEO, AvoPrime Ltd
[Read More →][20]
what we stand for

## Core Values

#### Integrity

Honesty, transparency and accountability across our entire value chain.

#### Excellence

World-class quality through discipline, precision and continuous improvement.

#### Farmer Partnership

Uplifting farmers through fair pricing, training and long-term collaboration.

#### Innovation

Embracing modern technology and smarter processes to stay globally competitive.

#### Sustainability

Protecting the environment and promoting responsible, future-focused agriculture.

#### Reliability

Keeping our promises — consistent supply and consistent quality, every time.

#### People First

Investing in our team's safety, growth and professional development.

#### African Pride

Championing African excellence, built and measured to global standards.

## Our Products

[Product]

Our signature cold-pressed avocado oil — mild, buttery, and endlessly versatile.

[Product]

Perfect for high-heat cooking with a smooth taste. A healthier alternative for everyday meals.

[Product]

Deeply moisturizing and packed with vitamin E. Ideal for natural beauty routines.

[Go to Products][21]

## Discover the health benefits of avocado oil

Avocado oil is rich in monounsaturated fats, vitamin E, and lutein — actively supporting heart
health, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress.

## Modern facility, pure raw material

AvoPrime Tanzania operates a modern processing setup including cold‑press extraction line, sorting &
preparation area, storage and ripening boxes, quality control and moisture testing, weighbridge
integration, and packaging & dispatch area.
* Cold‑press extraction line
* Sorting & preparation area
* Storage and ripening boxes
* Quality control & moisture testing
* Weighbridge integration
* Packaging and dispatch area

**Raw material:** Hass Avocados only — sourced from Njombe, Makambako, Wanging'ombe, Mufindi, and
farmer cooperatives.

[AvoPrime facility]

## Step Into Our Process

From the moment the Hass avocados are hand-picked at peak ripeness to the instant the seal is placed
on each bottle, every step of our process is guided by one principle: preserve the natural goodness
that nature put into the fruit.

[Step]

#### Step 1

Premium Hass avocados hand-picked at peak ripeness.

[Step]

#### Step 2

Cold-pressed within hours — no heat, no chemicals.

[Step]

#### Step 3

Filtered, quality-tested, and bottled in dark glass.

client feedback

## Success Stories

Export PartnerCosmetics BrandRestaurantFarmer Co-opDistributor
“

AvoPrime oil consistently meets EU organic standards. Our clients love the full traceability from
orchard to bottle, and the quality never wavers shipment after shipment.

James K.Export Partner, Nairobi

“

The cold-pressed purity is unmatched. We use it in our premium skincare line because it's rich,
stable, and our customers feel the difference immediately.

Amina M.Founder, Natural Glow Cosmetics

“

Finally an avocado oil that can handle high heat without losing its character. Our chefs won't use
anything else for searing and dressings.

David R.Owner, Zanzibar Beach Kitchen

“

Fair prices and regular training changed our community. We are proud partners — AvoPrime treats us
like family, not just suppliers.

Grace T.Njombe Farmers Cooperative

“

Reliable supply, every single month. AvoPrime is our go‑to source for premium African avocado oil —
logistics are smooth and communication is excellent.

Michael B.Regional Distributor, Dubai

# Pure Avocado Oil...

Purity • Precision • Global Excellence
enhance the flavour of your life

## About Avoprime

AvoPrime Ltd is a regional agro‑industrial company specializing in premium cold‑pressed avocado oil
and fresh export fruit. We operate integrated facilities in Tanzania and Kenya, combining farmer
partnerships, modern processing technology, and strict quality systems to deliver world‑class
products to global markets.
* Integrated operations in Tanzania and Kenya
* Farmer partnerships & modern processing technology
* Strict quality systems for world‑class products

[More About Us][18]
[Premium avocado oil]

### Our Mission

To build a fully integrated, farmer‑centered avocado value chain — delivering premium cold‑pressed
oil and fresh export fruit with consistency, integrity and technical excellence.

[Read More →][19]

### CEO Vision

To become East Africa's most trusted avocado oil producer — standing for purity, precision and
prosperity, from Njombe orchards to global markets.

Mr. Adan A. Mohamed
CEO, AvoPrime Ltd
[Read More →][20]
what we stand for

## Core Values

#### Integrity

Honesty, transparency and accountability across our entire value chain.

#### Excellence

World-class quality through discipline, precision and continuous improvement.

#### Farmer Partnership

Uplifting farmers through fair pricing, training and long-term collaboration.

#### Innovation

Embracing modern technology and smarter processes to stay globally competitive.

#### Sustainability

Protecting the environment and promoting responsible, future-focused agriculture.

#### Reliability

Keeping our promises — consistent supply and consistent quality, every time.

#### People First

Investing in our team's safety, growth and professional development.

#### African Pride

Championing African excellence, built and measured to global standards.

## Our Products

[Product]

Our signature cold-pressed avocado oil — mild, buttery, and endlessly versatile.

[Product]

Perfect for high-heat cooking with a smooth taste. A healthier alternative for everyday meals.

[Product]

Deeply moisturizing and packed with vitamin E. Ideal for natural beauty routines.

[Go to Products][21]

## Discover the health benefits of avocado oil

Avocado oil is rich in monounsaturated fats, vitamin E, and lutein — actively supporting heart
health, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress.

## Modern facility, pure raw material

AvoPrime Tanzania operates a modern processing setup including cold‑press extraction line, sorting &
preparation area, storage and ripening boxes, quality control and moisture testing, weighbridge
integration, and packaging & dispatch area.
* Cold‑press extraction line
* Sorting & preparation area
* Storage and ripening boxes
* Quality control & moisture testing
* Weighbridge integration
* Packaging and dispatch area

**Raw material:** Hass Avocados only — sourced from Njombe, Makambako, Wanging'ombe, Mufindi, and
farmer cooperatives.

[AvoPrime facility]

## Step Into Our Process

From the moment the Hass avocados are hand-picked at peak ripeness to the instant the seal is placed
on each bottle, every step of our process is guided by one principle: preserve the natural goodness
that nature put into the fruit.

[Step]

#### Step 1

Premium Hass avocados hand-picked at peak ripeness.

[Step]

#### Step 2

Cold-pressed within hours — no heat, no chemicals.

[Step]

#### Step 3

Filtered, quality-tested, and bottled in dark glass.

client feedback

orchard to bottle, and the quality never wavers shipment after shipment.

James K.Export Partner, Nairobi

The cold-pressed purity is unmatched. We use it in our premium skincare line because it's rich,
stable, and our customers feel the difference immediately.

Amina M.Founder, Natural Glow Cosmetics

Finally an avocado oil that can handle high heat without losing its character. Our chefs won't use
anything else for searing and dressings.

David R.Owner, Zanzibar Beach Kitchen

“

Fair prices and regular training changed our community. We are proud partners — AvoPrime treats us
like family, not just suppliers.

Grace T.Njombe Farmers Cooperative

Reliable supply, every single month. AvoPrime is our go‑to source for premium African avocado oil —

## Bella Vado® Avocado Oil

At Bella Vado, we proudly craft America’s original cold-pressed avocado oil—right here on our family
farm in Southern California. Every drop of our golden-green oil begins with hand-selected,
California-grown avocados, harvested at peak ripeness and cold-pressed within hours to preserve
their full flavor, vibrant color, and powerful nutrients.

As the first U.S. producer of unrefined, unfiltered avocado oil, we’ve stayed true to what matters:
quality, integrity, and real food. Our oil is never chemically extracted, deodorized, or
altered—just 100% pure, extra virgin avocado oil made the traditional way.

Bella Vado avocado oil is:

USA-made, from California-grown avocados

Cold-pressed, unrefined, and unfiltered

Naturally Non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, and high in heart-healthy fats

A versatile culinary oil perfect for dressings, sautéing, roasting, and more

From our grove to your table, we invite you to taste the difference that freshness, family values,
and California sunshine make.

## The Heart of the Avocado

Looking back, it’s hard to believe how quickly it all flew by. Late-night bottling parties where we
called in all our kids and their friends—well bribed with pizza and music. Grueling 72-hour oil
pressing marathons with rotating sleep shifts—while half of us still worked full-time jobs. We were
all in. We hustled. We stayed heads down. We loved the craft of turning our avocados into oil.

We poured ourselves into perfecting our oil, always analyzing, adjusting, and improving our process
year after year.

To us, It was always more than a product available on store shelves, quietly traveling in your
shopping cart and then patiently sitting on your kitchen counter.

 **Bella Vado is the heart of the avocado!**

## Bella Vado® Avocado Oil

At Bella Vado, we proudly craft America’s original cold-pressed avocado oil—right here on our family
farm in Southern California. Every drop of our golden-green oil begins with hand-selected,
California-grown avocados, harvested at peak ripeness and cold-pressed within hours to preserve
their full flavor, vibrant color, and powerful nutrients.

As the first U.S. producer of unrefined, unfiltered avocado oil, we’ve stayed true to what matters:
quality, integrity, and real food. Our oil is never chemically extracted, deodorized, or
altered—just 100% pure, extra virgin avocado oil made the traditional way.

Bella Vado avocado oil is:

USA-made, from California-grown avocados

Cold-pressed, unrefined, and unfiltered

Naturally Non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, and high in heart-healthy fats

A versatile culinary oil perfect for dressings, sautéing, roasting, and more

From our grove to your table, we invite you to taste the difference that freshness, family values,
and California sunshine make.

## The Heart of the Avocado

Looking back, it’s hard to believe how quickly it all flew by. Late-night bottling parties where we
called in all our kids and their friends—well bribed with pizza and music. Grueling 72-hour oil
pressing marathons with rotating sleep shifts—while half of us still worked full-time jobs. We were
all in. We hustled. We stayed heads down. We loved the craft of turning our avocados into oil.

We poured ourselves into perfecting our oil, always analyzing, adjusting, and improving our process
year after year.

To us, It was always more than a product available on store shelves, quietly traveling in your
shopping cart and then patiently sitting on your kitchen counter.

 **Bella Vado is the heart of the avocado!**

Organics

#### Organic Oils

#### Fixed Oils

shelf life.

#### Fixed Oils

In the essential oils industry, “fixed oils” are non-volatile oils from botanical sources. Also
called “carrier” or “base” oils, they evaporate more slowly than essential oils and have a longer
shelf life.

offers over 2,500 natural and synthetic aromatic chemicals.

# Welcome to Beyond, the Plant Protein Company

[Scroll to See How][2]

## Beyond The Plant Protein Company committed to everyday nourishment.

## Simple, clean ingredients

Meet our line-up. Food you can feel good about, bite after bite:
* Plant proteins sourced from ingredients like yellow peas, red lentils, and faba beans
* No GMOs, 0mg cholesterol, and no added hormones or antibiotics

[Discover Products][3][Store Locator][4]
[Beyond Burger]

### Beyond Burger

Beyond burgers are the perfect blend of comfort food and clean eating with ingredients you can read
like avocado oil.

21g Protein
2g Saturated Fat
0mg Cholesterol

Nutritional info per 1 patty

[Product Details][5][WHERE TO BUY][6]
[Beyond Steak Tips]

### Beyond Steak Tips

Beyond Steak Tips add some rich and savory sizzle to your fajitas, stir fries, and salads.

21g Protein
1g Saturated Fat
170 Calories

Nutritional info per 3/4 cup steak tips

[Product Details][7][WHERE TO BUY][8]
[Beyond Chicken Pieces]

### Beyond Chicken Pieces

Beyond Chicken is clean protein reimagined— juicy, versatile, and air-fryer ready.

21g Protein
0.5g Saturated Fat
130 Calories

Nutritional info per 3/4 cup chicken pieces

[Product Details][9][WHERE TO BUY][10]
[Beyond Beef]

### Beyond Beef

Beyond Beef is the protein you can build any meal around, whether it’s tacos, pasta, or a protein
bowl.

21g Protein
2g Saturated Fat
230 Calories

Nutritional info per 4oz ground

[Product Details][11][WHERE TO BUY][12]
[Beyond Sausage]

### Beyond Sausage

Beyond Sausage is a mouth-watering addition to pasta, stir-fry, or just grilled with a bun.

17g Protein
0mg Cholesterol
210 Calories

Nutritional info per 1 link

[Product Details][13][WHERE TO BUY][14]
[Discover Products][15][Store Locator][16]
123

## Plants are nutrition powerhouses.

Our team is dedicated to unlocking and delivering nutrients such as vitamins, minerals, and healthy
fats.

[Learn More][17]

## Plants are nutrition powerhouses.

Our team is dedicated to unlocking and delivering nutrients such as vitamins, minerals, and healthy
fats.

[Learn More][18]

## We love clean protein.

Our products are full of powerful plant protein, with no added hormones, antibiotics, GMOs, or
cholesterol.

[Learn More][19]

## We believe in plant fiber.

Our products also include dietary fiber, essential fuel for the gut microbiome.

[Learn More][20]
[Plants are nutrition powerhouses.]

## Starting back at the farm

Meet Steven, a 5th generation farmer and father in Munich, North Dakota. He grows faba beans for
Beyond, a soil-enriching crop that helps regenerate farmland naturally. Stephen’s faba beans are one
of the simple, non-GMO ingredients that help Beyond bring you clean, wholesome plant protein that’s
good for the planet and your diet.

[Learn More][21]
[No Cholesterol;Faba bean protein;Avocado Oil;Simple ingredients;No antibiotics or hormones]

## Feeding a better future

We create plant protein to nourish and protect our bodies, heal earth and climate, and better share
the planet with the miracle of life that surrounds us.

[Our Mission][22]
[Feeding a better future]

## See what we’re cooking up next

Beyond Test Kitchen is where our newest ideas come to life, and where you come in. What excites us
most is creating products that bring energy and joy to our families, friends, and community. Beyond
Test Kitchen is our open innovation platform where you get early access to upcoming launches and
help shape what comes next.

[Shop Now][23]
[Chef holding a plate of two Beyond Steaks with asparagus and potatoes.]

Protein Company news, and more.

van Nederland leveren we daar actief een bijdrage aan.

Dat doen we door samen met onze strategische partner Albert Heijn te zorgen voor de allerbeste
kwaliteit, het meest verrassende en duurzame aanbod voor een competitieve prijs. Neem bijvoorbeeld
de AH verspakketten: bijzondere maaltijden met veel verse groenten en precies op maat, geen
verspilling dus.

[ Lees meer over ons groene verhaal ][35]
Onze activiteiten
Bakker Barendrecht zorgt ervoor dat bij Albert Heijn dagelijks de allerbeste groenten en fruit in de
winkels ligt. Aan Koninklijke Vezet leveren we groenten en fruit voor hun kant-en-klare producten en
maaltijdoplossingen. In België en Luxemburg hebben we een strategisch partnerschap met Delhaize. In
Tsjechië werken we samen met Albert.
[ Lees hier meer over ons ][36]
Citaat

We werken met plezier samen met onze klanten en telers aan gezonde en smaakvolle producten!

Fresh/Bakker
Werken bij Bakker
Met een vers product werken, geeft een bijzondere en afwisselende dynamiek. Dat vergt creativiteit
en eigen initiatief. We willen voorop lopen in ons internationale speelveld. Werken bij Bakker, is
werken in een fijne omgeving, met goede arbeidsomstandigheden en aandacht voor persoonlijke
ontwikkeling.
[ Lees hier meer over werken bij Bakker ][37]
Waar zitten we?
Onze locaties
Nederland
In Ridderkerk regelen we onze commerciële en logistieke activiteiten. Onze ondersteunende diensten
zijn hier ook gehuisvest.

Tsjechië
Vanuit onze vestiging in Divišov voorzien we supermarktketen Albert dagelijks van de beste groente-
en fruitproducten.

België
Bakker Belgium is strategisch partner van Delhaize. We leveren een groot deel van het verse groente-
en fruitassortiment aan de distributiecentra van de Belgische supermarktketen.

[ Klik hier voor ons adres ][38]
[Martijn Hendrikx - teler homepage]
Onze telers
Van zaadje tot product
Onze groenten en fruit halen we zo dichtbij als mogelijk en zo ver weg als nodig. We werken, vaak al
tientallen jaren, samen met vaste telers.
[ Lees meer over onze telers ][39]
[Werken bij - Nicole]
Citaat
‘Ik heb hier geleerd dat je veel meer kunt dan je denkt.’
Als trainee begin je vaak met meedraaien in de productie, als teamleider. Zo leer je de
basisprocessen van Bakker kennen, en snap je ook het effect van een besluit op een andere afdeling.
Eén dag per week werk je aan een project heel ergens anders in het bedrijf. Je wordt wel in het
diepe gegooid: we gaan je op die afdeling plaatsen, probeer het maar uit. Ik heb door die aanpak
geleerd dat je veel meer kunt dan je denkt.

Kirsty Summerbell MFHT 308


Bees can teach us to work with purpose, to rest when needed, to seek out what nourishes us, and to
remain connected to the world. Learn how to bring a little of their world into your life with our
bee-inspired aromatherapy blends.

[Read more ...][116]

### A Little More About Base Formula

At Base Formula, we supply aromatherapy products worldwide to therapists, natural health
enthusiasts, and people dipping their toes into the world of aromatherapy for the first time. We
specialise in premium grade essential oils, essential oil blends, massage oils, carrier oils,
hydrolats (hydrosols), aloe vera gels and aromatherapy skincare products.

As long standing members of the Aromatherapy Trade Council, all of our essential oils are subject to
random testing and verification at independent laboratories to ensure that they are of exceptional
quality.

Nature provides an abundance of natural ingredients that can be beneficial for the mind, body and
soul, and we are committed to using responsibly sourced, fair-trade, natural, vegan-friendly
ingredients wherever we can.

[READ MORE][117]

### Our Products - for Body, Mind & Soul

**[Essential Oils][118]**
Base Formula stocks only premium, therapeutic grade essential oils, organic oils, infusions,
dilutions and absolutes. We have an extensive range to choose from, including trusted favourites
such as Lavender and Tea Tree, through to more unusual oils such as Copaiba Balsam and Yuzu. All of
our essential oils are 100% pure and come uniquely batch numbered with country of origin detailed on
the label. Material data safety sheets and allergen listings are available on request.

**[Carrier Oils][119]**
We have a wide selection of premium quality carrier oils (also known as base oils) for aromatherapy
massage and natural skincare. Our 100% pure and natural carrier oils are rich in skin nurturing
vitamins, minerals and essential fatty acids, with no other additives, colours or preservatives.
Carrier oils that we supply include Sweet Almond carrier oil, Grapeseed oil, Argan oil, Rosehip Seed
oil, Jojoba and Coconut oil.

**[Hydrolats / Hydrosols][120]**
Hydrolats, also known as flower waters or floral waters, are the therapeutic waters collected when
pure essential oils are steam-distilled. Hydrolats are widely used for natural skincare. They have
similar powers to essential oils, although they are much gentler and can be applied directly to the
skin. We offer a range of hydrolats including Lavender, Chamomile, Rose Otto and Witch Hazel.

**[Cosmetic Bases][121] & [Aloe Vera Gels][122]**
Base Formula supplies a wide range of cosmetic bases for making your own aromatherapy products. From
ultra-hydrating aloe vera gels, through to moisturising lotions, creams, cleansers and bath and
shower bases, all of which make ideal carrying mediums for essential oils and other natural cosmetic
ingredients.

Bees can teach us to work with purpose, to rest when needed, to seek out what nourishes us, and to

[Read more ...][116]

### A Little More About Base Formula

At Base Formula, we supply aromatherapy products worldwide to therapists, natural health
enthusiasts, and people dipping their toes into the world of aromatherapy for the first time. We
specialise in premium grade essential oils, essential oil blends, massage oils, carrier oils,
hydrolats (hydrosols), aloe vera gels and aromatherapy skincare products.

As long standing members of the Aromatherapy Trade Council, all of our essential oils are subject to
random testing and verification at independent laboratories to ensure that they are of exceptional
quality.

Nature provides an abundance of natural ingredients that can be beneficial for the mind, body and
soul, and we are committed to using responsibly sourced, fair-trade, natural, vegan-friendly
ingredients wherever we can.

[READ MORE][117]

### Our Products - for Body, Mind & Soul

**[Essential Oils][118]**
Base Formula stocks only premium, therapeutic grade essential oils, organic oils, infusions,
dilutions and absolutes. We have an extensive range to choose from, including trusted favourites
such as Lavender and Tea Tree, through to more unusual oils such as Copaiba Balsam and Yuzu. All of
our essential oils are 100% pure and come uniquely batch numbered with country of origin detailed on
the label. Material data safety sheets and allergen listings are available on request.

**[Carrier Oils][119]**
We have a wide selection of premium quality carrier oils (also known as base oils) for aromatherapy
massage and natural skincare. Our 100% pure and natural carrier oils are rich in skin nurturing
vitamins, minerals and essential fatty acids, with no other additives, colours or preservatives.
Carrier oils that we supply include Sweet Almond carrier oil, Grapeseed oil, Argan oil, Rosehip Seed
oil, Jojoba and Coconut oil.

**[Hydrolats / Hydrosols][120]**
Hydrolats, also known as flower waters or floral waters, are the therapeutic waters collected when
pure essential oils are steam-distilled. Hydrolats are widely used for natural skincare. They have
similar powers to essential oils, although they are much gentler and can be applied directly to the
skin. We offer a range of hydrolats including Lavender, Chamomile, Rose Otto and Witch Hazel.

**[Cosmetic Bases][121] & [Aloe Vera Gels][122]**
Base Formula supplies a wide range of cosmetic bases for making your own aromatherapy products. From
ultra-hydrating aloe vera gels, through to moisturising lotions, creams, cleansers and bath and
shower bases, all of which make ideal carrying mediums for essential oils and other natural cosmetic
ingredients.

medical devices, nutraceuticals, vaccines, antiretroviral (ARV) therapies for HIV/AIDS, veterinary

healthcare markets across Nigeria and beyond.Established in September 1997, Tyonex Nigeria Limited

company is a respected member of the Pharmaceutical Manufacturing and Marketing Companies in Nigeria
and actively participates in several international trade and business organizations, including the

Chamber of Commerce. Through these affiliations, Tyonex continues to strengthen global partnerships
and expand access to quality healthcare products.The Group operates modern manufacturing facilities
in Lagos, Nigeria, dedicated to the production of both pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products.

manufacture a broad range of medicines and health supplements tailored to local and regional
healthcare needs.The Tyonex Group comprises several specialized companies that collectively drive
innovation, manufacturing excellence, and market expansion:Tyonex HealthcareDivine Essential
FormulationsTrinity Systems Nigeria LimitedTarcuma Nigeria LimitedOver the years, Tyonex has
distinguished itself through pioneering achievements in Nigeria's pharmaceutical sector. The company
was the first in the country to manufacture Tyonex Succimer, demonstrating its commitment to
introducing advanced therapeutic solutions to the local market. In addition, Tyonex remains the only
indigenous manufacturer of Vinpocetine 5mg (Cognitol Tablets), a cognitive enhancement medication

accessibility, Tyonex Nigeria Limited continues to play a vital role in strengthening Nigeria’s

Driving innovation, customer friendly solutions and service excellence


[Responsible procurement ][50]
* Our suppliers are specialists in their product, as well as ethical and sustainably minded, located
  as close to the source of the food as possible. We source both quality wholesale foods and a large
  range of catering equipment and non-food essentials.
* We are proud to say we take a sustainability-based approach to product sourcing, minimising the
  impact of our carbon footprint, whilst ensuring fair labour practices are at the forefront of all
  stages of our supply chain.
[Value-add processing ][51]
* Through listening to our customers, Bidfood has identified opportunities for value-add light
  processing and bespoke manufacture to make our customers' lives easier.
* Around the world we have our own purpose-built facilities offering additional value-add services,
  as directed by customer needs and market trends identified.
[Warehousing and distribution efficiencies ][52]
* We invest in depots and vehicles equipped with state-of-the-art efficient and sustainable
  capabilities. We utilise tools such as voice-pick technology and onboard-telematics in vehicles to
  ensure improved efficiencies and accuracies in service. Coupled with anti-error systems, we commit
  to reduced preparation error rates and overall improved working conditions for our workforce.
* Our fleet is equipped to simultaneously distribute products at positive and negative temperatures,
  with modular compartments equipping us to deliver to specific customer and product requirements.
[Market-leading innovation ][53]
* Our in-house developed ecommerce solution is a market-leading customer communication, transaction
  and information portal connecting us directly. Customers have online touch access to products
  offered by Bidfood divisions; real-time stock and pricing; product and sourcing information;
  planning and costing facilities, as well as intuitive complementary product suggestions.
* By using technology to deliver operational efficiency, implementing smart solutions faster through
  sharing of learning and ideas across our businesses, Bidfood is ahead of the pack. Continual
  upgrading, modernisation and simplification of our global IT infrastructure; from farm to fork.
[Customer service excellence ][54]
* Our mission is to deliver service excellence. Everything we do has the customer at heart, and is
  led by research and insights, be it into food trends to keep a step ahead of the curve, or the
  latest technological advances allowing us to continuously develop our service offering.
Each business is directly responsible for its product range, its buying and sales approach.
Businesses retain their local brand, tone of voice, look and feel. The cultural differences are
important to differentiate the regional locations. Each business operates as an autonomous, small,
local business.

[AUSTRALASIA ][55]

Australia and New Zealand offer customers the industry's most comprehensive range, wide market
coverage, economies of scale and one-stop solutions.

2026 07 01 - 2026 07 31 leidinys, kuriame ne tik geriausi pasiūlymai mūsų klientams, bet ir
