[ ][20]

## Azijos produktų katalogas

Jūsų patogumui sukūrėme naująjį Azijos produktų katalogą, kuriame rasite kruopščiai atrinktą
asortimentą nuo bambukinių lazdelių iki makaronų.
[Atsisiųsti][21]
[ ][22]

## Sous vide mėsos katalogas

Šiame asortimente rasite platų kiaulienos, jautienos, paukštienos ir kitų mėsos gaminių pasirinkimą:
vyniotiniai, elniena, triušiena ir ėriena.
[Atsisiųsti][23]
[ ][24]

## Street Food - greitas maistas

Pristatome Street Food - greito maisto produktų katalogą, kupiną įvairiausių skonių ir įkvepiančių
idėjų jūsų verslui.
[Atsisiųsti][25]
[ ][26]

## Kepinių katalogas

Katalogas, kuriame rasite visą duonų, bandelių, užkandžių krepšelių, saldžių ir pikantiškų gaminių,
pyragų bei tortų asortimentą.
[Atsisiųsti][27]
[ ][28]

## Atnaujinome ne maisto prekių asortimentą

Vienkartiniai indai, higienos prekės, maisto pakavimo prekės, valymo priemonės ir buitinė chemija,
anglys bei kitos pramoninės prekės.
[Atsisiųsti][29]

## Naujienos

## [Esame dėkingi, kad dalyvavote mūsų renginyje "Skonių vasara", 2026][30]

2026-02-25
Džiaugiamės galėdami pasidalinti praėjusio Bidfood „Skonių vasara 2026, Klaipėda“ renginio
akimirkomis. Čia atvykę klientai turėjo puikią galimybę pamatyti asortimento naujienas, akis į akį
pabendrauti su tiekėjais iš įvairių šalių, bei smagiai praleisti laiką.
[Skaitykite plačiau][31]

## [Draugiška aplinkai saulės energija!][32]

2025-07-02
Galimybė gauti paramą 40 000 € iš jungtinio projekto „Investicinė parama saulės elektrinėms
sausumoje“ pateikus paraišką Lietuvos energetikos agentūrai paskatino UAB Bidfood Lietuva suplanuoti
įsirengti 272 kW saulės elektrinę sausumoje.
[Skaitykite plačiau][33]

## [Akimirkos iš renginio "Skonių jūra", 2025][34]

2024-04-12
Keletas akimirkų iš mūsų didžiausio šių metų renginio "Skonių jūra" 2025, kuris vyko vasario 12d.,
Klaipėdos Švyturio arenoje. Renginyje ne tik degustavome produktus, tačiau bendravome su tiekėjais,
šefais ir dalinomės neįkainojamomis patirtimis bei žiniomis.
[Skaitykite plačiau][35]

## Apie mus

Lietuvoje dirbame jau 30 metų, todėl gerai suprantame klientų poreikius. Lyderiaujame šaldytų ir
atvėsintų produktų platintojų mažmeniniame, didmeniniame ir HoReCa sektoriuose.

Mūsų asortimente yra daugiau nei 2400 prekių pavadinimų. Jį nuolat plečiame, siekdami pateikti
klientams visus maisto produktus "iš vienų rankų". Turime nuosavą transporto parką, kas leidžia
operatyviai pristatyti prekes visame Pabaltijyje.

Mūsų produkcijos kokybė yra užtikrinama visose grandyse - nuo gamintojo iki kliento. Su dauguma
tiekėjų dirbame jau eilę metų. Siekiame pačių aukščiausių standartų visose mūsų darbo srityse.

[Sužinokite daugiau][36]

## Liepos mėnesio HoReCa leidinukas

2026 07 01 - 2026 07 31 leidinys, kuriame ne tik geriausi pasiūlymai mūsų klientams, bet ir
naujienos bei receptų idėjos!
[Atsisiųsti][19]
[ ][20]

## Azijos produktų katalogas

Jūsų patogumui sukūrėme naująjį Azijos produktų katalogą, kuriame rasite kruopščiai atrinktą
asortimentą nuo bambukinių lazdelių iki makaronų.
[Atsisiųsti][21]
[ ][22]

## Sous vide mėsos katalogas

Šiame asortimente rasite platų kiaulienos, jautienos, paukštienos ir kitų mėsos gaminių pasirinkimą:
vyniotiniai, elniena, triušiena ir ėriena.
[Atsisiųsti][23]
[ ][24]

## Street Food - greitas maistas

Pristatome Street Food - greito maisto produktų katalogą, kupiną įvairiausių skonių ir įkvepiančių
idėjų jūsų verslui.
[Atsisiųsti][25]
[ ][26]

## Kepinių katalogas

Katalogas, kuriame rasite visą duonų, bandelių, užkandžių krepšelių, saldžių ir pikantiškų gaminių,
pyragų bei tortų asortimentą.
[Atsisiųsti][27]
[ ][28]

## Atnaujinome ne maisto prekių asortimentą

Vienkartiniai indai, higienos prekės, maisto pakavimo prekės, valymo priemonės ir buitinė chemija,
anglys bei kitos pramoninės prekės.
[Atsisiųsti][29]

## Naujienos

## [Esame dėkingi, kad dalyvavote mūsų renginyje "Skonių vasara", 2026][30]

2026-02-25
Džiaugiamės galėdami pasidalinti praėjusio Bidfood „Skonių vasara 2026, Klaipėda“ renginio
akimirkomis. Čia atvykę klientai turėjo puikią galimybę pamatyti asortimento naujienas, akis į akį
pabendrauti su tiekėjais iš įvairių šalių, bei smagiai praleisti laiką.
[Skaitykite plačiau][31]

## [Draugiška aplinkai saulės energija!][32]

2025-07-02
Galimybė gauti paramą 40 000 € iš jungtinio projekto „Investicinė parama saulės elektrinėms
sausumoje“ pateikus paraišką Lietuvos energetikos agentūrai paskatino UAB Bidfood Lietuva suplanuoti
įsirengti 272 kW saulės elektrinę sausumoje.
[Skaitykite plačiau][33]

## [Akimirkos iš renginio "Skonių jūra", 2025][34]

2024-04-12
Keletas akimirkų iš mūsų didžiausio šių metų renginio "Skonių jūra" 2025, kuris vyko vasario 12d.,
Klaipėdos Švyturio arenoje. Renginyje ne tik degustavome produktus, tačiau bendravome su tiekėjais,
šefais ir dalinomės neįkainojamomis patirtimis bei žiniomis.
[Skaitykite plačiau][35]

## Apie mus

Lietuvoje dirbame jau 30 metų, todėl gerai suprantame klientų poreikius. Lyderiaujame šaldytų ir
atvėsintų produktų platintojų mažmeniniame, didmeniniame ir HoReCa sektoriuose.

Mūsų asortimente yra daugiau nei 2400 prekių pavadinimų. Jį nuolat plečiame, siekdami pateikti
klientams visus maisto produktus "iš vienų rankų". Turime nuosavą transporto parką, kas leidžia
operatyviai pristatyti prekes visame Pabaltijyje.

Mūsų produkcijos kokybė yra užtikrinama visose grandyse - nuo gamintojo iki kliento. Su dauguma
tiekėjų dirbame jau eilę metų. Siekiame pačių aukščiausių standartų visose mūsų darbo srityse.

[Sužinokite daugiau][36]

# Váš výrobce a **distributor potravin**

#### Stojíme po Vašem boku v podnikání.
#### Dodáváme čerstvé, mražené i trvanlivé potraviny, které přivezeme až k Vašim dveřím. Nabízíme
#### jednoduché způsoby objednávání. Jsme tu pro všechny, kdo chtějí mít jistotu kvality,
#### spolehlivého servisu a osobního přístupu.
* [Pomůžeme s podnikáním]
  
  ### Pomůžeme Vám s podnikáním
  
  Náš prodejní tým je připraven pomoci Vám s výběrem sortimentu, přinášet inspiraci a podpořit růst
  Vašeho podnikání. Jsme Vaší každodenní oporou – od řízení zásob a zvládání provozních starostí až
  po zavádění nových trendů a technologií.
* [Nákladní auto Bidfood ikona]
  
  ### Zboží Vám přivezeme
  
  Čerstvé, mražené i trvanlivé potraviny doručíme rychle a spolehlivě po celé České republice – až
  šestkrát týdně. Díky moderní flotile aut s oddělenými teplotními zónami k Vám vše dorazí najednou
  a v perfektní kvalitě.
* [Zboží Bidfood ikona]
  
  ### Osvědčené produkty
  
  Nabízíme široký sortiment od cenově výhodných produktů až po prémiové delikatesy. Kombinujeme
  vlastní výrobu, regionální dodavatele i světové značky, abyste měli možnost výběru přesně podle
  svých potřeb. 
* [Objednání]
  
  ### Jednoduché objednání
  
  Nakupovat u nás je snadné – objednávat můžete prostřednictvím obchodního zástupce, zákaznického
  centra, e‑shopu nebo mobilní aplikace. Vždy rychle, přehledně a s podporou, na kterou se můžete
  spolehnout.

# Váš výrobce a **distributor potravin**

#### Stojíme po Vašem boku v podnikání.
#### Dodáváme čerstvé, mražené i trvanlivé potraviny, které přivezeme až k Vašim dveřím. Nabízíme
#### jednoduché způsoby objednávání. Jsme tu pro všechny, kdo chtějí mít jistotu kvality,
#### spolehlivého servisu a osobního přístupu.
* [Pomůžeme s podnikáním]
  
  ### Pomůžeme Vám s podnikáním
  
  Náš prodejní tým je připraven pomoci Vám s výběrem sortimentu, přinášet inspiraci a podpořit růst
  Vašeho podnikání. Jsme Vaší každodenní oporou – od řízení zásob a zvládání provozních starostí až
  po zavádění nových trendů a technologií.
* [Nákladní auto Bidfood ikona]
  
  ### Zboží Vám přivezeme
  
  Čerstvé, mražené i trvanlivé potraviny doručíme rychle a spolehlivě po celé České republice – až
  šestkrát týdně. Díky moderní flotile aut s oddělenými teplotními zónami k Vám vše dorazí najednou
  a v perfektní kvalitě.
* [Zboží Bidfood ikona]
  
  ### Osvědčené produkty
  
  Nabízíme široký sortiment od cenově výhodných produktů až po prémiové delikatesy. Kombinujeme
  vlastní výrobu, regionální dodavatele i světové značky, abyste měli možnost výběru přesně podle
  svých potřeb. 
* [Objednání]
  
  ### Jednoduché objednání
  
  Nakupovat u nás je snadné – objednávat můžete prostřednictvím obchodního zástupce, zákaznického
  centra, e‑shopu nebo mobilní aplikace. Vždy rychle, přehledně a s podporou, na kterou se můžete
  spolehnout.

## Welcome to BioProGreen

### Natural beauty and argan oil—made simple

Welcome to BioProGreen – We believe true beauty begins with nature. Here you’ll find inspiring
stories, science-aware tips, and easy rituals around natural care—especially Morocco’s treasure:
[argan oil][40]. Our goal is clarity. Every guide is short, practical, and friendly—so you can build
a routine that fits your day and your skin. Step-by-step routines for face, body, and hair. Argan
oil basics: sourcing, storage, and usage. Moroccan staples: black soap, ghassoul clay, and rose
water. Simple ingredient explainers with safety notes.

## FAQ — Natural Beauty and Argan Oil

Quick answers to the most asked questions. If you need more help, reach us anytime.

How do I start a simple natural beauty and argan oil routine?

Cleanse, then apply 2–3 drops of argan oil on damp skin. Seal with your cream. For hair, smooth 1–2
drops on the ends.

How can I patch test new products safely?

Apply a small amount to the inner forearm for 24–48 hours. If redness or itching appears, stop using
the product.

What’s the best way to store oils?

Keep bottles closed, away from heat and light. Use within the recommended period after opening.

Where can I read more guides?

Visit our [Guides][45] and [Argan Oil][46] sections for step-by-step articles.

Still have questions? [Contact us][47].

How do I start a simple natural beauty and argan oil routine?

Cleanse, then apply 2–3 drops of argan oil on damp skin. Seal with your cream. For hair, smooth 1–2
drops on the ends.

How can I patch test new products safely?

Apply a small amount to the inner forearm for 24–48 hours. If redness or itching appears, stop using
the product.

What’s the best way to store oils?

Keep bottles closed, away from heat and light. Use within the recommended period after opening.

A Journey Through Time

## The Perfumer's *Journey*

1400 saal purani riwayat — aaj Bio Shop™ ke haath mein

🕌
7th Century

### Ancient Arabia

Oud, Musk aur Attar — Islam ki roshan sehron mein janam liya. Khulafa-e-Rashideen ke daur mein
khushbu ko ibadat ka hissa samjha gaya. Damas aur Baghdad ke bazaaron mein attar-faroosh apni khaas
botalein sajate the.

🌹 Oud 🕌 Attar 🌿 Musk
"Al-Tibb wal-'Itr" — Medicine & Fragrance were one.
👑
16th–19th Century

### Mughal Era

Mughal Shehzadiyon ne rose water distillation ijaad ki. Nur Jahan ne gulab se attar nikala — duniya
ka pehla essential oil. Lahore, Agra aur Delhi ke darbar mein khushbu ek royal art thi.

🌸 Rose Attar 💧 Distillation 🏰 Royal Craft
"Nur Jahan's rose distillation — the world's first essential oil."
🇵🇰
20th Century

### Modern Pakistan

Pakistan bana — aur Lahore, Karachi ke bazaaron mein attar-farooshi zinda rahi. Local perfumers ne
indigenous roses, kewra aur henna se apni fragrance identity banayi. DIY culture dheere dheere utha.

🌺 Kewra 🌿 Henna 🏙️ Lahore
"Pakistan ki apni khushbu — apni pehchaan."
🔬
21st Century

### The DIY Revolution

Digital era ne sab badal diya. Pakistani formulators ne global fragrance knowledge tak rasa'i pa'i.
Home-based perfumers, skincare brands aur aroma chemists ne ek naya industry khada kiya. Pure
ingredients ki zaroorat thi — aur demand barhi.

💻 Digital 🧴 Skincare ⚗️ DIY
"Har ghar ek lab ban gaya."
✨
Today

### Bio Shop™ — The Legacy Continues

Is poori riwayat ka ek maqsad tha — Pakistan mein pure, lab-tested, cosmetic-grade ingredients har
formulator tak pahunchana. Bio Shop™ ne yeh mission uthaya — 1500+ ingredients, COA verification aur
aik trusted brand jo is journey ka aaj ka pehredar hai.

🌿 1500+ Ingredients 🔬 Lab Tested 📜 COA Verified 🇵🇰 Made for Pakistan

## The Perfumer's *Journey*

7th Century

### Ancient Arabia

Oud, Musk aur Attar — Islam ki roshan sehron mein janam liya. Khulafa-e-Rashideen ke daur mein
khushbu ko ibadat ka hissa samjha gaya. Damas aur Baghdad ke bazaaron mein attar-faroosh apni khaas
botalein sajate the.

🌹 Oud 🕌 Attar 🌿 Musk
"Al-Tibb wal-'Itr" — Medicine & Fragrance were one.
👑
16th–19th Century

### Mughal Era

Mughal Shehzadiyon ne rose water distillation ijaad ki. Nur Jahan ne gulab se attar nikala — duniya
ka pehla essential oil. Lahore, Agra aur Delhi ke darbar mein khushbu ek royal art thi.

🌸 Rose Attar 💧 Distillation 🏰 Royal Craft
"Nur Jahan's rose distillation — the world's first essential oil."
🇵🇰
20th Century

### Modern Pakistan

Pakistan bana — aur Lahore, Karachi ke bazaaron mein attar-farooshi zinda rahi. Local perfumers ne
indigenous roses, kewra aur henna se apni fragrance identity banayi. DIY culture dheere dheere utha.

🌺 Kewra 🌿 Henna 🏙️ Lahore
"Pakistan ki apni khushbu — apni pehchaan."
🔬
21st Century

### The DIY Revolution

Digital era ne sab badal diya. Pakistani formulators ne global fragrance knowledge tak rasa'i pa'i.
Home-based perfumers, skincare brands aur aroma chemists ne ek naya industry khada kiya. Pure
ingredients ki zaroorat thi — aur demand barhi.

💻 Digital 🧴 Skincare ⚗️ DIY
"Har ghar ek lab ban gaya."

formulator tak pahunchana. Bio Shop™ ne yeh mission uthaya — 1500+ ingredients, COA verification aur

zajmujemy się od 30 lat!

### **We help you protect & enhance your reputation**
### 
### Safely manage your risks associated with food & product consumption
### 

Food safety and efficient cold chain management directly impact your business success, reputation,
profitability, and most importantly, the health and satisfaction of your patrons. Join other
businesses owners, chefs, restaurateurs, managers, and other decision-makers who call us their
preferred supplier.

At Bidfood, we engage with reputable supply partners, we continuously maintain and update food
safety and religious certifications, we ensure products are packed and labelled correctly to comply
with local regulations, and we engage with our suppliers to resolve complaints. Customers and
suppliers can rest assured that where necessary, products can be promptly recalled, mitigating
consumer hazards.

We know that management of the cold chain is critical to customer satisfaction, and product safety
and quality guarantees.

### Collaborations

#### Working with some of the voices that help shape South African foodservice

We work closely with leading industry platforms, events and associations to stay connected to what
matters most in foodservice.
By collaborating with trusted brands and industry voices, we strengthen our ability to add value
beyond supply, keeping our customers informed, inspired and ahead of the curve.

### **We help you protect & enhance your reputation**
### 
### Safely manage your risks associated with food & product consumption
### 

Food safety and efficient cold chain management directly impact your business success, reputation,
profitability, and most importantly, the health and satisfaction of your patrons. Join other
businesses owners, chefs, restaurateurs, managers, and other decision-makers who call us their
preferred supplier.

At Bidfood, we engage with reputable supply partners, we continuously maintain and update food
safety and religious certifications, we ensure products are packed and labelled correctly to comply
with local regulations, and we engage with our suppliers to resolve complaints. Customers and
suppliers can rest assured that where necessary, products can be promptly recalled, mitigating
consumer hazards.

We know that management of the cold chain is critical to customer satisfaction, and product safety
and quality guarantees.

### Collaborations

#### Working with some of the voices that help shape South African foodservice

We work closely with leading industry platforms, events and associations to stay connected to what
matters most in foodservice.
By collaborating with trusted brands and industry voices, we strengthen our ability to add value
beyond supply, keeping our customers informed, inspired and ahead of the curve.

Bidfood is a leading broad line supplier of frozen, chilled, ambient grocery and allied products to
the foodservice and hospitality industry. We're passionate about foodservice and believe that we add
value to your business by offering a wide range of products, complemented by simplified order and
delivery solutions. We can help you to make money, save time and enhance your efficiencies.

Our attention to food safety standards help to protect and enhance your reputation.

### Wholesale food, inspired by you

One of the UK’s leading foodservice providers we share our customers passion for great food,
supplying more than 10,000 frozen ambient and chilled products to over 45,000 caterers and food
service businesses around the UK.

With 26 sites spanning the UK, we provide a truly local presence, in terms of service, product,
employment and community engagement. We offer specialist support within 12 sectors, whether you’re a
small or large chain of pubs, care homes or coffee shops we’re here to bring you all the right
ingredients and support, so that you can create your magic.

# From Kenya's Finest Orchards to Your Table

Experience the pure essence of premium avocado oil, cold-pressed from sustainably sourced avocados
and crafted with generations of farming expertise.

## Why Choose Brentwood Avo

Expertise in sustainable avocado farming and oil production, delivering premium quality to
discerning global markets.

[Full Traceability]

### Full Traceability

Track your oil from specific orchards to your facility with complete transparency and documentation.

[Cold-Press Excellence]

### Cold-Press Excellence

Our mechanical extraction preserves nutrients and flavor without heat or chemical processing.

[Certified Quality]

### Certified Quality

International certifications ensure consistent quality and safety standards for global markets.

## Trusted Certifications

Our commitment to quality is backed by international certifications and rigorous standards.

[EU Organic]

### EU Organic

EU Organic Certification

[AFA]

### AFA

AFA Certification

## Growing Together

Our success is rooted in sustainable partnerships with local farmers, creating positive impact
across Kenyan communities.

700+
Partner Farmers
Supporting local communities
60%
Women-Led Farms
Empowering female farmers
100%
Sustainable Practices
Environmentally responsible

### Meet Our Farmers

#### Our Farmer Network

We work directly with smallholder farmers across Kenya's prime avocado-growing regions and
neighboring countries. Our network spans multiple counties and countries, bringing together
dedicated growers who share our commitment to quality and sustainable practices.

700+

##### Partner Farmers

Smallholder farmers across East Africa

5+

##### Sourcing Regions

Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Burundi, Rwanda

100%

##### Sustainable Practices

Organic farming and fair trade principles

### Farmer Network Map

Click on markers to see farmer details and locations

Loading map...
East Africa Network
700+ Partner Farmers
Kenya
Uganda
Tanzania
Rwanda
[Explore Our Impact][7]

## Our Process

From orchard to export, every step is carefully controlled to deliver the highest quality avocado
oil to global markets.

1

### Selection

Hand-picked premium avocados from certified organic farms

Only the finest, fully ripened avocados make it to our processing facility

2

### Cold Press

Mechanical extraction without heat or chemicals

Our cold-press method preserves all natural nutrients and flavor compounds

3

### Quality Assurance

Rigorous testing for purity, acidity, and nutritional content

Every batch undergoes comprehensive laboratory analysis and certification

4

### Packaging

Filled into Flexi Tanks for bulk crude avocado oil export

Flexi Tanks are fitted into standard 20ft containers, offering a cost-effective and hygienic
solution for transporting large volumes of crude avocado oil

5

### Export

Global distribution with full traceability documentation

Temperature-controlled logistics ensure product integrity from Kenya to your facility

### Quality Guarantee

Every batch comes with complete documentation including certificates of analysis, traceability
records, and quality assurance reports.

## Trusted by Leading Brands Worldwide

Building partnerships with industry leaders who value quality and sustainability.

# Essential Oils & Specialty Ingredients

Since our inception in 2010, Bulk Apothecary has quickly expanded to become the nation’s leading
supplier of soap making supplies and specialty ingredients. Our meteoric rise is directly related to
our strong focus on superior quality and excellent customer service. This commitment has allowed
us to build relationships with millions of customers that trust us as their source for premium
fragrance oils, certified organic essential oils, and other soap supplies.  In addition to a
complete line of specialty ingredients, we have also expanded our offering with a complete line of
ready to private label products including bath bombs, cold process soaps, candles, and personal care
products.  Lastly, we have leveraged our economies of scale to introduce wholesale products and
fragrances from some of the world's best-known brands.

## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

## We Are The Premier Agribusiness Solutions Company Built for the 21st Century


For generations, Bunge has nourished the world. Now, we’re redefining what’s possible. We have
evolved, transformed, and grown, building an irreplaceable global footprint and a team dedicated to
connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. With our
agile workforce, global footprint, increased access to markets, and agriculture network covering all
major crops, Bunge navigates seasonal cycles, weather, and other risks. We partner with farmers,
supply plant-based oils and proteins for food, provide essential animal feed ingredients, and
champion low-carbon feedstocks for renewable fuel.

**Our mission: sensory-safe aromatherapy, made with integrity.**

At Burnt Orchid Organics™, we create 100% natural aromatherapy products and offer personalised 1:1
consultations — all guided by our proprietary SOFT™ Framework. Every blend is formulated without
synthetic fragrance, specifically for neurodivergent individuals, sensory-sensitive nervous systems,
and the carers who support them. Whether you're shopping for yourself or seeking expert guidance,
we're here to help you find what works.

[ Shop for Me ][82]

#### Neurodivergent Adults

Sensory-safe blends to support your nervous system, sleep, focus and emotional regulation.

[ Shop for My Child ][83]

#### Parents of Neurodivergent Children

Gentle, family-safe aromatherapy to support bedtime, anxious feelings and sensory sensitivity.

[ Shop for Us ][84]

#### Carers

Tools to support your wellbeing and the person you care for — safe for the whole household.

[ For Practitioners ][85]

#### Healthcare Practitioners

Professional-grade aromatherapy for clinical practice — safe, effective blends to support your
clients.

#### Ingredient Sourcing

We source 100% natural botanicals — pure essential oils, cold-pressed carrier oils, and dried herbs
— from trusted UK and European suppliers. No synthetic fragrance, no fillers.

#### Formulation Standards

Every blend is developed using the SOFT Framework™, our proprietary method for creating sensory-safe
formulations. We test for skin safety, scent intensity, and neurodivergent suitability before
anything reaches you.

#### Therapeutic Benefits

Our blends are crafted to support real outcomes — calmer sleep, reduced anxious feelings, improved
focus, and emotional regulation — using botanicals with established therapeutic properties.

**Our mission: sensory-safe aromatherapy, made with integrity.**

At Burnt Orchid Organics™, we create 100% natural aromatherapy products and offer personalised 1:1
consultations — all guided by our proprietary SOFT™ Framework. Every blend is formulated without
synthetic fragrance, specifically for neurodivergent individuals, sensory-sensitive nervous systems,
and the carers who support them. Whether you're shopping for yourself or seeking expert guidance,
we're here to help you find what works.

[ Shop for Me ][82]

#### Neurodivergent Adults

Sensory-safe blends to support your nervous system, sleep, focus and emotional regulation.

[ Shop for My Child ][83]

#### Parents of Neurodivergent Children

Gentle, family-safe aromatherapy to support bedtime, anxious feelings and sensory sensitivity.

[ Shop for Us ][84]

#### Carers

Tools to support your wellbeing and the person you care for — safe for the whole household.

[ For Practitioners ][85]

#### Healthcare Practitioners

Professional-grade aromatherapy for clinical practice — safe, effective blends to support your
clients.

#### Ingredient Sourcing

We source 100% natural botanicals — pure essential oils, cold-pressed carrier oils, and dried herbs
— from trusted UK and European suppliers. No synthetic fragrance, no fillers.

#### Formulation Standards

Every blend is developed using the SOFT Framework™, our proprietary method for creating sensory-safe
formulations. We test for skin safety, scent intensity, and neurodivergent suitability before
anything reaches you.

#### Therapeutic Benefits

Our blends are crafted to support real outcomes — calmer sleep, reduced anxious feelings, improved
focus, and emotional regulation — using botanicals with established therapeutic properties.

# New England’s trusted partner for food and everyday essentials.

## Family-run. Community-driven. Here for New England’s retailers.

## For over 80 years, Bozzuto’s has helped independent retailers from Maine to Maryland with
## reliable distribution, transportation, and hands-on support—delivered with the care you expect
## from a family-run company.

## Where Service Meets Scale

### Our Business

Bozzuto’s Inc. is a family-owned wholesale distributor of food and household products, established
in 1945 and based in Cheshire, Connecticut. We help independently owned retailers stay competitive
with consistent delivery, comprehensive selection, and in-house support teams.

[About Us][30]

## The Hometown Foundation

### Our Philanthropy

Our community work is powered through The Hometown Foundation, a nonprofit established in 2002.
Together with our family of retailers and community partners, the Foundation supports programs that
strengthen local communities year-round.

[Bozzuto’s in the Community][31]

seasonal, and private label — all delivered reliably.

# Creating a *more*
# *food secure* world

Our planet’s population is growing rapidly — and so is the need for more food. Already, 800 million
people go to bed hungry each night. As a food company to the world, Cargill is partnering with
farmers and customers to grow and produce more food with less impact, to move that food to store
shelves and family tables, and to nourish people for a more food secure world.

[Watch the video][52]

**GROW**

### [Meet the farmers building our food-secure world][53]

**MOVE**

### [Advancing decarbonization across the food supply chain][54]

**NOURISH**

### [Discover how we’re building resilient food systems][55]

## 2025 Annual Report

#### Connecting a food secure world

The food you eat has a story to tell. Because before you take that first bite, a global network of
hard-working people – spanning countries, cultures and skillsets – each did their part to grow, make
and move your meal from where it was grown to the fork in your hand. At Cargill, it’s our privilege
to facilitate the complex connections that make it all happen.

In Cargill’s 2025 Annual Report, we share how we’re strengthening ties between farmers, frontline
food workers and the customers we exist to serve. Learn how our collective efforts are helping
transform food and agriculture and connect a food secure world.

[Read the Report][56]

[2025 annual report feature image]

 

 

[2025 Impact report feature image]

## 2025 Impact Report

#### Building a more resilient food system

As a company that sits at the center of the global food system, Cargill plays a unique role in
connecting farmers, food producers, and consumers. This vantage point makes it clear that the future
of food depends on a system that is productive, sustainable, and resilient.

In Cargill’s 2025 Impact Report, we share how our strategy reflects this interconnected view — how
growing food impacts natural resources; how it moves from where it’s grown; and how we partner to
expand access to nutrition, improve farmer and community livelihoods, and accelerate our customers’
progress on sustainability.

Together, we’re working to build a stronger, more sustainable food system that can nourish the world
for generations to come.

[Read the Report][57]

 

 

## Our purpose

#### To nourish the world in a safe, responsible and sustainable way

Sitting at the heart of the global supply chain, we join farmers, ranchers, manufacturers,
foodservice customers and retailers in sourcing, making and delivering products that are vital for
living.

Every day, our 155K+ team members come to work:
* Driven to improve lives through food, nutrition and health
* Looking for ways to innovate with purpose
* Committed to nourishing our growing world by providing access to life’s essentials

This is how we create new opportunities for our customers to grow, communities to prosper and
consumers to live well.

[Read about Cargill][58]

[Our purpose]

 

 

 

 

## People

 

With 155K+ colleagues in 70 countries, we work as a global network to bring together the people,
ideas and resources that can nourish lives around the world.

[Careers][59]

## Products

 

Partnering across the supply chain, we bring food, ingredients, agricultural solutions and
industrial products to meet customers’ ever-evolving needs.

[Products & Services][60]

## Planet

 

From small family farms to global shipping lanes, we work every day to bring new sustainable
practices, reduce our impact on the planet and take care of people.

[Sustainability][61]

## Our Process

From orchard to export, every step is carefully controlled to deliver the highest quality avocado
oil to global markets.

1

### Selection

Hand-picked premium avocados from certified organic farms

Only the finest, fully ripened avocados make it to our processing facility

2

### Cold Press

Mechanical extraction without heat or chemicals

Our cold-press method preserves all natural nutrients and flavor compounds

3

### Quality Assurance

Rigorous testing for purity, acidity, and nutritional content

Every batch undergoes comprehensive laboratory analysis and certification

4

### Packaging

Filled into Flexi Tanks for bulk crude avocado oil export

Flexi Tanks are fitted into standard 20ft containers, offering a cost-effective and hygienic
solution for transporting large volumes of crude avocado oil

5

### Export

Global distribution with full traceability documentation

Temperature-controlled logistics ensure product integrity from Kenya to your facility

# Authenticity in Every Drop

Catania Oils is the trusted supplier of plant-based oils for every scale of business. From authentic
olive and vegetable oils to avocado and specialty blends, we pair proven quality with responsive
service, market insight, and packaging that fits your operation.
[Discover Our Legacy][70] [Explore Product Catalog][71]
[olive branch lineart light green cropped]

## Our Oils

Oil isn’t a side category, it’s our entire craft. With over 125 years of expertise, we source
globally, test every batch in-house, and deliver with full documentation. Whether our oils carry
your private label or become a core ingredient in your creation, you can trust us to protect your
brand with quality, consistency, and care.

Olive Oils

Olive oil is where our story began, and it remains at the heart of what we do. From Extra Virgin to
Light Tasting and Pomace, our portfolio delivers dependable flavor, heat performance, and
versatility for retail, foodservice, and private label programs.

[See Olive Oils][72] [Product Catalog][73]
Olive Oil Blends

Our blends balance olive flavor with dependable high-heat performance. We pair EVOO, olive oil, or
pomace with vegetable or sunflower oils to create flexible options for cooking and custom
formulations. Choose from trusted ratios or request a blend tailored to your goals.

[See Blends][74] [Product Catalog][75]
Vegetable Oils

For teams that need consistency at scale, our soybean, canola, corn, and sunflower oils support
frying, baking, and blending with ease. Many options are organic or Non-GMO Project Verified, and
every choice is backed by rigorous quality testing.

[See Vegetable Oils][76] [Product Catalog][77]
Tropical Oils

From baked snacks to plant-based spreads to wellness and skincare products, our coconut oils and
RSPO-certified palm oils deliver the texture, stability, and clean-label attributes makers rely on.
Available in organic, RBD, kernel, and shortening options.

[See Tropical Oils][78] [Product Catalog][79]
Specialty Oils

Avocado, a customer favorite, plus almond, grapeseed, jojoba, and more. Our specialty oils support
distinctive flavors, clean-label formulations, and culinary or personal care innovation, sourced
from trusted global partners and verified for quality in our own lab.

[See Specialty Oils][80] [Product Catalog][81]
Fry Oils

Engineered for busy kitchens that run hot and fast, our fry oils include high oleic, non-GMO, and
purpose-built blends designed for long fry life and crisp results. Trusted by independents, QSRs,
national chains, and leading food manufacturers for performance that stays consistent across
locations and production lines.

[See Fry Oils][82] [Product Catalog][83]
Popcorn Oils

U-POP and U-TOP streamline concession workflows. Liquid at room temperature with no melting or
refrigeration needed, they deliver natural golden

brand with quality, consistency, and care.

Help Make Organic the Norm!

# CCOF - California Certified Organic Farmers

CCOF is a nonprofit organization that advances organic agriculture for a healthy world through
organic certification, education, advocacy, and promotion. We envision a world where organic is the
norm.

[ Get Certified ][171] [ Donate ][172]

From field to fork, we're growing a future where organic is the norm.

## Supporting Organic Professionals

## Getting Started

We are your partner as you navigate the complicated world of organic certification.

[ Get Certified ][173]

## Staying Certified

Use our Resource Library, MyCCOF portal, videos, podcasts, and more.

[ Resources ][174]

## Advocating for You

We keep you in the loop on policy updates and represent organic producers at the state and national
levels.

[ Advocacy ][175]

## Grants

The CCOF Foundation offers financial support for students, farmers transitioning to organic, and
producers facing hardship.

[ Grants ][176]

## Interested in going organic?

### Join our free weekly Organic Office Hours to learn everything about transitioning to organic,
### staying in compliance & more. All questions & experience levels welcome!

[ Learn More! ][177]

## Why Organic?

Organic creates jobs, sequesters carbon, keeps water clean, and reduces our exposure to toxic
pesticides. Learn about the economic, social, and environmental benefits of organic.

[ The science behind organic ][178] [ What is organic? ][179]
Paicines Ranch Soil by Liz Birnbaum at the Curated Feast

## Our organic community

From grocery shoppers to farmers and retailers, organic offers benefits to everyone.

## Directory

Use our interactive listing of over 4,000 California Certified Organic Farmers certified organic
producers and handlers.

[ Directory ][180]

## Organic News

Stay up-to-date with the top organic news.

[ News ][181]

## Understanding Organic Labels

Learn how to find the foods and products you can trust.

[ How to Read Labels ][182]

## USDA Organic Certification - How it Works

Achieving USDA organic certification shouldn't be intimidating or confusing. In this video, CCOF
walks you through the organic certification process, how to apply, what to expect, and how we
support you from start to finish. CCOF has helped people like you get organic certified for over 50
years!

Help Make Organic the Norm!

# CCOF - California Certified Organic Farmers

CCOF is a nonprofit organization that advances organic agriculture for a healthy world through
organic certification, education, advocacy, and promotion. We envision a world where organic is the
norm.

[ Get Certified ][171] [ Donate ][172]

From field to fork, we're growing a future where organic is the norm.

## Supporting Organic Professionals

## Getting Started

We are your partner as you navigate the complicated world of organic certification.

[ Get Certified ][173]

## Staying Certified

Use our Resource Library, MyCCOF portal, videos, podcasts, and more.

[ Resources ][174]

## Advocating for You

We keep you in the loop on policy updates and represent organic producers at the state and national
levels.

[ Advocacy ][175]

## Grants

The CCOF Foundation offers financial support for students, farmers transitioning to organic, and
producers facing hardship.

[ Grants ][176]

## Interested in going organic?

### Join our free weekly Organic Office Hours to learn everything about transitioning to organic,
### staying in compliance & more. All questions & experience levels welcome!

[ Learn More! ][177]

## Why Organic?

Organic creates jobs, sequesters carbon, keeps water clean, and reduces our exposure to toxic
pesticides. Learn about the economic, social, and environmental benefits of organic.

[ The science behind organic ][178] [ What is organic? ][179]
Paicines Ranch Soil by Liz Birnbaum at the Curated Feast

## Our organic community

From grocery shoppers to farmers and retailers, organic offers benefits to everyone.

## Directory

Use our interactive listing of over 4,000 California Certified Organic Farmers certified organic
producers and handlers.

[ Directory ][180]

## Organic News

Stay up-to-date with the top organic news.

[ News ][181]

## Understanding Organic Labels

Learn how to find the foods and products you can trust.

[ How to Read Labels ][182]

## USDA Organic Certification - How it Works

Achieving USDA organic certification shouldn't be intimidating or confusing. In this video, CCOF
walks you through the organic certification process, how to apply, what to expect, and how we
support you from start to finish. CCOF has helped people like you get organic certified for over 50
years!

# Rapid analysis of food and beverages with CDR FOODLAB®

## Your ideal partner for reliability and ease of use

CDR FOODLAB® is a line of chemical analysis systems for quality control of foods and beverages. For
use in the laboratory or on the production line, even without the need for specialised personnel.

[Sistema di analisi Foodlab]
[Discover products][9]Watch the video

## What can you analyse?

You will be able to perform analysis of several samples at the same time and carry out a wide range
of determinations of many foods and beverages with the same reliability as traditional methods.

‌


‌


‌


Do you need something different?Write us hereWe are glad to help

[image][image]

## Simple and fast

The innovation carried out by CDR research laboratories has enabled us to speed up and simplify
analysis procedures. We have made sample preparation absent or very simple. 
The reagents in our systems are pre-filled into vials and ready to use. The result is obtained by a
simple photometric reading.

In addition, thanks to Multitasking Mode, analysis times can be significantly reduced.

## New methods, same reliability

The analytical methods developed by CDR research laboratories are optimised for reliable results.
Like those obtained by traditional methods, but simpler and faster. The photometric technology used
makes CDR FoodLab® systems highly sensitive instruments with a very wide measuring range, which
ensures excellent repeatability of the analysis results.

[image][image]

## Continuously Evolving

The company operates as a workshop of innovation and development that, thanks to a continuous
research process, creates products and systems that meet the needs of rapidly changing markets.

[image][image]
[image][image]
[image][image]

## An investment over time

Saving time and resources

With a single analysis system, the main analyses for quality and process control can be carried out
quickly and easily, even without the intervention of chemically skilled operators. No calibration or
periodic checks are necessary: the analysers are supplied pre-calibrated and ready to use.

[image][image]

### Would you like to purchase a CDR FoodLab® analysis system?

Our network of specialists will guide you in the choice of the most suitable system for your needs
and will offer you continuous and timely support after purchase.

# Rapid analysis of food and beverages with CDR FOODLAB®

## Your ideal partner for reliability and ease of use

CDR FOODLAB® is a line of chemical analysis systems for quality control of foods and beverages. For
use in the laboratory or on the production line, even without the need for specialised personnel.

[Sistema di analisi Foodlab]
[Discover products][9]Watch the video

## What can you analyse?

You will be able to perform analysis of several samples at the same time and carry out a wide range
of determinations of many foods and beverages with the same reliability as traditional methods.

‌


‌


‌


Do you need something different?Write us hereWe are glad to help

[image][image]

## Simple and fast

The innovation carried out by CDR research laboratories has enabled us to speed up and simplify
analysis procedures. We have made sample preparation absent or very simple. 
The reagents in our systems are pre-filled into vials and ready to use. The result is obtained by a
simple photometric reading.

In addition, thanks to Multitasking Mode, analysis times can be significantly reduced.

## New methods, same reliability

The analytical methods developed by CDR research laboratories are optimised for reliable results.
Like those obtained by traditional methods, but simpler and faster. The photometric technology used
makes CDR FoodLab® systems highly sensitive instruments with a very wide measuring range, which
ensures excellent repeatability of the analysis results.

[image][image]

## Continuously Evolving

The company operates as a workshop of innovation and development that, thanks to a continuous
research process, creates products and systems that meet the needs of rapidly changing markets.

[image][image]
[image][image]
[image][image]

## An investment over time

Saving time and resources

With a single analysis system, the main analyses for quality and process control can be carried out
quickly and easily, even without the intervention of chemically skilled operators. No calibration or
periodic checks are necessary: the analysers are supplied pre-calibrated and ready to use.

[image][image]

Our network of specialists will guide you in the choice of the most suitable system for your needs
and will offer you continuous and timely support after purchase.

## Cosmopolitan Food Group

> Today Cosmopolitan Food Group is operating in over 50 countries, supported by a strong network of
> more than 300 distributors, and reaching over 600,000 sales points worldwide!

In addition to olive oil, specialty oils, salt & seasonings, honey, and gourmet food production in
Türkiye, Cosmopolitan Food Group supplies Coconut Oil from Sri Lanka, Avocado Oil from Spain,
Pickles from India, and Vegetables from Egypt, China, and many others. We are the supplier of
avocado oil to Kraft Heinz & PepsiCo in the United States.

Cosmopolitan Food Group delivers 35% of the coconut oil coming from Sri Lanka to the USA and
provides 50% of bulk avocado oil to the USA. As a result of its business model, Cosmopolitan Food
Group proudly works with the major retailers of the world as a solution partner.

Our Vision

## Proudly Grown In Cherry Creek, Queensland, Australia.

Harnessing the region’s unique nutrient-dense volcanic soil and sun-drenched hills, we produce
Australia's premium avocados, avocado oil, macadamias and ginger.

[About Us][25]

Our Story

### New beginnings

Our story begins over a decade ago, with a group of mates who served our country. Seeking new
purpose and adventure, we leveraged our combined resources and network of friends and family to
create Cherry Creek Estate.

[Supporting Veterans][26]

Giving Back

### Creating the farm of the future, today.

The land we grow on is naturally abundant, and we plan to keep it that way. Through innovation,
technology and sustainable farming practices, we can maximise the longevity of our farmland whilst
minimising our carbon footprint. We do this to secure a productive and healthy future for the next
generation of farmers to come.

[Our Initiatives][27]

[Leading foodservice distributor][Over 2 million square feet][EXPLORE OUR EXCLUSIVE BRANDS][Export
And Transportation]

Florida born, family owned and operated since 1925, with the 4th generation now in place.

It is one of the fastest growing broadline distributor in the United States, with annual sales over
$3 Billion.

Total of 1,900 Tractors and Trailers, 250 loading docks, over 65,176 items, 3,298 employees and
growing, over 800 trucks traveling 24 million miles annually.

## [Cheney Brothers Export][32]

If you require service by sea, air or land, Cheney Brothers can deliver on time and accurately.
Whether your needs include meat, seafood, dairy, frozen food, dry grocery, disposables, equipment,
supplies or chemicals, our team of export professionals can help you meet the challenging demands of
doing business in your country.

[Learn More][33]

## [Our Services][34]

Our team of courteous, knowledgeable employees are dedicated to helping you meet the challenging
demands of the food service industry. We believe in partnerships with our customers to better
understand your business and how you define success. At Cheney Brothers, we are committed to what
matters most: your success.

[Learn More][35]

## Mission Statement

Delivering Southern Hospitality Since 1925

 

We insist upon top quality products from nationally recognized manufacturers. Our broad inventory
consists of more than 65,176 stocked items, from gourmet to everyday. Never content to rest on our
laurels, we strive to continuously improve and innovate our products and services. This commitment
to excellence has served our customers well for more than 90 years, and continues to serve as our
standard for success.

 

– **Byron Russell**, Chairman & CEO

And Transportation]

Florida born, family owned and operated since 1925, with the 4th generation now in place.

It is one of the fastest growing broadline distributor in the United States, with annual sales over
$3 Billion.

Total of 1,900 Tractors and Trailers, 250 loading docks, over 65,176 items, 3,298 employees and
growing, over 800 trucks traveling 24 million miles annually.

## [Cheney Brothers Export][32]

If you require service by sea, air or land, Cheney Brothers can deliver on time and accurately.
Whether your needs include meat, seafood, dairy, frozen food, dry grocery, disposables, equipment,
supplies or chemicals, our team of export professionals can help you meet the challenging demands of
doing business in your country.

[Learn More][33]

## [Our Services][34]

Our team of courteous, knowledgeable employees are dedicated to helping you meet the challenging
demands of the food service industry. We believe in partnerships with our customers to better
understand your business and how you define success. At Cheney Brothers, we are committed to what
matters most: your success.

[Learn More][35]

We insist upon top quality products from nationally recognized manufacturers. Our broad inventory
consists of more than 65,176 stocked items, from gourmet to everyday. Never content to rest on our
laurels, we strive to continuously improve and innovate our products and services. This commitment
to excellence has served our customers well for more than 90 years, and continues to serve as our
standard for success.

### THE COMPANY HUB ADVANTAGE

#### SIMPLE & FAST

Our breezy application takes care of the entire process in one easy step. No printing, scanning or
returning forms - everything is done online.

#### COMPLETE SERVICE

Need to add trading names? Tax registration? How about getting a business bank account setup or a
free sitdown with your local accountant? Our super smart application takes care of all that too.

#### COMPANY RECORDS

Our companies come with a professional document package plus access to your own dashboard, where you
can maintain details, automatically generate forms & resolutions, and keep important records up to
date.

### HELPFUL RESOURCES

#### STARTING A NEW BUSINESS?

From choosing the right accounting software to getting a logo designed, there's a lot to think about
when you're starting a business.
[Check out our helpful resources][15]

#### WHAT ARE MY OBLIGATIONS?

Registering a company can be exciting, but being a director carries with it certain duties and
obligations.
[Read about director responsibilities][16]

# Raw Ingredients To Finished Products

Connoils By Kraft is a leading international supplement [manufacturer][93], [distributor][94]
and [wholesale supplier][95] of bulk oil ingredients. We create [oil and oil powders][96] meeting
food, nutritional and drink grade standards. Connoils By Kraft clients range from startups to big
multinational corporations creating gels, [capsules][97], pills, [dried beverages][98],
[tablets][99], [drinks][100] and more. Connoils By Kraft can help any business create oil and oil
powder based product to stringent domestic or international specifications.

Coconut
CBD
Saw Palmetto
Sunflower
Pomegranate
Powder

## We Buy, Grow or Source Oil & Oil Powder Products

We’ve worked with manufacturers and companies in the [pet nutrition][101], [functional food][102],
health, [beauty][103] and [sports nutrition][104] industries, providing customized formulations with
the highest potency available. Our [experienced formulators][105] draw on industry leading training
and technology to bring your product beyond the standards of regulatory compliance.

[Get Started][106]

### A Single-Source Custom Supplier

We’re competitively priced in [oils and oil powders][107]. Through our Peterson Plant Products (PPP)
company, we plant or source conventional, organic and biodynamic products with full traceability and
documentation, ensuring you meet the regulatory standards of your industry.

[Custom Formulation][108]

### Cutting-Edge Drying Technology Increases Ingredient Potency

By minimizing the use of heat in transforming oils into oil powders, Connoils By Kraft maximizes the
nutritional integrity of your product through microencapsulation. We're able to create high oil load
oil powders that are more potent than those from [manufacturers][109] that use traditional drying
processes.

[Know What's Inside][110]

[FDA registered manufacturer of bulk oils and oil powders]
[DSHEA certified manufacturer of dietary supplements]
[USDA certified Organic supplier of oils and oil powders]
[Vegan wholesale supplier of oils and oil powders]
[Kosher certified]
[Non-GMO bulk oil supplier]
[Halal certified wholesale oils and oil powders]

## Get Your Product To Market, *Faster*

Our customers require the flexibility to order small and large raw materials quantities. From high
oil load powders and bioactive powders with improved absorption and uptake, Connoils By Kraft
provides superior customer service, on-time delivery and price competitiveness. As a toll processor,
we can take any element (from a raw ingredient to a finished product) through our formulation
process, [private labeling/white labeling][111] and shipping direct.

# Raw Ingredients To Finished Products

Connoils By Kraft is a leading international supplement [manufacturer][93], [distributor][94]
and [wholesale supplier][95] of bulk oil ingredients. We create [oil and oil powders][96] meeting
food, nutritional and drink grade standards. Connoils By Kraft clients range from startups to big
multinational corporations creating gels, [capsules][97], pills, [dried beverages][98],
[tablets][99], [drinks][100] and more. Connoils By Kraft can help any business create oil and oil
powder based product to stringent domestic or international specifications.

## We Buy, Grow or Source Oil & Oil Powder Products

We’ve worked with manufacturers and companies in the [pet nutrition][101], [functional food][102],
health, [beauty][103] and [sports nutrition][104] industries, providing customized formulations with
the highest potency available. Our [experienced formulators][105] draw on industry leading training
and technology to bring your product beyond the standards of regulatory compliance.

[Get Started][106]

### A Single-Source Custom Supplier

We’re competitively priced in [oils and oil powders][107]. Through our Peterson Plant Products (PPP)
company, we plant or source conventional, organic and biodynamic products with full traceability and
documentation, ensuring you meet the regulatory standards of your industry.

[Custom Formulation][108]

### Cutting-Edge Drying Technology Increases Ingredient Potency

By minimizing the use of heat in transforming oils into oil powders, Connoils By Kraft maximizes the
nutritional integrity of your product through microencapsulation. We're able to create high oil load
oil powders that are more potent than those from [manufacturers][109] that use traditional drying
processes.

[Know What's Inside][110]

## Get Your Product To Market, *Faster*

Our customers require the flexibility to order small and large raw materials quantities. From high
oil load powders and bioactive powders with improved absorption and uptake, Connoils By Kraft
provides superior customer service, on-time delivery and price competitiveness. As a toll processor,
we can take any element (from a raw ingredient to a finished product) through our formulation
process, [private labeling/white labeling][111] and shipping direct.

# Investing in caregivers to build a better working world

Circle In is a digital-first employee benefits platform that provides on-demand access to expert
advice for caregiving employees and their managers at every life stage.

[Watch a demo][19]
[Illustration of diverse caregivers, parents and children]

## Leading organizations trust Circle In to help build a family-inclusive workplace and create a
## culture that supports caregivers.

## Expert advice for every life stage

A global solution to suit every need across your workforce. Because we know caregiving needs differ.

[The Circle In platform shown on a tablet]
* Cost-effective, globally scalable and easy to implement
* Personalized recommendations and digital content
* Dedicated customer support to deliver insights and demonstrate ROI
* Nudges and conversation guides for managers, so they won’t miss important moments

## Hear from our Co-Founders on why they started Circle In

[Circle In co-founder speaking to camera]

## One platform for all of life’s stages

For parents on leave and returning to work6 of 6

### The right way to return to work

Aiko is about to return to work after being on parental leave and she feels prepared and confident.
Thanks to available resources, she has created a return to work checklist. She has also done a
practice run of her new routine and discussed flexible work arrangements with her manager.

For Expecting Parents1 of 6

### Calming the first baby nerves

Sylvia is expecting her first child and joined the platform when she was 14 weeks pregnant. She
immediately began receiving personalized, time-based nudges with information. This helped her
through important stages such as a guide on how to inform her manager she was pregnant.

For Working Parents2 of 6

### Connection and community is key

Mateo is a busy working dad of 3 kids, juggling a full-time career and the guilt and anxiety of
trying to have it all. Reading the real stories of other working parents helped get rid of his sense
of isolation. By tapping into the wellness hub, he made time to look after his own physical and
mental wellbeing.

For those planning for a baby3 of 6

### Planning and preparing for the future

Nate is recently married and starting to think about the pitter-patter of little feet. Having his
company’s parental policies and leave entitlements in one place made planning easy. From this, he
picked up some great tips around finance, childcare, and the many ways to form a family.

For Managers4 of 6

### Manager support is employee support

Claudia is an experienced manager who leads a very large team. When a team member experienced a
stillbirth, Claudia was able to access related conversation guides and resources. Having immediate
access to this content allowed her to lead with confidence and provide the right support to her
employee – and the wider team.

For Caregivers5 of 6

### The generation doing double duties

Lily lives with her partner, two teenagers, and her elderly father who recently experienced a
stroke. By tapping into specialized caregiver resources, she found financial and emotional support
options. She also found practical ways to share the caregiving load with her partner and siblings.

For parents on leave and returning to work6 of 6

Aiko is about to return to work after being on parental leave and she feels prepared and confident.
Thanks to available resources, she has created a return to work checklist. She has also done a

immediately began receiving personalized, time-based nudges with information. This helped her
through important stages such as a guide on how to inform her manager she was pregnant.

#### Wir sind da, wo unsere Früchte wachsen.

35 Länder der Welt

### For the free access to thousands of learning and business opportunities.

## Purchasing Announcements

Apply to purchasing announcements published by companies and governments from around the world.
Interested in posting your own company's purchasing needs? You can do that too.

[Learn more][29]

and service catalogs.

good businesses practices, trends and new markets for your business.

[Learn more][31]

community will be able to see and reply to your messages, product and service offerings, and
purchasing needs.

have great potential to develop into further commercial relations. We aim that these meetings may
generate a trade relation with an economic impact on the local communities, as many of these
companies work directly with local producers or are manufacturers bringing employment to their
region."
Marcelo Bobadilla
BC Soluciones Globales (Guatemala)
About Outsource2LAC Virtual 2020: "I just wanted to congratulate you on the excellent work
organizing O2LAC. It is the first time that I participate in the event, and I've been fascinated--I
admire the professionalism that comes through in the organization, logistics, coordination,
moderation and quality of the presentations (...) I'm from Guatemala, I have participated in events
and organized several big international events, and know what it takes, which is why I feel I can
congratulate you, because I know what organizing something of this level entails."
Elizabeth Montano
Montanos' Chocolate Co. Ltd. (Trinidad & Tobago)
In 2019 Montanos' Chocolate Company from Trinidad and Tobago had the opportunity to pitch the Machel
Montano 60% dark Chocolate at Trade Missions in Colombia and South Korea. This was made possible
through ConnectAmericas. As a result, we met with buyers and Distributors who have sinced indicated
their interest in our product and resulted in a distribution agreement. These experiences have
definitely provided our company with opportunities to export our product. Thanks to ConnectAmericas.
Love and greetings from TT.

# Proud to be the leader in fresh solutions for the convenience store industry.

[Manager and Representative]

## YOUR SUCCESS
## IS OUR SUCCESS

[Truck unloading]

## DELIVERING FOODSERVICE
## YOU CAN TRUST

[Display case graphic]

## PERFORMANCE
## BUILT ON
## INNOVATION

[Person holding tablet]

## LEADING THE WAY
## WITH TECHNOLOGY

### Customer-Centric Approach

Delivering an exceptional customer experience is our top priority. From independent stores to large
chain-operators, we are dedicated to our customers’ success and growth. Our culture is one of
innovation, integrity, and daily commitment to our customers and their businesses.

[Learn About Us][77]

### The Leader in Convenience Foodservice

Core-Mark, a distinguished member of the Performance Food Group family of companies, has established
itself as the largest and most highly-regarded marketer of consumer goods in North America. Our
commitment to crafting pioneering programs and offering best-selling products is fundamental to our
success, but more importantly, to the success of our customers.

[Explore Foodservice Programs][78]

### The Future is Innovation

Our organization thrives on providing inventive solutions to customers, enabling them to stay ahead
in the markets they serve. We achieve this with technology services that give our customers access
to systems anywhere at any time, as well as by prioritizing fresh foodservice programs that surpass
the industry standards. Our team members are consistently inspired by the evolution of the market,
and we pride ourselves on our innovative product offerings and early-to-market merchandising
solutions. Ultimately, our unwavering commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction is what
drives us forward.

[Learn About Us][79]

### Technology Leading the Way

At Core-Mark, we recognize the pivotal role that technology plays for our customers, which is why we
offer a robust suite of applications to enhance their interaction with us. This includes tools that
enable customers to place orders, track deliveries, and manage other critical aspects of their
business. Moreover, we provide solutions that cater to the evolving needs of today's consumers, such
as loyalty programs designed for independent and larger operators and frictionless check-out
options. We are committed to ongoing investment in technology that will keep our customers on the
cutting edge.

[See Our Technology][80]


## Advanced Category Management

Our expert merchandising solutions, coupled with our comprehensive product assortment will help you
drive sales while engaging consumers. We utilize cutting-edge planogram technology and offer access
to first-to-market product offerings, data-driven insights and programs to ensure your execution at
retail. Leveraging our Assortment Optimization software, cloud-based space visualization and
exclusive trend analytics will help you sell more products and manage inventory more efficiently.

cutting edge.

the industry standards. Our team members are consistently inspired by the evolution of the market,

DKSH’s purpose is to enrich people’s lives. For over 160 years, we have been distributing,
marketing, and selling high-quality products and brands for multinational and Fortune 500 companies.
Established in 1989, DKSH India is the trusted partner for companies looking to grow their business
in India.

 

### What We Offer

At DKSH India, we deliver growth for our partners by providing a full range of market expansion
services to distribute, market, and sell innovative and sustainable specialty chemicals and

intel.summary:
Mission
We started our journey with the mission of producing the highest quality extra virgin avocado oil in the world. With our success, we now strive to provide everyone with access to the healthiest and best-tasting avocado oil.
Founded in 2013,
Crofts produces the finest quality extra virgin avocado oil in the world! 
We believe in a truly healthy oil,
produced ethically with nothing added to the process.  
Crofts is the only company in the world that hand sorts each avocado before pressing for oil. This means we pick only, perfectly ripe fruits for extra virgin avocado oil production. To ensure we don’t waste anything,
we produce crude avocado oil from the overripe/rotten avocados. 
Our award-winning extra virgin avocado oil is in high demand the world over! With no marketing, it’s really the most well-known “secret!”
Our avocado oil is 100% natural and unrefined. The oil is extracted using a single cold pressed production method, which retains all essential nutrients. 
We guarantee a completely chemical and additive free extraction process and produce over 400MT of some of the best quality avocado oil per year.
We started our journey with the mission of producing the highest quality extra virgin avocado oil in the world. With our success, we now strive to provide everyone with access to the healthiest and best-tasting avocado oil.

# Thinking globally, acting responsibly and organically

## For many years this is the  principle we have held to faithfully

As a company with many years of experience in the trade in organic food, we have focused on food
from checked organic cultivation, which we import into the EU. Our customers worldwide have been
benefiting from this passion for certified organic food for many years. Our customer portfolio
consists of the relevant food sector, wholesalers, packaging operations and private label companies.

As a partner for the food industry, producers, and packagers, we look forward to supplying you with
pallet goods and full loads from our wide selection. The products we import worldwide are tested to
the highest quality standards so they meet your requirements. Try our service for yourself and trust
our experience.

5 principles of our philosophy

Fairness

Sustainability
Transparency

#  

## Quality

Partnerships with our suppliers, some of which have developed over many years, have enabled us to
build up a solid relationship of trust. This does not, however, prevent us having the analytical
quality of our products checked by accredited laboratories. True to the motto: “Trust is good,
checking is better”.
At the same time, we value good relations with all those who are involved and who contribute to the
high-quality results.

## Fairness

It is important to us to be on an equal footing with our business partners (customers and
suppliers). In this way, we create a long-term basis of trust that is very helpful to us when
working on joint projects and solving problems. We create a positive basis if we make our partners’
problem our problem too. It is our target to meet the needs of our customers.

## Transparency

“We have nothing to hide!” We are open in our dealings, our thinking and our care, all of which
leads to positive interactions. Open communication ensures transparency for customers and suppliers.

## Social responsibility

Through successful action, we are able to provide support to the socially weaker. It is our wish to
create a world for future generations in which social commitment is a matter of course. A pleasure
shared is a pleasure doubled.
It is out of this sense of responsibility that we make our contribution to a better world for our
fellow human beings. We support numerous social projects with this end in mind.

relationships with our producers and trading partners. Sustainability as a basis of understanding
means developing the future together. Our standard is 100% organic quality, which is verified and
confirmed by our organic certificate issued by our accredited control body Kiwa-BCS. In addition, we
attach importance to social standards that are guaranteed by quality seals such as Fair Trade. For
us, sustainable means thinking and acting socially, ecologically and economically in the long term.

What does organic mean?

Everyone’s talking about organic foods and they are becoming increasingly popular. But what does the

environmentally friendly form of agriculture. By law, organic raw ingredients must not be
genetically modified, nor is the use of synthetic chemical pesticides allowed. Organic farming
relies on circular economy. The aim is to find a balance between the soil, plants, and animals.

How can consumers identify organic food?

To distinguish organic foods from conventionally produced products, the EC Eco-Regulation 2092/91
was introduced in Europe in 1991. Consequently, products manufactured in accordance with the EC
Eco-Regulation can be labelled and marketed as organic on the European market. In addition, all
producers and companies that trade in organic food and organic raw ingredients are obliged to get
certified as organic by an external accredited inspection body. This gives consumers the assurance
that the product they purchase really is an organic product. In addition, there are other farming
associations, such as Naturland, Bioland, or Demeter. A Naturland, Bioland, or Demeter Association
certification is additional to the mandatory organic certification.

Another important aspect is transparency. The traceability of organic products from producers in the
country of origin to the consumer must always be available and verifiable. These important criteria,
coupled with trust and long-term partnerships, are the foundation for safe global trade in organic
raw ingredients for Delphi Organic.

It is important to us to be on an equal footing with our business partners (customers and

What does organic mean?

How can consumers identify organic food?

To distinguish organic foods from conventionally produced products, the EC Eco-Regulation 2092/91
was introduced in Europe in 1991. Consequently, products manufactured in accordance with the EC
Eco-Regulation can be labelled and marketed as organic on the European market. In addition, all
producers and companies that trade in organic food and organic raw ingredients are obliged to get
certified as organic by an external accredited inspection body. This gives consumers the assurance
that the product they purchase really is an organic product. In addition, there are other farming
associations, such as Naturland, Bioland, or Demeter. A Naturland, Bioland, or Demeter Association
certification is additional to the mandatory organic certification.

Another important aspect is transparency. The traceability of organic products from producers in the
country of origin to the consumer must always be available and verifiable. These important criteria,
coupled with trust and long-term partnerships, are the foundation for safe global trade in organic
raw ingredients for Delphi Organic.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

Tailored support for retailers

From regionally tailored offers to the exclusive DMART Retail Club, we give you pricing, products,

From Trade Weeks to depot activations and year-round promotions, Dhamecha connects your products

visibility, sales, and margins.

consistent availability, trusted quality, and scale you can depend on.

At DHCFruit, we take pride in sourcing avocados from trusted, high-quality suppliers around the
globe, including regions like South Africa, Peru, Israel, Chile, Colombia, Kenya, Tanzania, and
Morocco.

Our avocados are available in both 4KG and 10KG bulk packaging. Upon arrival, every batch undergoes
rigorous quality checks to ensure premium standards, with flexible options for consumer-ready
packaging.

Choosing DHCFruit means choosing reliability and quality. We deliver avocados consistently
throughout the year, so you can always depend on a steady supply of exceptional produce.

From Greenskin to Hass varieties, available in multiple sizes and packaging options, we cater to
every requirement with tailored solutions.


Transport:

Shipped by SEA in 40ft Reefer Container. 5760 boxes of 4 kg/ 1200 boxes of 10 kg.

Shipped by AIR 144 boxes of 4 kg per pallet. Minimum 10 pallets,  maximum 24 pallets per shipment.

At DHCFruit, we are dedicated to sourcing blueberries from the finest, certified suppliers
worldwide.



Our blueberries are available in various packaging options, from 125g, 250g and 500g clamshells to
larger bulk packs, allowing flexibility for diverse market needs. Each batch is carefully inspected
on arrival, ensuring it meets our strict quality standards and is ready for consumer packaging.



Why Choose DHCFruit for Blueberries?

Choosing DHCFruit means choosing a reliable source of top-quality blueberries. 

With a variety of packaging solutions available, we can adapt to your specific requirements, whether
for retail or wholesale distribution.



Interested in how DHCFruit can fulfill your blueberry needs? Reach out today for a customized
solution!
