At DHCFruit, we source premium avocado oil from trusted global suppliers, ensuring quality in every
shipment.

Available in 24,000-liter flexitanks and IBCs, our avocado oil meets the diverse needs of our
clients.


Why Choose Avocado Oil from DHCFruit?

For us, supplying avocado oil means more than just delivery; it’s a commitment to excellence. With
consistent availability and adaptable solutions, we guarantee a reliable supply of high-quality
avocado oil all year round.

Transport:

Bulk Unrefined CRUDE (raw) Avocado Oil – Shipped in 24,000 liter Flexitanks. For food,
nutraceutical- or cosmetic ingredient.

Extra Virgin Avocado Oil – usually shipped in 1,040 liter IBC’s/Totes.

Refined Avocado Oil – RBD & RBDW

Fast and reliable bulk food product deliveries for supermarkets, whole sale agents, food
distributors and Nutraceutical- and cosmetic industries

Tailored packaging solutions to enhance product presentation and meet unique branding needs.

Source high-quality fresh fruits directly from farms for top-notch culinary creations.

# Western Canada’s Trusted Source for Certified Organic & Fair Trade Produce

[ Our Growers ][21]
[ Our Customers ][22]
 
[crisp-16.jpg]

Discover


Our Commitment

In business since 1999, Discovery Organics is an independently owned Canadian distributor of
[Certified Organic][23] and [Fair Trade][24] produce.

We passionately work to promote Certified Organic and Fair Trade by building relationships with
small scale farmers here in B.C. and beyond.

We serve hundreds of customers, including natural food retailers and wholesalers across Western
Canada and the Northern Territories.

[Learn more about Discovery ➝][25]

[125 Years Of Pineapple Anniversary Dole]

A Golden Milestone: 125 Years of Pineapples

Since first introducing the US and much of the world to fresh and canned pineapple in 1901, Dole has
been synonymous with the tropical fruit connected to warm welcomes, generous hospitality and beach
vacations. Throughout 2026 we invite you to join with us as we share the joy in celebrating our
125th year in growing and delivering the best in pineapple—DOLE® Pineapple.

[ 125 Years of Pineapples ][43]

## Discover a New Slice of Paradise

[Award Winning Colada Royale Pineapple from Dole]

From the company that knows pineapples best comes a new treasure. Dole’s new Colada Royale pineapple
brings a smooth, tropical sweetness with subtle coconut notes for a truly elevated pineapple
experience. Crafted for those who savor something special.

[ Discover More ][44]

## Dole Resources, Recipes and Recommendations for GLP-1 Medications

[Women opening a fridge containing Dole fruits]

GLP-1 medications are changing how people think about weight loss and blood sugar management, but
food still matters. Discover how fresh fruits and vegetables can play a practical, satisfying role
alongside this medication, with recipes, tips, and real-world guidance designed for everyday life.
Visit our GLP-1 resource hub to explore smart, produce-forward ways to nourish your body and support
your journey.

[ View Resources ][45]

## 2023 Dole plc Sustainability Report

For over 170 years, we have been as proud to deliver nutritious, high-quality produce all around the
world, as we have been to take responsibility for the land from which it is grown. And we are
equally committed to supporting and enhancing the global communities that ensure we can produce and
deliver the quality produce we are known for.

The Dole Way is our enduring commitment to grow, process and distribute our produce responsibly-
today and for generations to come.

A Golden Milestone: 125 Years of Pineapples

Since first introducing the US and much of the world to fresh and canned pineapple in 1901, Dole has
been synonymous with the tropical fruit connected to warm welcomes, generous hospitality and beach
vacations. Throughout 2026 we invite you to join with us as we share the joy in celebrating our
125th year in growing and delivering the best in pineapple—DOLE® Pineapple.

[ 125 Years of Pineapples ][43]

[Award Winning Colada Royale Pineapple from Dole]

From the company that knows pineapples best comes a new treasure. Dole’s new Colada Royale pineapple
brings a smooth, tropical sweetness with subtle coconut notes for a truly elevated pineapple
experience. Crafted for those who savor something special.

[Women opening a fridge containing Dole fruits]

food still matters. Discover how fresh fruits and vegetables can play a practical, satisfying role
alongside this medication, with recipes, tips, and real-world guidance designed for everyday life.
Visit our GLP-1 resource hub to explore smart, produce-forward ways to nourish your body and support
your journey.

## 2023 Dole plc Sustainability Report

For over 170 years, we have been as proud to deliver nutritious, high-quality produce all around the
world, as we have been to take responsibility for the land from which it is grown. And we are
equally committed to supporting and enhancing the global communities that ensure we can produce and
deliver the quality produce we are known for.

The Dole Way is our enduring commitment to grow, process and distribute our produce responsibly-
today and for generations to come.

# Welcome to Eltherington, providing Rainscreen & Façade solutions since 1960

We strive to remain at the forefront of innovation and performance in terms of building envelopes,
with solutions across the entire building facade, including decorative rainscreen cladding,
roofline, column casings and special fabrications.

All our quality building products are available in an extensive choice of materials, colours and
designs to help you bring your design to life.

We build transformative partnerships to accelerate clean energy and economic opportunity.

Global efforts to tackle energy poverty have made immense strides in recent decades. But progress
has stalled. Today, nearly 700 million people live without electricity and a billion more live with
access that is unaffordable or unreliable. This deficit holds back development, raises the cost of
doing business and suppresses economic growth.

**A new approach is urgently needed.**

### About Global Energy Alliance

# Organic Fruits & Vegetables

Eosta’s mission is to make the world more **Healthy, Fair & Organic** by driving positive change in
the food system. We do this together with a worldwide network of **over 1,000 **organic certified**
growers**, delivering organic and fair fresh produce with full transparency in the supply chain.

[More about us][72]

## Global sourcing

With growers across continents, we reduce regional risks and secure a stable supply.

### SUSTAINABLE LOGISTICS

Sustainable packaging & responsible transport is our expertise. 


### Transparency

We know our farmers personally and how they grow sustainbly.

### [
### 
### Moroccan limes provide breathing space in a tight organic lime market
### 
### ][98]

Demand for organic fruit continues to grow, and organic limes are no exception. Their popularity is
being driven partly by increasing demand for cocktails, mocktails and homemade lemonades, as well as
their wider use in salads, curries and other dishes. Consumers are also increasingly choosing citrus
grown without synthetic pesticides and without post-harvest fungicide treatment.

[ [Kivinaki] ][99]

### [
### 
### Kivinaki ready for the new Organic Raingrown Oranges season
### 
### ][100]

Ahead of the new organic orange season, our sourcing team visited Kivinaki in Peru. Over the past
four years, we have built a successful export programme with this growers’ co-operative. During the
visit, we worked together to prepare for the coming months.

[ [Pineapple] ][101]

### [
### 
### Healthy soil makes organic pineapples more resilient
### 
### ][102]

In Costa Rica, too, the effects of climate change are becoming increasingly apparent. Heavy
rainfall, in particular, is making organic pineapple cultivation more challenging and requires
growers to be adaptable.

### Moroccan limes provide breathing space in a tight organic lime market
### 
### ][98]

Demand for organic fruit continues to grow, and organic limes are no exception. Their popularity is
being driven partly by increasing demand for cocktails, mocktails and homemade lemonades, as well as
their wider use in salads, curries and other dishes. Consumers are also increasingly choosing citrus
grown without synthetic pesticides and without post-harvest fungicide treatment.

[ [Kivinaki] ][99]

### [
### 
### Kivinaki ready for the new Organic Raingrown Oranges season
### 
### ][100]

Ahead of the new organic orange season, our sourcing team visited Kivinaki in Peru. Over the past
four years, we have built a successful export programme with this growers’ co-operative. During the
visit, we worked together to prepare for the coming months.

[ [Pineapple] ][101]

### [
### 
### Healthy soil makes organic pineapples more resilient
### 
### ][102]

In Costa Rica, too, the effects of climate change are becoming increasingly apparent. Heavy
rainfall, in particular, is making organic pineapple cultivation more challenging and requires
growers to be adaptable.

finest naturally derived, and natural skincare and hair care solutions. We specialize in small batch
manufacturing to ensure freshly created beauty options that are responsibly designed and ethically
based. Your customers are bound to love them—and the planet will too!

As a premium wholesale skin and hair care manufacturer driven by an unwavering commitment to
sustainability, purity, and transparency, we are here to bring you exceptional skincare and haircare
formulations designed with a conscience. On top of offering an extensive product catalog, we can

our product lines and ingredient offerings address a wide spectrum of skin and hair types.

## What Is Fair Trade Egypt ?

** Fair Trade Egypt is committed to promoting ethical and eco-conscious Egyptian handicraft products
by establishing strong partnerships with artisans. Our curated selection of handicrafts in Egypt
includes home décor, accessories, and gift items that are made with respect for both people and the
planet. **

## Empowering Egyptian Artisans through Fair Trade Egypt Principles

** **

** Fair Trade Egypt, a WFTO member, supports Egyptian artisans by applying Fair Trade principles,
promoting sustainable development, and preserving handicraft heritage, benefiting artisans and their
families, 90% of whom are women. **

## What Is Fair Trade Egypt ?

** Fair Trade Egypt is committed to promoting ethical and eco-conscious Egyptian handicraft products
by establishing strong partnerships with artisans. Our curated selection of handicrafts in Egypt
includes home décor, accessories, and gift items that are made with respect for both people and the
planet. **

## Empowering Egyptian Artisans through Fair Trade Egypt Principles

** **

** Fair Trade Egypt, a WFTO member, supports Egyptian artisans by applying Fair Trade principles,
promoting sustainable development, and preserving handicraft heritage, benefiting artisans and their
families, 90% of whom are women. **

### ¿Alguna pregunta?

### ¿Para quién es esto?

Para los que están hartos de frutas y verduras sin sabor y sin ninguna garantía de salud y de
origen. También para las personas que son conscientes de la importancia de apoyar nuestro campo
español y darle la prioridad que se merece. Y si quieres ahorrar en tu cesta de la compra EAP es
para ti.

### ¿Funcionará para mi?

Si tienes poco tiempo, estás un poco pendiente de cuando llega el pedido a casa o lo gestionas bien
con la agencia de envío, te vas ahorrar tiempo. Todo lo nuevo siempre tira un poco para atrás, pero
es acostumbrarse a esta nueva forma de consumir fruta y verdura de verdad, como la época de nuestros
abuelos.

### ¿Cuántos días tarda en llegar mi pedido?

Desde que sale de nuestro almacén tenemos contratado el servicio 24 horas, que la empresa de
transporte cumple en un 97%. Enviamos de Lunes a Jueves. Por tanto si has hecho tu pedido Jueves más
tarde de las 6:00am, Viernes, Sábado o Domingo. Se enviará entre el Lunes y Martes de la siguiente
semana.

### ¿Qué ocurre si me llega un pedido en mal estado?

Siempre te vamos a dar una solución, nos encantaría que hubiese un 0% de incidencias pero trabajando
con productos perecederos y delicados es imposible. Tenemos un 3% de incidencias, pero lo dicho,
darte la tranquilidad al 100% de que siempre siempre siempre te vamos a dar una solución, así es que
hemos creado una plataforma de incidencias donde puedes gestionar cualquier problema de forma
directa y obtener una solución al instante. Sin esperas y sin depender de que alguien te conteste.
Tú mismo podrás gestionar la incidencia de manera sencilla y rápida aquí:
[https://incidencias.europagricultproduct.com][54]

Porque si algo tenemos claro es que confiamos en ti. Y esa confianza también significa darte
autonomía, transparencia y control.

Así que si te daba inseguridad pedir fruta online sin haberla visto y tocado antes, no tienes de qué
preocuparte.

### ¿Hay gastos de envío?

Si y siempre los hay, somos muy transparentes y las tiendas online que te dicen que a partir de
cierta cantidad que te gastes de dinero, el envío es gratis, no es cierto… lo estás pagando tú.
Nosotros separamos lo que es el coste de producto del transporte para que sepas exactamente por lo
que estás pagando. Y te cobramos lo mismo que nos cobra a nosotros la agencia, ni un céntimo más. Y
cuanto más pidas más se reduce el coste por kg. Por ejemplo si pides 2kg de aguacate el porte son 3€
pero si pides 10kg de aguacate el porte son 4€ aunque el total aumente, lo que repercute por kg es
mucho menos.

### ¿Alguna pregunta?

### ¿Para quién es esto?

Para los que están hartos de frutas y verduras sin sabor y sin ninguna garantía de salud y de
origen. También para las personas que son conscientes de la importancia de apoyar nuestro campo
español y darle la prioridad que se merece. Y si quieres ahorrar en tu cesta de la compra EAP es
para ti.

### ¿Funcionará para mi?

Si tienes poco tiempo, estás un poco pendiente de cuando llega el pedido a casa o lo gestionas bien
con la agencia de envío, te vas ahorrar tiempo. Todo lo nuevo siempre tira un poco para atrás, pero
es acostumbrarse a esta nueva forma de consumir fruta y verdura de verdad, como la época de nuestros
abuelos.

### ¿Cuántos días tarda en llegar mi pedido?

Desde que sale de nuestro almacén tenemos contratado el servicio 24 horas, que la empresa de
transporte cumple en un 97%. Enviamos de Lunes a Jueves. Por tanto si has hecho tu pedido Jueves más
tarde de las 6:00am, Viernes, Sábado o Domingo. Se enviará entre el Lunes y Martes de la siguiente
semana.

### ¿Qué ocurre si me llega un pedido en mal estado?

Siempre te vamos a dar una solución, nos encantaría que hubiese un 0% de incidencias pero trabajando
con productos perecederos y delicados es imposible. Tenemos un 3% de incidencias, pero lo dicho,
darte la tranquilidad al 100% de que siempre siempre siempre te vamos a dar una solución, así es que
hemos creado una plataforma de incidencias donde puedes gestionar cualquier problema de forma
directa y obtener una solución al instante. Sin esperas y sin depender de que alguien te conteste.
Tú mismo podrás gestionar la incidencia de manera sencilla y rápida aquí:
[https://incidencias.europagricultproduct.com][54]

Porque si algo tenemos claro es que confiamos en ti. Y esa confianza también significa darte
autonomía, transparencia y control.

Así que si te daba inseguridad pedir fruta online sin haberla visto y tocado antes, no tienes de qué
preocuparte.

### ¿Hay gastos de envío?

Si y siempre los hay, somos muy transparentes y las tiendas online que te dicen que a partir de
cierta cantidad que te gastes de dinero, el envío es gratis, no es cierto… lo estás pagando tú.
Nosotros separamos lo que es el coste de producto del transporte para que sepas exactamente por lo
que estás pagando. Y te cobramos lo mismo que nos cobra a nosotros la agencia, ni un céntimo más. Y
cuanto más pidas más se reduce el coste por kg. Por ejemplo si pides 2kg de aguacate el porte son 3€
pero si pides 10kg de aguacate el porte son 4€ aunque el total aumente, lo que repercute por kg es
mucho menos.

¿Aún tienes preguntas? [Ver más][55]

# Field Day, Ingredients You Can Trust
* ## WILDLY SIMPLE
  
  ### We believe in where our food comes from
* Our goal is to fill your home with a wide selection of value-priced items that you can use and
  feel good about every day. Our harvest of Non-GMO, organic and quality products are delicious and
  genuinely simple. We take a less-is-more approach with our ingredients and packaging. No
  confusion, just what you need. That’s Field Day.
  
  [LEARN MORE][18]

[USDA Organic Logo]

## WHY WE CHOOSE ORGANIC

### ...and why you should too!

Organic foods are cleaner for your family and the environment because they do not allow toxic
pesticides, GMOs, antibiotics or growth hormones.  They prohibit the use of artificial colors,
flavors and preservatives.  Whenever possible we will source organic ingredients to produce USDA
certified products.

[Learn More][19]

## EARTH-FRIENDLY
## ESSENTIALS

### We have your tableware needs covered!

Perfect for using at home or on-the-go! Our durable dinner bowls are made with a blend of sugarcane
and bamboo fibers, and our 24-piece assorted Compostable Cutlery comes with 8 forks, 8 knives and 8
spoons.

### **Frequently Asked Questions**

#### [green line]

 

#### 1. What types of food products does Flanagan supply? 

Flanagan offers a wide range of food products, including fresh produce, pantry essentials, dairy,
meats, beverages, frozen goods, and specialty items, catering to diverse foodservices and retail
needs.  

#### 2. How do I find a food supplier or distributor near me? 

Flanagan operates across Canada with strategically located distribution centers, ensuring efficient
delivery to various regions including Ontario and other provinces. Contact us to discuss local
availability and delivery options.  

#### 3. What makes Flanagan a reliable food distributor in Canada? 

With decades of experience, Flanagan is committed to quality, freshness, and excellent customer
service. Our extensive product range, reliable logistics, and strong relationships with producers
make us a trusted partner in food distribution.  

#### 4. Can I purchase wholesale food directly from Flanagan? 

Yes, we provide wholesale pricing and supply to restaurants, caterers, retailers, and other
foodservice operators. We offer flexible ordering options to meet your specific volume needs.  

#### 5. How can I become a foodservice or restaurant food supplier partner? 

Reach out to our sales team to discuss your product offerings and how we can support your growth in
the Canadian market through our distribution network and marketing support.  

#### 6. Do you deliver food products to restaurants and foodservice establishments? 

Absolutely. We specialize in restaurant and foodservice distribution, ensuring timely delivery of
fresh and quality products directly to your location, including special arrangements for holidays or
peak seasons.  

#### 7. What are the key questions I should ask a food distributor before partnering? 

Consider asking about their experience, product specialization, delivery schedule, pricing
structure, order minimums and maximums, and how they handle product safety and quality controls.
These questions help ensure a good fit for your business.  

#### 8. How does Flanagan support food wholesalers and bulk buyers? 

We offer competitive pricing, volume discounts, customized order plans, and dedicated customer
support to help maximize your margins and operational efficiency.  

#### 9. What regions does Flanagan serve? 

We serve Ontario and Atlantic Canada, we focus on providing tailored solutions to meet regional
demands, ensuring freshness and reliability for local and national customers.  

#### 10. How can I get more information or request a quote? 

Contact us directly through our website or customer service channels. Our team is ready to assist
with product inquiries, quotes, and delivery arrangements tailored to your business needs.

### **A TRUSTED EMPLOYER & FOODSERVICE DISTRIBUTOR**

[Green line]

 

 

 

 


 

Flanagan Foodservice has been recognized on the Forbes list of Canada’s Best Employers 2026. This
prestigious award underscores Flanagan Foodservice’s steadfast commitment to maintaining an
exceptional workplace environment.


 

As a Canadian-owned and managed company, Flanagan’s has been recognized for our innovative,
world-class business practices. Best Managed companies share an emphasis on culture and people,
innovation, sustained performance and strong financial results.

 

 

 

### **Frequently Asked Questions**

#### [green line]

 

#### 1. What types of food products does Flanagan supply? 

Flanagan offers a wide range of food products, including fresh produce, pantry essentials, dairy,
meats, beverages, frozen goods, and specialty items, catering to diverse foodservices and retail
needs.  

#### 2. How do I find a food supplier or distributor near me? 

Flanagan operates across Canada with strategically located distribution centers, ensuring efficient
delivery to various regions including Ontario and other provinces. Contact us to discuss local
availability and delivery options.  

#### 3. What makes Flanagan a reliable food distributor in Canada? 

With decades of experience, Flanagan is committed to quality, freshness, and excellent customer
service. Our extensive product range, reliable logistics, and strong relationships with producers
make us a trusted partner in food distribution.  

#### 4. Can I purchase wholesale food directly from Flanagan? 

Yes, we provide wholesale pricing and supply to restaurants, caterers, retailers, and other
foodservice operators. We offer flexible ordering options to meet your specific volume needs.  

#### 5. How can I become a foodservice or restaurant food supplier partner? 

Reach out to our sales team to discuss your product offerings and how we can support your growth in
the Canadian market through our distribution network and marketing support.  

#### 6. Do you deliver food products to restaurants and foodservice establishments? 

Absolutely. We specialize in restaurant and foodservice distribution, ensuring timely delivery of
fresh and quality products directly to your location, including special arrangements for holidays or
peak seasons.  

#### 7. What are the key questions I should ask a food distributor before partnering? 

Consider asking about their experience, product specialization, delivery schedule, pricing
structure, order minimums and maximums, and how they handle product safety and quality controls.
These questions help ensure a good fit for your business.  

#### 8. How does Flanagan support food wholesalers and bulk buyers? 

We offer competitive pricing, volume discounts, customized order plans, and dedicated customer
support to help maximize your margins and operational efficiency.  

#### 9. What regions does Flanagan serve? 

We serve Ontario and Atlantic Canada, we focus on providing tailored solutions to meet regional
demands, ensuring freshness and reliability for local and national customers.  

#### 10. How can I get more information or request a quote? 

Contact us directly through our website or customer service channels. Our team is ready to assist
with product inquiries, quotes, and delivery arrangements tailored to your business needs.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

## **Industry Solutions **

[[FRUIT&VEGETABLE PRODUCTION LINE][FRUIT&VEGETABLE PRODUCTION LINE]][158]
[FRUIT&VEGETABLE PROCESSING LINE][159]

### Complete processing solutions for fresh fruits and vegetables, covering washing, sorting,
### crushing, pulping, juice extracting, separating, enzymatic treatment, concentration and
### sterilization.

### Suitable for producing juice, puree, concentrate, fruit & vegetable sauces, jams, fermented
### products, with stable quality and scalable capacity for industrial production.

[[Milk and dairy processing line ][Milk and dairy processing line ]][160]
[MILK&DAIRY PROCESSING LINE ][161]

### Turn-key dairy processing lines for liquid milk and value-added dairy products.

### Designed for pasteurized milk, UHT milk, flavored milk drinks, milk powder, condensed milk,
### yogurt, cheese and butter, integrating raw milk reception, standardization, fermentation, 
### homogenization, heat treatment, concentration, spray drying and hygienic filling.

[[PLANT-BASED MILK PROCESSING LINE ][PLANT-BASED MILK PROCESSING LINE ]][162]
[PLANT-BASED MILK PROCESSING LINE ][163]

### Integrated plant-based milk processing solutions for nuts, grains and legumes.

### Suitable for coconut, almond, walnut, cashew, oats, beans, peas, peanut, sesame and other raw
### materials, enabling efficient soaking, grinding, enzymatic treatment, filtration, homogenization
### and sterilization to produce stable, high-protein plant-based beverages.

[[Sauce and dresssing processing lines ][Sauce and dresssing processing lines ]][164]
[SAUCE&DRESSINGS PROCESSING LINE ][165]

### Customized sauce and dressing production lines for high-viscosity and multi-phase products.

### Capable of processing tomato sauce, mayonnaise, chili sauce, onion garlic sauce, salad dressings
### and compound sauces, ensuring uniform texture, stable emulsion and consistent flavor.

[[beverage processing line ][beverage processing line ]][166]
[BEVERAGE PROCESSING LINE][167]

### Turn-key beverage processing lines for non-carbonated and carbonated drinks.

### Suitable for tea and coffee based drinks, juice beverages, milk-based drinks, functional
### beverages and carbonated drinks, integrating beverage preparation and blending, filtration, heat
### treatment, CIP and hygienic filling.

[[DRY FOOD PROCESSING LINE][DRY FOOD PROCESSING LINE]][168]
[DRY FOOD PROCESSING LINE][169]

### Dry food and powder processing solutions for liquid-to-powder conversion.

### Applied to milk powder, plant-based milk powder, bone broth powder,  fruit & vegetable powder
### and egg powder  utilizing evaporation, drying and powder handling systems for stable quality and
### long shelf life.

# Quality fruit directly from the source

FruitMasters is the largest fruit cooperative in the Netherlands with unrivalled capacity to deliver
Dutch quality fruit directly from the source. Combined with its versatile packaging and constant
pursuit of innovation, FruitMasters creates a fruit experience for carefree enjoyment. [More about
FruitMasters][44]

 

### Brands

[

KANZI®

KANZI® is our own apple cultivar, jointly cultivated by FruitMasters. The KANZI® fruit label derives
from Gala and Braeburn and has received the best characteristics from both parents.

][45]
[

Tessa®

][46]
[

Morgana®

][47]
[

Joly Red

Meet Joly Red. A sweet, crispy apple with an intense red color. Perfect to eat fresh. Because of the

## Delivery, Box Weights & Fees

All our product prices **include delivery**, so there are no surprises at checkout
* Free Delivery: Orders over 12kg are shipped free of charge.
* Small Orders: If your order weighs less than 12KG, a R100 delivery fee wil be added at checkout.
* Free Delivery for all Local Collections:  Choose a collection point at checkout.

We do our best to make sure your order reaches you fresh and on time

**Dispatch Days**: 

Orders are sent out on **Mondays** and **Thursdays**, unless you’ve added a note asking for a later
delivery date. Once your order is on its way, we’ll send you the **waybill via WhatsApp** so you can
track it easily.

**Typical Delivery Times**: 
* Polokwane: Next Day      
* Gauteng: Next day.           
* Cape Provinces: About 4 days. 
* Other provinces: 2 – 4 days.
**Local Collection Points**: 
* Tzaneen: The Blue Willow Tree (Opposite spar)
* Haenertsburg: PPS Fuel Station

## About Fresh From The Farm

Order from Fresh From the Farm and get fresh avocados, seasonal produce, and locally made goodies
delivered straight to your door.

By shopping with us, you support local farmers and sustainable growing practices. Our produce is
real, full of flavour, and sometimes imperfect – but always fresh and delicious.

We keep packaging minimal to reduce waste, so you can enjoy fresh, local food while making a
positive impact on the planet and your community.

## Delivery, Box Weights & Fees

All our product prices **include delivery**, so there are no surprises at checkout
* Free Delivery: Orders over 12kg are shipped free of charge.
* Small Orders: If your order weighs less than 12KG, a R100 delivery fee wil be added at checkout.

**Dispatch Days**: 

Orders are sent out on **Mondays** and **Thursdays**, unless you’ve added a note asking for a later
delivery date. Once your order is on its way, we’ll send you the **waybill via WhatsApp** so you can
track it easily.

**Typical Delivery Times**: 
* Polokwane: Next Day      
* Gauteng: Next day.           
* Cape Provinces: About 4 days. 
* Other provinces: 2 – 4 days.
**Local Collection Points**: 
* Tzaneen: The Blue Willow Tree (Opposite spar)
* Haenertsburg: PPS Fuel Station

## About Fresh From The Farm

Order from Fresh From the Farm and get fresh avocados, seasonal produce, and locally made goodies
delivered straight to your door.

By shopping with us, you support local farmers and sustainable growing practices. Our produce is
real, full of flavour, and sometimes imperfect – but always fresh and delicious.

We keep packaging minimal to reduce waste, so you can enjoy fresh, local food while making a
positive impact on the planet and your community.

FAQS
01
What types of Mexican products do you export to Singapore?
[Expand] [Collapse]

We export a comprehensive range including fresh produce (avocados, mangoes, berries), frozen fruits
and vegetables, premium meats and seafood, specialty foods like guacamole and salsas, and authentic
Mexican spirits including tequila and mezcal. All products meet Singapore's strict import standards
and are sourced from certified Mexican suppliers.

02
What are your minimum order quantities and delivery times?
[Expand] [Collapse]

Minimum order quantities vary by product category - typically one pallet for frozen goods and
negotiable for fresh produce. Standard delivery from Mexico to Singapore is 3-4 weeks by sea
freight, with air freight options available for urgent orders. We consolidate shipments to optimize
costs for smaller buyers.

03
How do you ensure product quality during long-distance shipping?
[Expand] [Collapse]

We use state-of-the-art cold chain logistics with temperature-controlled containers monitored 24/7.
Fresh produce is harvested at optimal ripeness, immediately cooled, and packed using modified
atmosphere technology. Our quality control team inspects products at origin and destination,
ensuring they arrive in perfect condition.

04
Do you handle import documentation and customs clearance?
[Expand] [Collapse]

Yes, we provide comprehensive support including phytosanitary certificates, certificates of origin,
health certificates, and all required Singapore AVA/SFA documentation. Our team is experienced with
Singapore's import regulations and can assist with customs clearance, though buyers typically handle
final clearance through their appointed agents.

## Solutions to Simplify Your Business

Discover our innovative technology and services designed to simplify operations, reduce costs, and
maximize your efficiency.

## Simplify Your Ordering Process

Order online anytime, track deliveries, and manage your inventory with ease using Gordon Ordering.

[Learn More >][25]

## On The Go With Our App

The Gordon Now App lets you place orders, browse products, and manage your account right from your
mobile device.

[Learn More >][26]

## Optimize Your Menu Management

Gordon Restaurant Pro helps you control costs, plan menus, and analyze sales data to maximize
profitability.

[Learn More >][27]

## Find the Right Tech for Your Restaurant

Navigate hundreds of tech options to discover the best fit for your operations—plus, access to
exclusive deals.

[Explore All Solutions >][28]

## Delivering Quality & Expertise

Explore our wide range of products and services designed to enhance your operations and delight your
customers.

## Quality Ingredients, Delivered On Time

We offer a wide selection of fresh, frozen, and dry goods to meet all your menu needs.

[**Explore Products**][29]

## Reliable Distribution Network

Our established distribution network ensures your orders are delivered on time and ready for
application.

[**Learn More**][30]

## Trusted Brands, Exceptional Value

Discover our exclusive brands that help you cut costs without sacrificing quality.

[**View Our Brands**][31]

## Specialized Solutions for Your Needs

Our specialty companies provide tailored solutions for specific foodservice tastes and operational
needs.

[**Learn More**][32]

## Essential Equipment & Supplies

Find a comprehensive selection of kitchen equipment, tabletop items, and supplies.

[**Browse Supplies**][33]

## Innovative Technology Solutions

Streamline your operations with our user-friendly online ordering, inventory management, and menu
planning tools.

[**Explore Technology**][34]

## Culinary Expertise & Support

Access culinary resources, trends, and expert advice to inspire your menu and enhance your
offerings.

[**Explore Support**][35]

## Committed to Sustainability

We offer sustainable products and practices to help you reduce your environmental impact.

[**Learn About Sustainability**][36]

## A Legacy of Excellence

With over 125 years of experience, Gordon Food Service is a trusted partner for foodservice
businesses across North America.

CAREERS

## Start Your Future
## With Us Today

Whether you are looking to work with your hands in operations, jump behind the scenes in the Home
Office, or serve our customers directly in transportation and sales, we have a place for you! We
welcome individuals with unique perspectives and talents. With a variety of positions available,
explore our careers and apply today if you find a role that fits your passion!

[ Explore Careers ][37]
[ See Open Positions ][38]

## Your Source for Industry Insights

We provide valuable resources to help you adapt, innovate, and thrive in the ever-evolving
foodservice landscape.

[ Become a Customer ][39]
[ Explore Trends & Ideas ][40]

## Connect & Discover at Our Food Shows

Stay informed about upcoming food shows and events to network and discover new products.

[Find a Show Near You >][41]

## Stay Informed with Industry Insights

Get the latest trends, research, and analysis to make informed business decisions.

[Read the Insights >][42]

## Inspire Your Menu with New Recipes

Find innovative recipes, menu ideas, and culinary inspiration to delight your customers.

[Get Inspired >][43]

## Optimize Your Strategy & Operations

Improve efficiency, manage costs, and enhance your business strategy with expert guidance.

[Learn More >][44]

See how we have helped foodservice businesses thrive through partnership and tailored solutions.

# Vietnam Tour & Vacation Packages | Top 10+ Vietnam Trips 2026 – 2027

Vietnam tours draw you in through the small things first — the street-side aromas, the river breeze
at dawn, the rhythm of daily life drifting through old towns and green valleys. Everything feels
lived-in, welcoming, and real, making each moment quietly memorable.

If you’re looking for a local, safe, and flexible Vietnam tour package, you’re in the right place!
At Go Vietnam Tours, we craft private Vietnam tours and Vietnam tour packages with clear pricing,
customizable itineraries, and 24/7 real-human support - so your trip flows naturally from start to
finish.

cover the country’s top destinations and offer flexible options for every traveler.

# Health Benefits

### IT’S GOOD FOR YOU

The amazing avocado has many distinctive health benefits and is classed as a superfood by many. On
top of the many health benefits here are a few: It may reduce cholesterol, improve heart health and
lower blood pressure. It’s high in rich Oleic Acid, a very healthy fat. The essential fats found
avocados are essential for digestion and nutrient absorption because they nourish the lining of the
gut. It’s an all-round super food!

### IT HAS A HIGH SMOKE POINT

Not every oil is created equal. The benefit of avocado oil is that it can be heated to very high
temperatures. Why is this good? When oil is heated past its smoke point, the fat starts to break
down, releasing free radicals and any health benefit that the oil had is lost.

### EXTRA VIRGIN COLD PRESSED

Extra Virgin is the highest grade of avocado oil, produced from the pressing of good quality
avocados. Produced at low temperatures, without chemicals the oil is 100% pure and natural. Cold
pressing from the first press of the avocado fruit means retains the same high level of nutrients,
natural flavour, aroma and colour found in fresh avocado.

### 16 AVOCADOS IN EVERY BOTTLE

Every one of our 250ml bottles contains 16 cold pressed avocados. Quality Avocado Oil should have a
taste and colour characteristics of the fresh avocado fruit and be a dark vibrant green. We house
our oil in dark glass bottles, which keeps out light and oxygen retaining the quality of the oil

# Health Benefits

### IT’S GOOD FOR YOU

The amazing avocado has many distinctive health benefits and is classed as a superfood by many. On
top of the many health benefits here are a few: It may reduce cholesterol, improve heart health and
lower blood pressure. It’s high in rich Oleic Acid, a very healthy fat. The essential fats found
avocados are essential for digestion and nutrient absorption because they nourish the lining of the
gut. It’s an all-round super food!

### IT HAS A HIGH SMOKE POINT

Not every oil is created equal. The benefit of avocado oil is that it can be heated to very high
temperatures. Why is this good? When oil is heated past its smoke point, the fat starts to break
down, releasing free radicals and any health benefit that the oil had is lost.

### EXTRA VIRGIN COLD PRESSED

Extra Virgin is the highest grade of avocado oil, produced from the pressing of good quality
avocados. Produced at low temperatures, without chemicals the oil is 100% pure and natural. Cold
pressing from the first press of the avocado fruit means retains the same high level of nutrients,
natural flavour, aroma and colour found in fresh avocado.

### 16 AVOCADOS IN EVERY BOTTLE

Every one of our 250ml bottles contains 16 cold pressed avocados. Quality Avocado Oil should have a
taste and colour characteristics of the fresh avocado fruit and be a dark vibrant green. We house
our oil in dark glass bottles, which keeps out light and oxygen retaining the quality of the oil

# Golden Circle 

Your Strategic Partner in Olive Oil, Avocado Oil & Gourmet Products Trade

[Let's Talk][5]

## About Golden Circle 

Golden Circle is an international food trading and brokerage firm specializing in olive oil, avocado
oil, edible oils, and gourmet products. We connect premium producers from Spain, Italy, Turkey,
Tunisia, Chile, Peru, Kenya, and Tanzania with importers, distributors, and retail chains across
Europe, the Americas, and beyond.
 

Whether you need bulk supply, private label solutions, or branded products, we tailor every
operation to your market, your specs, and your margins. With first-hand industry knowledge and a
network built at ANUGA, SIAL, Gulfood, and the World Olive Oil Exhibition, we help buyers anticipate
where the market is heading and move first on high-growth categories like avocado oil.

[Learn More][6]
[Image by Lucio Patone]

## Our Services

What We Offer

Golden Circle provides a comprehensive range of services to facilitate international trade. Our
offerings include tailored solutions for local and global transportation, freight forwarding,
warehousing, and storage, ensuring a seamless and reliable supply chain.

### Export Trading & Brokerage

We connect producers with qualified international buyers, managing the full commercial cycle: from
sourcing and negotiation to samples, pricing, and deal execution. Our focus is on protecting margins
and building sustainable trade flows.

### Buyer & Importer Identification

We identify and qualify the right buyers for your product and target market - importers,
distributors, retail chains, and HORECA operators. Every connection is vetted for commercial fit,
compliance, and long-term potential.

### Market Entry & Development

Expanding into a new market or a new category? We provide structured go-to-market strategies backed
by local insights, competitive analysis, and pricing intelligence. We help you spot emerging
opportunities - like avocado oil - and enter as a pioneer, not a follower. From Europe to the
Americas to East Africa, we help you grow with confidence.

### Long-Term Partnerships

We don't do one-off transactions. Every relationship we build is designed to scale. We work
alongside our clients as their international trade partner, adapting to market shifts and unlocking
new opportunities together.

# From all corners of the world to your table

# Welcome to Good Earth

At Good Earth, our passion is for food, people, the earth we share and the air we breathe.
We are committed to sourcing and providing unrefined, natural and organic food products. Likewise we
encourage you to live a healthier, more natural lifestyle and to become more aware of our planet’s
well-being and sustainability. Our portfolio spans all 5 continents of the world allowing us to
carry hundreds of healthy, natural and organic products. So if you are on a restricted or a free
from diet you can find lots of products which are good for you, gluten free, wheat free, dairy free
and other delicious foods!

maximize your efficiency.

# About Us

“We don’t just supply commodities. We deliver consistency, quality, and trust in every shipment.
From sourcing to export, every product reflects our commitment to global standards.”

Goshen Agro Commodities Limited*

[leaf] Trusted Agro Export Company

## Premium Agro Commodities export from across Africa and beyond

Goshen Agro Commodities Limited bridges the gap between Africa’s rich agricultural heritage and the
global marketplace. By integrating a traceable supply chain with sustainable local sourcing, we
deliver premium-grade commodities to international partners while empowering the farming communities
that grow them.

###### Business Focus:

Sourcing, aggregation, processing, and export of premium agricultural commodities while
strengthening rural farmer capacity in sustainable agriculture

## Services We Offer

We streamline the agricultural journey at Goshen Agro Commodities Limited. By overseeing everything
from sourcing to shipping, we take the stress out of the supply chain and deliver quality you can
trust.

This helps us maintain consistent supply and ensure product quality from the source.] ][155]

About Green Turkey
Green Turkey is a leading company in agricultural engineering and investment in Turkey.
We work in agricultural engineering, backed by extensive experience and a specialized team. Green Turkey brings together a group of agricultural engineers with both scientific and practical expertise across various fields, including garden design and landscaping, agricultural project implementation, irrigation network design, plant protection, project management, and performance evaluation. The team is also proficient in technical office operations. This diversity equips us with a comprehensive ability to provide precise, well-studied, and integrated solutions—both scientifically and operationally.

Equality

Quality

Work Process

At Green Turkey, we ensure that working with us is a clear, organized experience—built on transparency and mutual understanding from start to finish.
Initial Consultation
An introductory meeting (in-person or remote) is held to understand the client's needs, site, and available budget.
Site Visit and Assessment
To evaluate environmental and physical conditions and determine technical parameters.
Preliminary Design and Technical Proposal
A draft plan is prepared with a realistic visual concept (2D or 3D), along with a detailed offer outlining phases and costs.
Contract Signing
An agreement is signed upon approval of the details, including a clear timeline and implementation plan.
Project Execution
Professional management of all implementation phases, with direct supervision and documentation through drawings and photos.
Project Delivery and Follow-Up
Final delivery is completed along with an operation manual and optional post-implementation support as agreed.
Official Documentation
Each client receives a formal copy of the contract and project schedule before execution to ensure complete clarity and mutual understanding.
On-Demand Technical Support
Remote consultations are available to answer inquiries related to plants, irrigation systems, or environmental conditions.

## Con amor y cuidado, llevamos
## productos de alta calidad a tu mesa.

[
ATÚN

### Atún en Hojuelas en Agua

Atún HERDEZ® en hojuelas es un alimento saludable, práctico y versátil, con excelente sabor y
consistencia. En sus presentaciones en agua o en aceite puede consumirse fácilmente en un sinfín de
preparaciones deliciosas ya que está listo para consumirse frío o caliente. ¡Atrévete a integrarlo a
tus recetas, será el ingrediente perfecto! Prueba sus presentaciones de 130 y 295 gramos.

][19]
[
SALSAS

### Salsa de Guacamole Picante

Salsa de Guacamole HERDEZ® es la consentida de toda la familia por su delicioso sabor, toque de
picor y consistencia ideal para acompañar tus antojitos favoritos en todo momento. Disponible en 3
presentaciones: 240, 440g y 670g.

][20]
[
VEGETALES

### Granos de Elote

Los granos de elote amarillo HERDEZ® se han colocado como uno de los productos estrella, ya que su
frescura, sabor y consistencia son el toque ideal para cada platillo, llevando la tradición de la
comida mexicana a tu mesa.

][21]
[
TOMATES MOLIDOS

### Tomates Molidos Condimentados

Los deliciosos Tomates Molidos Condimentados Herdez® son el mejor aliado en tu cocina dándole un
toque especial a tus recetas, además de que todos sus ingredientes son naturales y están libres de
conservadores gracias a su envase Tetra Pak que evita el paso de materiales externos. Su gran sabor
y color será la base de todos tus platillos para que alcancen el sazón que tanto le gusta a tu
familia.

][22]
[
CHILES

### Jalapeños Enteros en Escabeche

Los tradicionales chiles jalapeños en rajas de HERDEZ® están elaborados con cosechas de alta calidad
en sus presentaciones 220g, 380g y 2.8Kg.

][23]
[
CHAMPIÑONES

### Champiñones Rebanados

Los champiñones rebanados HERDEZ® tienen ingredientes de origen 100% natural y estando libres de
conservadores se vuelven una deliciosa y nutritiva alternativa para toda la familia. Puedes usarlos
como guarnición con una arrachera o acompañados de una rica milanesa de pollo. Son tan versátiles
que tendrás una amplia variedad de opciones.

][24]
Con amor y cuidado, llevamos
productos de alta calidad a tu mesa.

Los deliciosos Tomates Molidos Condimentados Herdez® son el mejor aliado en tu cocina dándole un

conservadores gracias a su envase Tetra Pak que evita el paso de materiales externos. Su gran sabor

CHILES

Los champiñones rebanados HERDEZ® tienen ingredientes de origen 100% natural y estando libres de

May 15, 2025

Chef Derek Bugge takes a minute to talk about one of the most underutilized seafoods that he’s seen
in the restaurant industry, and that is scallops. ... [Read More][28]

Tags: [menu][29], [Videos][30]

Hello, Neighbor

## Local Like You.

Harbor Foodservice has been supplying northwest restaurant owners with everything they need for over
four generations. From the beginning, we’ve been family-owned and operated, and our reps, drivers,
and staff eat from the same kitchens we supply. It’s what sets us apart, and we wouldn’t have it any
other way.

[About Harbor][31]

Harbor Products

## Yep.
## We've got it.

As a broadline distributor, we have well over 10,000 individual products, 17 exclusive premier
brands, plus the farm-fresh, locally-sourced products your customers expect. Simply put, your Harbor
rep can set you up with everything you need to ensure your restaurant succeeds.

[Products Overview][32]

Season of Giving

## HarborCares

HarborCares is about being in-service of others, investing in relationships, and putting our values
into action.

[Learn More][33]

### Proud to serve thousands of operators throughout our food community.

### We are proud to do business with some very special vendor partners.

##### See what makes them so special.

[learn more][34]

Harbor Solutions

## We're in this together

We all know this is a tough business, and it helps to have expert friends that care. So, we’ve put
together an array of services to help our customers succeed. Our restaurant consultants can provide
operational reviews to help identify problem areas, inspiring new menu ideas from Chef Derek, and a
suite of articles, podcast interviews, videos and other resources. We make your success our
business.

[Consulting Solutions][35]

[Resources & Guidance][36]

Your Team

## Here to support your operation.

Harbor Foodservice has Team Members everywhere, but the one that matters most is yours. Introduce
yourself and let a rep that knows your neighborhood show you what Harbor can do for you.

### Delivering Goodness.

#### **From our neighborhood to yours.**

Stay up-to-date

## Market reports

We have compiled reports and update them on a regular basis so you stay up-to-date on the
commodities you use the most.

[Beef Market Report][19]

[Produce Market Report][20]

[Seafood Market Report][21]

News

###### [Celebrating over 100 years of delivering goodness][22]

October 31, 2025

Over a century ago, a Swedish immigrant named Carl V. Erickson arrived in Aberdeen, Washington, with
a dream and a work ethic that would lay the found... [Read More][23]

Tags: [100 years][24]

News

###### [Harbor Foods Named One of Washington’s Best Workplaces for Fourth Consecutive Year][25]

September 18, 2025

For the fourth year in a row, Harbor Foods has been recognized by the Puget Sound Business Journal
as one of Washington’s Best Workplaces. This honor ... [Read More][26]

Tags:

Videos

###### [Pierport Scallops with Chef Derek][27]

May 15, 2025

Chef Derek Bugge takes a minute to talk about one of the most underutilized seafoods that he’s seen
in the restaurant industry, and that is scallops. ... [Read More][28]

Tags: [menu][29], [Videos][30]

Hello, Neighbor

## Local Like You.

Harbor Foodservice has been supplying northwest restaurant owners with everything they need for over
four generations. From the beginning, we’ve been family-owned and operated, and our reps, drivers,
and staff eat from the same kitchens we supply. It’s what sets us apart, and we wouldn’t have it any
other way.

[About Harbor][31]

Harbor Products

## Yep.
## We've got it.

As a broadline distributor, we have well over 10,000 individual products, 17 exclusive premier
brands, plus the farm-fresh, locally-sourced products your customers expect. Simply put, your Harbor
rep can set you up with everything you need to ensure your restaurant succeeds.

[Products Overview][32]

Season of Giving

## HarborCares

HarborCares is about being in-service of others, investing in relationships, and putting our values
into action.

[Learn More][33]

### Proud to serve thousands of operators throughout our food community.

### We are proud to do business with some very special vendor partners.

##### See what makes them so special.

[learn more][34]

Harbor Solutions

## We're in this together

We all know this is a tough business, and it helps to have expert friends that care. So, we’ve put
together an array of services to help our customers succeed. Our restaurant consultants can provide
operational reviews to help identify problem areas, inspiring new menu ideas from Chef Derek, and a
suite of articles, podcast interviews, videos and other resources. We make your success our
business.

[Consulting Solutions][35]

[Resources & Guidance][36]

Your Team

## Here to support your operation.

Harbor Foodservice has Team Members everywhere, but the one that matters most is yours. Introduce
yourself and let a rep that knows your neighborhood show you what Harbor can do for you.

## Why Hummingbird Wholesale

Our business isn’t just selling food. It’s about stewardship, sustainability, and literally changing
the world (yes, we’re idealists!).

## We go out of our way to work with regional farmers who are dedicated to organic practices.

[Organic Wholesale Ingredients]

## Through our Farm Connections® program, we help support farmers’ honest challenging work.

## We call this “distributor supported agriculture.” The goal is to nourish everyone.

## While also keeping the soil, air and water healthy (not to mention the bees)!

## And helping sustain our local rural communities.

## Welcome. We are an Employee Owned organic food producer
## and distributor, based in Eugene, Oregon.

[The Birds of Hummingbird 2022]

Join us in this collaborative effort to build a better food system.

We are all in it together.

## Where Hummingbird Wholesale’s food comes from

Most of our products are grown right here in the bountiful Pacific Northwest, along with select
other suppliers around the world.

## Why Hummingbird Wholesale

Our business isn’t just selling food. It’s about stewardship, sustainability, and literally changing
the world (yes, we’re idealists!).

## We go out of our way to work with regional farmers who are dedicated to organic practices.

[Organic Wholesale Ingredients]

## Through our Farm Connections® program, we help support farmers’ honest challenging work.

## We call this “distributor supported agriculture.” The goal is to nourish everyone.

## While also keeping the soil, air and water healthy (not to mention the bees)!

## And helping sustain our local rural communities.

## Welcome. We are an Employee Owned organic food producer
## and distributor, based in Eugene, Oregon.

[The Birds of Hummingbird 2022]

Join us in this collaborative effort to build a better food system.

We are all in it together.

## Where Hummingbird Wholesale’s food comes from

Most of our products are grown right here in the bountiful Pacific Northwest, along with select
other suppliers around the world.

[Browse our products][75]

## What our customers say
* “Hummingbird is my favorite distributor — an ethical business that seeks to create a sustainable
  future.”
  
  **Kwah Wa’Adabi,
  Bulk Buyer,
  People’s Food Coop,
  Portland, Oregon**
* “Hummingbird is a special place, full of enthusiastic, dedicated people on a wonderful mission.”
  
  **Tom Williams,
  Williams Hudson Bay Farm,
  Milton-Freewater, Oregon**
* “Consistency of product and availability has been fantastic. In fact, Hummingbird is fantastic on
  every level.”
  
  **Christy Goldsby,
  Honey Mama’s,
  Portland, Oregon**

[Hummingbird Wholesale]

Sip the nectar without harming the flower®

[Hydrite Corporate Office]

# Providing Creative Solutions

Hydrite, founded in 1929, is a leading North American manufacturer delivering innovative,
high-quality integrated chemical programs across industries—including food and beverage,
agriculture, and manufactured solutions—backed by technical expertise, responsive service, and
custom manufacturing capabilities.

[platter with an assortment of cheeses]

## Our Industries

Serving customers the elements of success for over 95 years, Hydrite is a trusted leader in North
American chemical manufacturing and distribution, supplying businesses across a wide range of
industries and markets.

[Our Industries][52]

[water flowing]

## Our Solutions

We aim to provide creative products and solutions that support our customers’ goals, backed by a
robust supply network and growing team of technical expertise.

[Our Solutions][53]

[Hydrite Office]

## careers: Great teams start with good chemistry.

Since the beginning, our employees have been the driving force in our success. Our core building
blocks of integrity, innovation, safety & quality, people, and responsible growth help us build and
empower an industry-leading team.

[Careers][54]

 

[Gen Chemical Historical photo]

## Our Mission

Providing sustainable ideas and solutions that ensure Customer, Employee and Partner success.

 

[Read more][55]

[12th street warehouse historical photo]

## Our Story

Founded in Milwaukee, WI on February 5, 1929, the name Hydrite came from the idea that using our
chemicals would tan “hyde right”.


 

[Read more][56]

[Our Community]

## Our Community

Hydrite has a long history of supporting the communities where we work and live through charitable
giving and volunteerism.

[Read more][57]

[Cottage Grove Plant]

## Our Locations

Our nationwide network supported by a private fleet of trucks & tankers is built to serve our
customers' needs.

[Read more][58]

### Hydrite® Earns WI Safety Council Corporate Safety Award  

Hydrite® introduced a robust safety program to reinvigorate and drive a One Hydrite safety culture
across the organization.

 

[Read More][59]

[[Wisconsin Safety Council Corporate Safety Award]][60]

### Hydrite® Named Winner of 2025 Top Workplaces Award

Hydrite® was recognized as a 2025 Top Workplaces award winner by the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel for
creating high employee experience and exceptional workplaces. Hydrite has won Top Workplaces eight
other years in the past.

 

[Read More][61]

[[2025 Top Workplaces Award]][62]

### Hydrite® Announces the Acquisition of Enterprise Specialty Products, Inc.

#### Welcome To " Indian Spice Oil Industries "

A Indian Spice Oil Industries is a leading name in the world of Natural Essential Oils. Our oils are
best known for it's Quality, Purity, Effectiveness and High Medicinal Value .

### ABOUT US

Our range is recognized globally for purity, effectiveness, high medicinal value and quality. Thus,
these are demanded in food processing, perfume manufacturing, cosmetics and pharmaceutical
industries, spa and aromatherapy center. We ensure to deliver best quality natural products as we
practice constant quality checking procedures in our working methodology. [Read More][85]

* ## Ajwain Seed Oil
  
  Ajwain is used as medicinal plant in traditional Ayurvedic medicine; primarily for stomach
  disorders such as indigestion, flatulence.
* [[ajwain oil]][86]

* ## Basil Oil
  
  Basil Oil is a highly aromatic essential oil known for its refreshing herbal aroma, strong
  antibacterial properties.
* [[basil oil]][87]

* ## Celery Seed Oil
  
  Celery (Apium graveolens) is a marshland plant in the family Apiaceae that has been cultivated as
  a vegetable since antiquity.

* ## Dill seed Oil
  
  Dill Seed (Anethum graveolens) is an annual herb in the celery family Apiaceae. It is the only
  species in the genus Anethum.
* 

* ## Fennel Seed Oil
  
  Fennel (Foeniculum vulgare) is a flowering plant species in the carrot family. It is a hardy,
  perennial herb with yellow flowers and feathery leaves.

* ## Thymol Natural
  
  Thymol is a natural monoterpene phenol derivative of cymene, C10H14O, isomeric with carvacrol,
  found in oil of Ajwain.

# Pearfectly fruit

## Kwaliteit door controle over de keten

Oskam beheerst elke stap in de keten, waardoor we in staat zijn om hardfruitproducten van
topkwaliteit snel, efficiënt en op maat te leveren – precies wanneer en waar ze nodig zijn.

1951

## Toen en nu

In de jaren ’50 legde Jan Oskam (1926-1994) de basis voor het familiebedrijf. Als zelfstandig
fruitpachter en commissionair was hij actief op de bruisende veilingen rondom Utrecht. 

Wat begon als een eenmanszaak, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een toonaangevend bedrijf in de
hardfruitsector.

Vanuit het fruithart van Nederland beheersen wij alle processen in de keten. Met eigen teelt van
hardfruit, sorteer- en verpakkingsfaciliteiten kunnen we fruit flexibel en snel verpakken en direct
aan onze klanten leveren.

[ Over ons ][17] [ Onze gewassen ][18]

2026

###### Direct van de bron

Onze peren en appels komen rechtstreeks van de bron: onze eigen boomgaarden.

###### Verpakking op maat

Dankzij onze sorteer- en verpakkingsmachines zijn er vele verpakkingsmogelijkheden.

###### Logistiek

Met eigen transport en logistieke partners hebben wij voor elke klant een oplossing.

###### Direct naar de klant

Altijd en snel geleverd op het gewenste moment.

[ Lees hier meer over onze kernwaarden ][19]

## Een greep uit ons aanbod

##### Beurre A. Lucas

Een heerlijke handpeer met een mooie gelijkmatige vorm.

##### Conference

De meest populaire en meest geteelde peer in Nederland.

##### Doyenne du Comice

De koningin onder de peren: prachtig uiterlijk en heerlijke smaak!

##### Red Jonaprince

Rondom rood en heerlijk stevig en lang houdbaar als handappel of te gebruiken in gerechten.

##### Golden Delicious

Prachtig goudgeel van kleur en heerlijk als handappel

##### Elstar

De meeste populaire appel van Nederland met een rode blos en geelgroene ondergrond.

[ Bekijk hier ons gehele assortiment ][20]

## OSKAM in beeld

## Werken bij OSKAM

Heb je een passie voor fruit en lijkt het je leuk om ons team te komen versterken? Bekijk onze
vacatures of stuur een open sollicitatie. We horen graag van je!

[ Bekijk onze vacatures ][21]

## Contact

Heb je een vraag over onze diensten, mogelijkheden of andere zaken, neem dan zeker contact met ons
op via het formulier hiernaast of via onderstaande wegen. Wij nemen dan snel contact met je op.

Our Farms Nation Wide production State of the Art Packhouse Our Global Footprint Life at Keitt

## Our Farms

Keitt Exporters’ farms in Kenya’s fertile highlands use sustainable practices to grow premium
avocados, mangoes, and vegetables. Certified to international standards, we are committed to quality
and community.

## Nation Wide Production

Keitt Exporters, a leading producer of avocados, mangoes, and vegetables, ensures a diverse,
high-quality supply through our vast network of farms and partnerships. We deliver nature’s bounty
directly to you.

## State of the Art Packhouse

Our state-of-the-art packhouse facility, certified BRC Grade-AA, integrates advanced technology and
houses the largest avocado packing line in East and Sub-Saharan Africa. This ensures top-tier
freshness and food safety, supporting our promise to deliver premium produce globally.

## Our Global Footprint

Keitt Exporters proudly serves customers in 25+ countries across Europe, the Middle East, South
Asia, and the Far East, delivering high-quality, sustainably sourced produce. Experience Africa’s
finest taste, no matter where you are.

## Life at keitt

At Keitt, teamwork and excellence drive our diverse staff to innovate and improve. We prioritize
high-quality production, reliable service, customer satisfaction, and sustainable practices to excel
in the agribusiness sector.

## From Africa to the world

Our tagline, ‘From Africa to the World,’ embodies our commitment to bringing the rich, natural
bounty of Kenya to global markets. By harnessing sustainable agricultural practices and leveraging
state-of-the-art technology, we ensure that the freshness and quality of our produce represent the
best of Africa on the world stage.

#### Streamlined logistics for timely delivery.

#### Sustainable practices preserve freshness & quality.

#### Our journey

22-Year Journey Towards Exceptional Growth

## 2002

## Keitt Exporters Established

Keitt Exporters, founded in 2002 by Mr. Asif Amin and Mr. Mihingo Mwangi, began with 4 permanent and
15 casual employees. Today, we have grown to over 200 permanent and 500 casual employees

## 2009

## UFL Inhouse Air logistics Established

UFL United Freight Logistics is our in-house air freight company. Initially focused on clearing and
forwarding for Keitt Exporters, UFL now handles clearing, forwarding, and scanning of cargo for both
Keitt and other clients.

## 2012

## Veg division Established

Initially, we only exported avocados and mangoes to the Middle East. In 2012, we expanded our
offerings by adding a vegetables segment.

## Scaling New Heights

## Our Farms

Keitt Exporters’ farms in Kenya’s fertile highlands use sustainable practices to grow premium
avocados, mangoes, and vegetables. Certified to international standards, we are committed to quality
and community.

## Nation Wide Production

Keitt Exporters, a leading producer of avocados, mangoes, and vegetables, ensures a diverse,
high-quality supply through our vast network of farms and partnerships. We deliver nature’s bounty
directly to you.

## State of the Art Packhouse

Our state-of-the-art packhouse facility, certified BRC Grade-AA, integrates advanced technology and
houses the largest avocado packing line in East and Sub-Saharan Africa. This ensures top-tier
freshness and food safety, supporting our promise to deliver premium produce globally.

## Our Global Footprint

Keitt Exporters proudly serves customers in 25+ countries across Europe, the Middle East, South
Asia, and the Far East, delivering high-quality, sustainably sourced produce. Experience Africa’s
finest taste, no matter where you are.

## Life at keitt

At Keitt, teamwork and excellence drive our diverse staff to innovate and improve. We prioritize
high-quality production, reliable service, customer satisfaction, and sustainable practices to excel
in the agribusiness sector.

## From Africa to the world

Our tagline, ‘From Africa to the World,’ embodies our commitment to bringing the rich, natural
bounty of Kenya to global markets. By harnessing sustainable agricultural practices and leveraging
state-of-the-art technology, we ensure that the freshness and quality of our produce represent the
best of Africa on the world stage.

#### Streamlined logistics for timely delivery.

#### Sustainable practices preserve freshness & quality.

#### Our journey

22-Year Journey Towards Exceptional Growth

## 2002

## Keitt Exporters Established

Keitt Exporters, founded in 2002 by Mr. Asif Amin and Mr. Mihingo Mwangi, began with 4 permanent and
15 casual employees. Today, we have grown to over 200 permanent and 500 casual employees

## 2009

## UFL Inhouse Air logistics Established

UFL United Freight Logistics is our in-house air freight company. Initially focused on clearing and
forwarding for Keitt Exporters, UFL now handles clearing, forwarding, and scanning of cargo for both
Keitt and other clients.

## 2012

## Veg division Established

Initially, we only exported avocados and mangoes to the Middle East. In 2012, we expanded our
offerings by adding a vegetables segment.

## 2012

## Scaling New Heights

We started with an average of 15+ Ton’s/Per week, Now we are standing at an average of 500+ Ton’s of
weekly export volumes.

## 2015

## Subukado Holding Limited

Subukado Holding Limited (Subukia Farm) became part of Keitt Family.

## 2016

## ACE Africa Limited

Meru and Embu Farms become part of Keitt Family

## 2020

## Kenol packhouse Established

Kenol Packhouse, the largest avocado packhouse in East and Sub-Saharan Africa, was established. It
has a capacity of processing 1,500 tons of avocado per week.

## 2021

## Oil Division Established

We ventured into the value addition of extracting Crude avocado oil to support our growers and
smallholder farmers.

## 2022

## Avo Africa Tanzania Established

Avo Africa TZ, a venture of Keitt, marks our expansion into the Tanzanian market for exporting
avocados. Operating within our East African footprint, this venture signifies our commitment to
growth and sustainability.

## 2024

## Commencement of Domestic Market Distribution

In 2024, Keitt began distributing its premium export-quality fruits and vegetable products within
the Kenyan market.

## 2024

## Mara Farm integration

Mara Farm, a 1100-acre farm, has been incorporated under the Keitt umbrella. It is located next to
Kenya’s most popular tourist destination, the Masai Mara

our high standards for freshness and taste.

specializing in air freight clearing and forwarding. With our advanced scanning services, we ensure

high-quality avocados and mangoes for global markets.

finest quality directly to avocado enthusiasts worldwide.

Avo Farms is located near the majestic Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania, specializing in avocado
cultivation across 1800 acres. Our premium avocados thrive in the unique climate and rich soil of

# We clean up after ourselves.

## Ecommerce deliveries have a carbon footprint. That's why we support verified projects that remove
## carbon from the air.

PARTICIPATING BRANDS AND CUSTOMERS HAVE HELPED FUND
83+ million
Carbon-neutral orders
58+ thousand
Tonnes of carbon removed
THAT'S LIKE...
7 billion
Smartphones charged
239 million
Kilometers driven by a gasoline-powered car
HOW IT WORKS

Every delivery’s carbon footprint is calculated based on weight, shipping method, and distance
traveled. We neutralize these emissions by purchasing verified carbon removal credits from
groundbreaking projects.

[44.01 carbon injection site in Oman]
[Climeworks direct air capture facility in Iceland]

With your purchase, you’ll join a community of proactive merchants and customers dedicated to a
sustainable future. Together, we've removed emissions for over 83 million deliveries and removed
over 58 thousand tonnes of carbon.

We work with a network of pioneering carbon removal companies that have been vetted by the commerce
platform Shopify.

## Dependable Worldwide Sourcing

KIC has been a reliable source of chemical products since our formation in 1985. We are
headquartered in Poughkeepsie, NY (approximately 75 miles north of Newark and New York City), and we
maintain numerous stocking locations across the USA and Europe. Through our strong network of
agents, distributors, and suppliers we are able to efficiently, and competitively, distribute our
products on a worldwide basis.

In 1995, KIC became one of the first chemical distributors in the United States to earn ISO
registration. We continue to improve the quality of our distribution services and develop new ways
to meet the needs of our customers.

The products listed on this web site represent only those items that we handle regularly. The full
range of our activities includes the following (we also welcome your inquiries for any products,
whether they appear on our lists or not).

In addition to our merchandise distribution services including RSPO products, we offer the following
consulting assistance to all industries:

– Logistical services and planning

– Marketing strategies and consulting services

Please feel free to contact us for any additional information. We look forward to assisting you with
any requirements you may have!

## INSPIRATION BEHIND LADYBUG JANE

**Ladybug Jane was borne from the vision of chemist Jane May Graves after her mother was diagnosed
with Stage 4 Cancer. **

**Her Mother is a Cancer Survivor. **

**Her Mother’s Cancer awakened her to the importance of avoiding toxic personal care products.**

**As a child, Jane was obsessed with Bonne Bell and Lip Smackers; however, she could no longer use
them after becoming health-conscious and very selective about ingredients.
**

**Compelled by the lack of high moisturizing and nourishing, organic, beeswax-free lip
balm on the market, Jane decided to formulate her own healthy,
nourishing formula.  **

**Uniquely formulated to be ultra healing, non-toxic,organic, vegan, soy-free, petroleum-free, and
FUN! **

][93]

## Join the Ladybug Jane club!

Sign up to receive exclusive promotions and discounts!.

Subscribe

Beeswax is the home of the young bees and their food.

Our purchases reflect our values, so it’s time to make a beeswax-free choice to take a stand for
bees!

Join us in taking the sting out of lip balms!

Ladybug Jane lip balms are made with All Natural, VEGAN, Organic, Cruelty-Free, Plant-based
ingredients. We use only effective and powerful ingredients combined with innovated green chemistry
to ensure even the driest lips will become soft and supple.

Ladybug Jane combines fun with organic vegan ingredients. Each flavor is uniquely created and safe
for those with allergens and sensitivities.

with Stage 4 Cancer. **

**As a child, Jane was obsessed with Bonne Bell and Lip Smackers; however, she could no longer use
them after becoming health-conscious and very selective about ingredients.
**

**Compelled by the lack of high moisturizing and nourishing, organic, beeswax-free lip

**About Us**

## At Leonardi Laboratories, we pride ourselves on our unique approach to crafting high-quality
## aromatherapy products. What sets us apart is our unwavering dedication to excellence and our
## commitment to customer satisfaction.

As a family-owned business led by Joe Leonardi, who brings over three decades of industry
experience, we infuse our passion and expertise into every aspect of our operation. Since our
inception in 2003, we have been driven by a genuine love for our craft and a desire to share the
benefits of aromatherapy with the world.

One aspect that distinguishes us is our extensive clientele base, which includes hotels, resorts,
massage therapists, wholesalers, and individuals seeking premium aromatherapy products. Whether it’s
supplying in bulk to businesses or catering to individual needs, we strive to meet and exceed the
expectations of every customer.

What truly sets us apart is our meticulous sourcing process. We scour the globe for the finest
botanicals, sourcing from Australia and beyond to ensure that only the highest quality ingredients
make their way into our products. From essential oils to carrier oils and base oils, each ingredient
is carefully selected and bottled with precision at our laboratory in Sydney.

Moreover, our dedication to innovation is evident in our in-house research and development efforts.
We continuously explore new formulations and techniques to enhance the efficacy and appeal of our
products. By collaborating closely with our clients, we tailor solutions to meet their specific
needs, ensuring that every product we offer is crafted with care and expertise.

At Leonardi Laboratories, we don’t just sell products; we cultivate experiences. We invite you to
explore our range of aromatherapy essentials and discover the difference that passion, quality, and
expertise can make in your wellness journey.
