**About Us**

## At Leonardi Laboratories, we pride ourselves on our unique approach to crafting high-quality
## aromatherapy products. What sets us apart is our unwavering dedication to excellence and our
## commitment to customer satisfaction.

As a family-owned business led by Joe Leonardi, who brings over three decades of industry
experience, we infuse our passion and expertise into every aspect of our operation. Since our
inception in 2003, we have been driven by a genuine love for our craft and a desire to share the
benefits of aromatherapy with the world.

One aspect that distinguishes us is our extensive clientele base, which includes hotels, resorts,
massage therapists, wholesalers, and individuals seeking premium aromatherapy products. Whether it’s
supplying in bulk to businesses or catering to individual needs, we strive to meet and exceed the
expectations of every customer.

What truly sets us apart is our meticulous sourcing process. We scour the globe for the finest
botanicals, sourcing from Australia and beyond to ensure that only the highest quality ingredients
make their way into our products. From essential oils to carrier oils and base oils, each ingredient
is carefully selected and bottled with precision at our laboratory in Sydney.

Moreover, our dedication to innovation is evident in our in-house research and development efforts.
We continuously explore new formulations and techniques to enhance the efficacy and appeal of our
products. By collaborating closely with our clients, we tailor solutions to meet their specific
needs, ensuring that every product we offer is crafted with care and expertise.

At Leonardi Laboratories, we don’t just sell products; we cultivate experiences. We invite you to
explore our range of aromatherapy essentials and discover the difference that passion, quality, and
expertise can make in your wellness journey.

## Join the network for the fruits and vegetables sector!


Libertyprim helps you develop your business in the fruit and vegetable sector. We offer many
innovative tools suitable for all stakeholders in the industry.

### Services dedicated to each activity

Libertyprim, the solution to connect all professionals in the fruit and vegetable industry:
producers, wholesalers, shippers, distributors, importers, exporters, traders, brokers,
cooperatives, processors, supermarkets, buying centers, greengrocers, restaurateurs, carriers,
horticulturists, equipment providers, professional organizations, etc.

### At a local level

List your business for free on Libertyprim and automatically appear in search results for users
looking for offers, ads, or professionals in your region.

### At an international level

Libertyprim is the gateway to the international market of fruits and vegetables thanks to its
extensive database, your offers will be automatically translated in many languages and made
available to the entire world ! Give your business new commercial opportunities.

### Make yourself visible!

Give your business the best visibility through a network of specific professional buyers. Create
your professional web page and multiply your networking and new contact opportunities. Showcase your
certifications, your production methods and infrastructures, your brands, your zones of activity,
your product lines, and much more information.

### Develop your own commercial strategy

Establish a commercial strategy that suits you thanks to privacy filters available in your
interface, select the sectors of activity that you want to work with. You will this way optimize the
quality and efficiency of your business transactions.

### Receive notifications in real time

Don't miss any opportunity! Set up alerts to be notified in real-time of any new offer or ad that

## Join the network for the fruits and vegetables sector!


Libertyprim helps you develop your business in the fruit and vegetable sector. We offer many
innovative tools suitable for all stakeholders in the industry.

### Services dedicated to each activity

Libertyprim, the solution to connect all professionals in the fruit and vegetable industry:
producers, wholesalers, shippers, distributors, importers, exporters, traders, brokers,
cooperatives, processors, supermarkets, buying centers, greengrocers, restaurateurs, carriers,
horticulturists, equipment providers, professional organizations, etc.

### At a local level

List your business for free on Libertyprim and automatically appear in search results for users
looking for offers, ads, or professionals in your region.

### At an international level

Libertyprim is the gateway to the international market of fruits and vegetables thanks to its
extensive database, your offers will be automatically translated in many languages and made
available to the entire world ! Give your business new commercial opportunities.

### Make yourself visible!

Give your business the best visibility through a network of specific professional buyers. Create
your professional web page and multiply your networking and new contact opportunities. Showcase your
certifications, your production methods and infrastructures, your brands, your zones of activity,
your product lines, and much more information.

### Develop your own commercial strategy

Establish a commercial strategy that suits you thanks to privacy filters available in your
interface, select the sectors of activity that you want to work with. You will this way optimize the
quality and efficiency of your business transactions.

### Receive notifications in real time

Don't miss any opportunity! Set up alerts to be notified in real-time of any new offer or ad that
matches your criteria.

## Why Choose MacroTech for Your Wholesale WPC Decking Suppliers?

[Stable Production Capacity]
Stable Production Capacity

MacroTech completed its capacity upgrade in 2025. With over 40 automated production lines and an
annual capacity of up to 50,000 tons, even during peak sales seasons, wholesalers can flexibly
replenish and supply goods according to market demand.

We maintain long-term partnerships with upstream raw material suppliers, keeping a constant safety
stock to effectively mitigate issues such as raw material shortages, price fluctuations, and supply
delays.

[Reliable Quality]
Reliable Quality

MacroTech factory is ISO 9001/CE/FSC-certified and equipped with a professional quality inspection
team of 5 people to conduct sampling inspections, comparisons, and confirmations for large orders.
Third-party inspection (SGS) is also supported.

We implement a multi-stage traceable quality control system. Each production link is strictly
monitored and data is digitally recorded. From raw material intake, processing, finished wpc decking
inspection to outbound shipment, the entire process is under closed-loop control, and every step is
traceable and verifiable.

[Efficient Logistics]
Efficient Logistics

Standard delivery time is 15 days. Our export team also provides high-density, space-optimized
container loading/LCL solutions, maximizing container capacity by considering shipment quantity,
size, weight, and stacking methods to help you save on ocean freight costs.

Our advantageous geographical location (adjacent to Tianjin Port, only a 3-hour drive) and our
customized integrated packing and LCL solutions help you ship quickly and efficiently while saving
on overall procurement costs.

[OEM]
OEM/ODM and Engineering Support

MacroTech supports color/mold/logo customization (nda confidentiality agreement required), provides
a 15-year warranty, and offers installation guidance and technical documentation.

MacroTech offers full-cycle, one-stop engineering support services, from solution planning, WPC
decking selection, compatibility calculations to implementation and delivery. Our sales staff and
factory professionals are involved throughout the project, providing reasonable compatibility
advice.

# WELCOME TO MADANA INC.

MADANA Inc. is a worldwide multi-cultural business dedicated to building mutually rewarding
relationships with our suppliers and improving sustainability in the communities they produce in.
Our guiding principle, to be both an economic and social asset to each community in which we do
business, has propelled MADANA Inc.’s success and allowed us to bring innovative products and
business solutions to the market for over 15 years.

Values That Span Generations

# OUR PROMISE
* ### QUALITY
  
  MADANA Inc. and partners will always strive to produce and distribute products of the highest
  quality.
* ### SOCIAL RESPONSIBILITY
  
  MADANA Inc. and its partners will always do everything in their power to promote social
  responsibility in all aspects of their business.
* ### ENVIRONMENTAL STEWARDSHIP
  
  The MADANA family will always put the environment first through conservation and sustainable
  practices.
* ### PASSION
  
  Our team and partners will be passionate about their work, mission and the impact that they are
  having in other peoples lives.
* ### HERITAGE
  
  MADANA Inc. takes pride in working families with a long standing heritage and keeping their
  traditions alive.
* ### TRADITION
  
  One of MADANA’s goals is to help families keep their long time established and inherited
  traditions alive.

## Our Core Advantages

### 100% Pure Natural Plant Oil

As a professional bulk plant oil supplier, we adopt cold-pressed low-temperature extraction to
retain active ingredients of raw materials. Every batch of carrier oil, herbal essential oil and
cosmetic plant oil passes strict GC-MS testing, with official COA, MSDS and microbial test reports
provided. Zero adulteration guarantees stable raw material quality for skincare, dietary supplement
and aromatherapy brands to avoid batch difference risks in bulk procurement.

### Complete OEM, ODM & OBM Service

We offer flexible bulk plant oil customization service for global wholesale buyers, supporting
technical index adjustment, formula optimization, private label packaging and exclusive
specification production. Our low MOQ trial bulk order solution helps new brands test market risk,
providing one-stop raw material customization solutions for cosmetic, health care and home fragrance
manufacturers worldwide.

### 5000+ Tons Annual Stable Supply

Our standardized production workshop realizes large-scale continuous manufacturing, supporting 5000+
tons annual bulk plant oil supply. We provide flexible packaging options including iron drums and
IBC tote tanks to meet large-volume export procurement demands. Stable stock ensures on-time
delivery for global raw material importers and avoids production suspension caused by delayed bulk
order shipment.

### 24-Hour Fast Technical Support

Our professional foreign trade and technical team provides 24-hour online fast response for global
bulk plant oil buyers. We offer targeted raw material application solutions, full sets of export
qualification documents and customs clearance guidance, helping overseas B2B importers smoothly
complete customs declaration and reduce communication & logistics risks in cross-border bulk raw
material procurement.

### Xi'an Qinyuan Quantum Biotechnology Co., Ltd.

Maxplantoil is exclusive export brand of Xi’an Qinyuan Quantum Biotechnology Co., Ltd. All
production, test and legal liability belong to Xi’an Qinyuan Quantum Biotechnology Co., Ltd.Focused
on cold-pressed natural vegetable oil and essential oil raw material production, we supply REACH &
IFRA-compliant bulk oils for skincare, nutraceutical, and home fragrance industries, offering
flexible low-MOQ bulk supply and full custom formulation services worldwide.

## Our Core Advantages

As a professional bulk plant oil supplier, we adopt cold-pressed low-temperature extraction to
retain active ingredients of raw materials. Every batch of carrier oil, herbal essential oil and
cosmetic plant oil passes strict GC-MS testing, with official COA, MSDS and microbial test reports
provided. Zero adulteration guarantees stable raw material quality for skincare, dietary supplement
and aromatherapy brands to avoid batch difference risks in bulk procurement.

### Complete OEM, ODM & OBM Service

We offer flexible bulk plant oil customization service for global wholesale buyers, supporting
technical index adjustment, formula optimization, private label packaging and exclusive
specification production. Our low MOQ trial bulk order solution helps new brands test market risk,
providing one-stop raw material customization solutions for cosmetic, health care and home fragrance
manufacturers worldwide.

Our standardized production workshop realizes large-scale continuous manufacturing, supporting 5000+
tons annual bulk plant oil supply. We provide flexible packaging options including iron drums and
IBC tote tanks to meet large-volume export procurement demands. Stable stock ensures on-time
delivery for global raw material importers and avoids production suspension caused by delayed bulk
order shipment.

bulk plant oil buyers. We offer targeted raw material application solutions, full sets of export

  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and

  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients, dyes
  or unknown substances.

  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.

  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this

## What makes us stand out of the crowd?
* ### Consistency
  
  All of our products are created using the same extraction process in the same facility, which
  creates consistency. This ensures that you will receive a product that’s always reliable and
  effective.
* ### Premium Grade
  
  Our products are considered premium grade because they are manufactured using the highest
  standards. We only offer products of the highest purity with no binders, fillers, excipients, dyes
  or unknown substances.
* ### Every Batch is Tested
  
  Our standards are rigorous and thorough. We test every single batch of our herbs and oils  through
  a third-party lab to ensure that the products you receive are the highest quality available,
  without pesticides or heavy metals.
* ### Customer Support
  
  We stand behind our products and reputation with something more than professional pride — this
  company is truly a labor of love, and it shows in every moment of your shopping experience. We
  always provide world-class customer support.
* ### Low MOQ
  
  We know that every big company had a small beginning. Hence, We offer even smaller quantities and
  Low Minimum Order Quantity requirement.
* ### Co-Packing & Contract Manufacturing

# 

# ABOUT US


**Our Mission**
We are a Mexican company dedicated to the production, transformation, commercialization and export
of avocado and derivatives at a global level, through the sustainability of our processes and
through an organizational ethic based on collaborative work with its stakeholders.
**Our Vision**
Being one of the best Mexican companies in the avocado and derivatives industry, recognized for the
quality of our products, for our commitment to the environment, for the development of our
collaborators and our operational excellence.
**Our Commitment**
We are committed to socially responsible management as part of our business strategy, having a
positive impact on the quality of life of our employees, the community that surrounds us and the
environment.
**The Future**
At MEVI Avocados we approach the future with passion and confidence, with an enduring belief in the
promise of avocado, a superfood that promotes the health and well-being of our consumers.

MEVI's foundation lies in 5 CORE VALUES:
**TRUST** We make sure that everyone involved with our company works with the same high purpose and
ethics, driving significant positive outcomes for our company and industry.
**RESPONSABILITY** We are committed to supplying exclusively healthy products, like the avocado and
its derivatives.
**HONESTY** We combine professionalism with integrity in all aspects of our business, including team
members and suppliers.
**RESPECT** We recognize the capabilities and achievements of clients, team members and suppliers.
**CUSTOMER SERVICE** We offer excellent personalized attention and responsiveness from the moment of
purchase until the delivery of our products, with the aim of fulfilling and exceeding the
expectations of our customers.

**ADVANTAGES OF OUR SERVICE**
Experience: Overall knowledge of production and management of avocados since 1974. Market experience
as a packer since 1994, and as an exporter―through APEAM―since 2003. Balanced Value Chain Method:
MEVI pledges to provide the best service through this process, ensuring full control from planting
the avocado, to its storage and distribution.

capacity that serves as a primary distribution point.

of avocado and derivatives at a global level, through the sustainability of our processes and
through an organizational ethic based on collaborative work with its stakeholders.
**Our Vision**
Being one of the best Mexican companies in the avocado and derivatives industry, recognized for the
quality of our products, for our commitment to the environment, for the development of our
collaborators and our operational excellence.
**Our Commitment**
We are committed to socially responsible management as part of our business strategy, having a
positive impact on the quality of life of our employees, the community that surrounds us and the
environment.
**The Future**
At MEVI Avocados we approach the future with passion and confidence, with an enduring belief in the
promise of avocado, a superfood that promotes the health and well-being of our consumers.

MEVI's foundation lies in 5 CORE VALUES:
**TRUST** We make sure that everyone involved with our company works with the same high purpose and
ethics, driving significant positive outcomes for our company and industry.
**RESPONSABILITY** We are committed to supplying exclusively healthy products, like the avocado and
its derivatives.
**HONESTY** We combine professionalism with integrity in all aspects of our business, including team
members and suppliers.
**RESPECT** We recognize the capabilities and achievements of clients, team members and suppliers.
**CUSTOMER SERVICE** We offer excellent personalized attention and responsiveness from the moment of
purchase until the delivery of our products, with the aim of fulfilling and exceeding the
expectations of our customers.

**ADVANTAGES OF OUR SERVICE**
Experience: Overall knowledge of production and management of avocados since 1974. Market experience
as a packer since 1994, and as an exporter―through APEAM―since 2003. Balanced Value Chain Method:
MEVI pledges to provide the best service through this process, ensuring full control from planting
the avocado, to its storage and distribution.

# BECAUSE WE CARE ABOUT THE JOURNEY
# FROM FIELD TO PLATE

## The Freshest Ingredients Start in the Field

At Markon, we’re redefining fresh. And that means being there on every step of the journey from
field to plate. We purchase fresh fruits, vegetables, and juices for North America’s best-known
foodservice companies for over 40 years, earning our reputation as the most trusted and innovative
leader in the industry. Our Boots in the Field inspectors, our 5-Star Food Safety program, and our
exclusive brands – Markon First Crop, Ready-Set-Serve, and Markon Essentials – help us ensure that
chefs can put the freshest produce on plates while saving time and labor in the kitchen.

[ The Markon Difference ][45]
[Tractor on a farm]

###### Origin

Quality starts with the seed.

[Crops in a field]

###### Journey

Traceability every step of the way.

[innovation]

###### Innovation Through Community

Connecting our chefs to our farmers.

### Farm-To-Table Solutions for Every Need

Markon’s premium commodity and value-added brands are available exclusively at our [five member
companies][46]. Markon’s scalable solutions offer high-quality, time- and cost-saving options for
your foodservice operation. No matter your size, Markon is here to help you put the freshest produce
on your table. Never settle for less than our premium brands: see which of our members is in your
region to have our fresh produce program shipped to your restaurant kitchen.



[ View All Produce ][47]
[Markon First Crop<sup>®</sup>]

#### Markon First Crop^{®}

Markon’s signature brand offers the highest quality whole fruits and vegetables for premium
farm-to-table execution.

[Discover Markon First Crop][48]
[Ready-Set-Serve<sup>®</sup> by Markon]

#### Ready-Set-Serve^{®} by Markon

Less prep. More perfection. Ready-Set-Serve provides efficiency for your kitchen while letting your
chefs focus on flavor and creativity.

[Discover Ready-Set-Serve][49]
[Markon Essentials<sup>®</sup>]

#### Markon Essentials^{®}

Produce essentials at a value. Markon’s value line provides you with quality, flavorful ingredients
for when appearances don’t matter.

[Discover Markon Essentials][50]

##### Put Markon on Your Plate

Our farm fresh produce is available where you are. Our experienced team works with you to find
scalable solutions that fit your needs. We’ll take care of providing you the highest quality,
freshest ingredients so you can focus on crafting inspired, creative culinary experiences.

[ Do Business with Us ][51]

# BECAUSE WE CARE ABOUT THE JOURNEY
# FROM FIELD TO PLATE

## The Freshest Ingredients Start in the Field

At Markon, we’re redefining fresh. And that means being there on every step of the journey from
field to plate. We purchase fresh fruits, vegetables, and juices for North America’s best-known
foodservice companies for over 40 years, earning our reputation as the most trusted and innovative
leader in the industry. Our Boots in the Field inspectors, our 5-Star Food Safety program, and our
exclusive brands – Markon First Crop, Ready-Set-Serve, and Markon Essentials – help us ensure that
chefs can put the freshest produce on plates while saving time and labor in the kitchen.

[ The Markon Difference ][45]
[Tractor on a farm]

###### Origin

Quality starts with the seed.

[Crops in a field]

###### Journey

Traceability every step of the way.

[innovation]

###### Innovation Through Community

Connecting our chefs to our farmers.

### Farm-To-Table Solutions for Every Need

Markon’s premium commodity and value-added brands are available exclusively at our [five member
companies][46]. Markon’s scalable solutions offer high-quality, time- and cost-saving options for
your foodservice operation. No matter your size, Markon is here to help you put the freshest produce
on your table. Never settle for less than our premium brands: see which of our members is in your
region to have our fresh produce program shipped to your restaurant kitchen.



[ View All Produce ][47]
[Markon First Crop<sup>®</sup>]

Markon’s signature brand offers the highest quality whole fruits and vegetables for premium
farm-to-table execution.

[Ready-Set-Serve<sup>®</sup> by Markon]

#### Ready-Set-Serve^{®} by Markon

Less prep. More perfection. Ready-Set-Serve provides efficiency for your kitchen while letting your
chefs focus on flavor and creativity.

[Discover Ready-Set-Serve][49]
[Markon Essentials<sup>®</sup>]

#### Markon Essentials^{®}

Produce essentials at a value. Markon’s value line provides you with quality, flavorful ingredients
for when appearances don’t matter.

[Discover Markon Essentials][50]

##### Put Markon on Your Plate

Our farm fresh produce is available where you are. Our experienced team works with you to find

# MayMyoAvocado

Avocado Excellence, Rooted in Myanmar.

## Who are we?

MayMyoAvocado is a modern agribusiness rooted in the fertile highlands of Myanmar, cultivating over
200 acres of premium avocado varieties — including Hass, Booth 7, Vietnamese 034, Buccaneer and
Amara — with an unwavering commitment to quality and consistency in every harvest. 

Guided by GlobalG.A.P., Myanmar GAP , and HACCP certifications, we deliver a full portfolio of
traceable avocado products — from fresh fruit and Extra Virgin Avocado Oil to Virgin Oil and IQF
Frozen Avocado — through partnerships with certified processing facilities that meet the highest
international food safety standards. Serving both local markets and ASEAN export destinations,
MayMyoAvocado brings the richness of Myanmar's highland terroir directly to importers, distributors,
and foodservice operators who demand a reliable, premium supply partner.
* [viber_image_2025-07-10_15-03-40-562]
* [viber_image_2025-07-10_09-27-54-494]
* [photo_2026-05-11 5.44.06 PM]
* [photo_2026-05-11 5.44.05 PM]
* [photo_2026-05-11 5.44.03 PM]
* [photo_2026-05-11 5.44.12 PM]
* [photo_2026-05-11 5.44.14 PM]
* [viber_image_2025-07-10_15-03-48-658]

## Meet Our Farm

**MayMyoAvocado Farm** is a modern highland avocado farm nestled in Pyin Oo Lwin, Myanmar — situated
at over 4,000 feet above sea level where volcanic soil, natural rainfall, and nighttime temperatures
of 8–14°C create the perfect growing conditions for premium avocados. Spanning 200 acres with over
20,000 trees across five carefully selected varieties — Hass, Booth 7, Vietnamese 034, Amara, and
Buccaneer — the farm is cultivated using Integrated Pest Management (IPM) practices, harvested
annually from November to January, and operated to GlobalG.A.P., Myanmar G.A.P, and HACCP-certified
standards from orchard to export. 

## The heart behind the harvest

**Dr. Aung Ko Ko** began not as a farmer, but as a physician — quietly serving patients in Myanmar
and the United Kingdom, one consultation at a time. After years of medical practice and building a
specialty coffee business that brought Myanmar's finest beans to the world, he found himself asking
a bigger question: how do you improve the health of an entire community, not just one patient? 

The answer led him to the highlands of Pyin Oo Lwin, where he founded MayMyoAvocado — not out of
ambition, but out of purpose. Today, he leads the farm with the same quiet dedication he once gave
to his patients, believing that great food, grown with integrity, is one of the most powerful
medicines there is.

# Dr. Aung Ko Ko

CEO of MayMyoAvocado

## Meet Our Finest

## Hass

**Hass** is the world's most beloved avocado variety — prized globally for its rich, creamy flesh,
high oil content, and the distinctive dark, pebbly skin that signals perfect ripeness.

### Buccaneer

**Buccaneer** is a medium-sized specialty variety with smooth, mildly sweet flesh and a subtle
yellowing skin at ripeness — a gentle, approachable avocado perfectly suited for Southeast Asian
fresh retail markets

### Amara

**Amara** is MayMyoAvocado's crown jewel — a rare highland variety born from the volcanic soils of
Myanmar, delivering an intensely rich, buttery flesh with approximately 18% oil content that only
Burma's cool Pyin Oo Lwin highlands can produce.

### 034

**Vietnamese 034** is a Southeast Asian highland specialist — a consistent, smooth-fleshed variety
carefully cultivated in Myanmar's Pyin Oo Lwin highlands to deliver reliable quality and a clean,
mild flavour perfectly suited to ASEAN palates and regional markets.

**Contact Us**

(+959) 787890902, 409409684

Musim Mas Group is one of the largest integrated palm oil companies. Present in [14 countries][185],
our main operations are in Indonesia, spanning cultivation to refining and manufacturing, and
downstream applications.

Our vertically integrated palm oil model is built for supply chain excellence. We excel at
delivering reliable, high-quality palm oil products and derivatives that enable you to be

## Integrated Business

As a fully-integrated palm oil company, we are able to deliver top quality palm products and
derivatives entire value chain, enabling us to deliver high-quality products safely, efficiently and
responsibly. This includes the production of crude palm oil and palm kernel oil, to the production
of value-added [specialty fats][229], oleochemicals, [biodiesel][230] and functional products such
as [emulsifiers][231].

[Leader Banner]

## Leader in Sustainability

As one of the most prominent players in the palm oil industry, we aspire to be a responsible leader
in the evolution of the industry, driving a new era of sustainability with innovation across the
globe. We were the first major oil palm group to be [100% certified by the Roundtable for
Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO)][232] for all our plantations with mills in 2012, and [the first palm
oil major to be verified by the Palm Oil Innovation Group (POIG)][233] in 2019.

[Banner Smallholder Program]

## Indonesia’s Largest Smallholder Program

Smallholder farmers, particularly independent ones, are significantly disadvantaged but makeup over
40% of oil palm production. Musim Mas runs Indonesia’s largest independent [smallholder
program][234] by a private company, equipping them with the know-how and resources to improve their
productivity and sustainability.

## Global Presence

Musim Mas Group is one of the largest’s integrated palm oil companies. Present in 14 countries, our
main operations are in Indonesia, spanning from cultivation to refining and manufacturing.

## Integrated Business

As a fully-integrated palm oil company, we are able to deliver top quality palm products and
derivatives entire value chain, enabling us to deliver high-quality products safely, efficiently and
responsibly. This includes the production of crude palm oil and palm kernel oil, to the production
of value-added [specialty fats][229], oleochemicals, [biodiesel][230] and functional products such
as [emulsifiers][231].

[Leader Banner]

## Leader in Sustainability

As one of the most prominent players in the palm oil industry, we aspire to be a responsible leader
in the evolution of the industry, driving a new era of sustainability with innovation across the
globe. We were the first major oil palm group to be [100% certified by the Roundtable for
Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO)][232] for all our plantations with mills in 2012, and [the first palm
oil major to be verified by the Palm Oil Innovation Group (POIG)][233] in 2019.

[Banner Smallholder Program]

## Indonesia’s Largest Smallholder Program

Smallholder farmers, particularly independent ones, are significantly disadvantaged but makeup over
40% of oil palm production. Musim Mas runs Indonesia’s largest independent [smallholder
program][234] by a private company, equipping them with the know-how and resources to improve their
productivity and sustainability.

## Global Presence

Musim Mas Group is one of the largest’s integrated palm oil companies. Present in 14 countries, our
main operations are in Indonesia, spanning from cultivation to refining and manufacturing.

## Higher quality at a lower price than expected.

Clean, healthy food is a right. But, it can be challenging to get everything you need at a single
location AND not overspend.

We promise high-quality, competitively-priced products so you can one-stop-shop with your
neighborhood grocer. Fill your basket in one place, hit your budget, and bring home the good stuff!

Dr. Sherin Lee, ND
Just a brief note to tell you how much I enjoy your Baked Cheddar Corn Curls. They are so tasty and
very original in sizing. The tiny pieces make for such a lovely crunch.

delicious your food is! I’m a fan!
Rhonda Henry
If I’m choosing between brands for something I don’t usually buy, I reach for yours first because I
know the quality will be worth any price difference (plus I think your stuff is fairly priced given
the quality!)

When you steer your cart into the neighborhood grocer, your shopping trip has the power to shape
your community. We offer CADIA® products exclusively to independently-owned grocers to ensure they
can compete with the big box down the street. Grocers are empowered with the goods they need, while
you get the high-quality products and low prices you want. From lentils to laundry detergent, the
goodness that goes into your basket can now flow right back into your hometown.

### Feel like you're ‘winning’ when you shop your grocery list.

Clean, healthy food is a right. But, it can be challenging to get everything you need at a single
location AND not overspend.

We promise high-quality, competitively-priced products so you can one-stop-shop with your
neighborhood grocer. Fill your basket in one place, hit your budget, and bring home the good stuff!

# Mulberry Growers: Exports Fruits and Herbs

We Export Fresh Fruits including Avocado (Hass, Fuerte), Mango (Kent), and Passion Fruit, Fresh
Herbs including Basil, Tarragon, Sage, Thyme, Oregon, Chives, Rosemary, Lemon Grass, Dill and Mint,
and Fresh Vegetables including French Beans, Fine Beans, Asparagus, Baby Corn, and Capsicum.

[Talk to a Consultant][31]
[Rounded Image]

## Your Trusted Parter in: **Fruits and Herbs**

Mulberry Growers LTD is headquartered in Kenya and grows fruits, edible herbs, and vegetables in
Kenya and East Africa, exporting them to Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the rest of the world.
We have farms in central Kenya, eastern Kenya, western Kenya, and East Africa where we grow fresh
produce. We process and package the fresh fruits, herbs, and vegetables for supply to the
international export market through both Sea and Air Freight.

The Products that **We Export:** Avocado, Mango, Passion Fruit and Fresh Herbs Basil, Tarragon,
Sage, Thyme, Oregon, Chives, Rosemary, Lemon Grass, Coriander, Dill and Mint, and Fresh Vegetables:
French Beans, Fine Beans, Baby Corn, Capsicum, and Asparagus.

Value additions: We offer both crude avocado oil and extra virgin avocado oil, as well as dried
fruit. For Fresh Herbs; we also offer dried herbs, preserving flavor and nutritiousness.

## Excellence: **Sustainable Fresh Produce Supplies by **Mulberry Growers

At Mulberry Growers, our mission is to sustainably grow and export fresh produce to feed the world,
enhancing the health of the final consumer and the prosperity of our customers.

We are committed to applying science-driven, ethical farming, and ethical business practices so that
our fruits, herbs, and vegetables continue flowing through sustainable processes.

We are also committed to innovation and traceability, demonstrating good practices, and remaining
accountable to our customers worldwide.

[Talk to a Consultant][32]
[Rounded Image]

## **Mulberry Growers: Our Operations**

#### Production

We are involved in large-scale cultivation of fruits, vegetables, and herbs, including avocados,
mangoes, passion fruits, basil, thyme, rosemary, tarragon, oregano, dill, mint, coriander, capsicum,
baby corn, asparagus, and more. We harvest, sort, process, package, and export the fresh produce.

#### Processing and Packaging

We use certified packhouse facilities to process and package our produce under controlled
conditions, preserving freshness and retaining nutritional value. We also offer our customers
value-added products like crude avocado oil, and extra virgin avocado oil.

#### Logistics and Supply Chain

We ship via Sea and Air freight. Our produce departs from Kenyan and East African airports and ports
on agreed terms that we have with our customers. We supply to clients in Europe, the Middle East,
Northern Africa, Asia, and other regions of the world.

#### Commitment to Quality and Sustainability

We are dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of quality and integrity. We have a very
strict traceability policy for any fruit or herbs that is grown from our farm. We identify each
section through a barcode system.

### Exporting

Mulberry Growers exports premium fruits and fresh herbs worldwide, ensuring exceptional taste and
freshness through our commitment to quality and sustainability.

### Delivery

At Mulberry Growers, we take pride in cultivating strong partnerships with trusted growers to ensure
that only the finest fruits and herbs make it to your destination

### Integrity

Mulberry Growers offers premium fruits and fresh herbs, catering to chefs and distributors with a
commitment to freshness, flavor, and integrity. Place your order now for top-tier produce!

# Mulberry Growers: Exports Fruits and Herbs

We Export Fresh Fruits including Avocado (Hass, Fuerte), Mango (Kent), and Passion Fruit, Fresh
Herbs including Basil, Tarragon, Sage, Thyme, Oregon, Chives, Rosemary, Lemon Grass, Dill and Mint,
and Fresh Vegetables including French Beans, Fine Beans, Asparagus, Baby Corn, and Capsicum.

[Talk to a Consultant][31]
[Rounded Image]

## Your Trusted Parter in: **Fruits and Herbs**

Mulberry Growers LTD is headquartered in Kenya and grows fruits, edible herbs, and vegetables in
Kenya and East Africa, exporting them to Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and the rest of the world.
We have farms in central Kenya, eastern Kenya, western Kenya, and East Africa where we grow fresh
produce. We process and package the fresh fruits, herbs, and vegetables for supply to the
international export market through both Sea and Air Freight.

The Products that **We Export:** Avocado, Mango, Passion Fruit and Fresh Herbs Basil, Tarragon,
Sage, Thyme, Oregon, Chives, Rosemary, Lemon Grass, Coriander, Dill and Mint, and Fresh Vegetables:
French Beans, Fine Beans, Baby Corn, Capsicum, and Asparagus.

Value additions: We offer both crude avocado oil and extra virgin avocado oil, as well as dried
fruit. For Fresh Herbs; we also offer dried herbs, preserving flavor and nutritiousness.

## Excellence: **Sustainable Fresh Produce Supplies by **Mulberry Growers

At Mulberry Growers, our mission is to sustainably grow and export fresh produce to feed the world,
enhancing the health of the final consumer and the prosperity of our customers.

We are committed to applying science-driven, ethical farming, and ethical business practices so that
our fruits, herbs, and vegetables continue flowing through sustainable processes.

We are also committed to innovation and traceability, demonstrating good practices, and remaining
accountable to our customers worldwide.

[Talk to a Consultant][32]
[Rounded Image]

## **Mulberry Growers: Our Operations**

#### Production

We are involved in large-scale cultivation of fruits, vegetables, and herbs, including avocados,
mangoes, passion fruits, basil, thyme, rosemary, tarragon, oregano, dill, mint, coriander, capsicum,
baby corn, asparagus, and more. We harvest, sort, process, package, and export the fresh produce.

#### Processing and Packaging

We use certified packhouse facilities to process and package our produce under controlled
conditions, preserving freshness and retaining nutritional value. We also offer our customers
value-added products like crude avocado oil, and extra virgin avocado oil.

#### Logistics and Supply Chain

We ship via Sea and Air freight. Our produce departs from Kenyan and East African airports and ports
on agreed terms that we have with our customers. We supply to clients in Europe, the Middle East,
Northern Africa, Asia, and other regions of the world.

#### Commitment to Quality and Sustainability

We are dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of quality and integrity. We have a very
strict traceability policy for any fruit or herbs that is grown from our farm. We identify each
section through a barcode system.

### Exporting

Mulberry Growers exports premium fruits and fresh herbs worldwide, ensuring exceptional taste and
freshness through our commitment to quality and sustainability.

### Delivery

At Mulberry Growers, we take pride in cultivating strong partnerships with trusted growers to ensure
that only the finest fruits and herbs make it to your destination

### Integrity

Mulberry Growers offers premium fruits and fresh herbs, catering to chefs and distributors with a
commitment to freshness, flavor, and integrity. Place your order now for top-tier produce!

# Natural Poland

Naszą misją jest dostarczanie firmom najlepszych produktów z całego świata. Głównym obszarem naszej
działalności jest** import surowców dla przemysłu: **
* **spożywczego, **
* **kosmetycznego **
* **farmaceutycznego**.

Nasi pracownicy w różnych zakątkach świata nieustannie poszukują niezawodnych dostawców oferujących
najlepsze surowce i dodatki w konkurencyjnych cenach. Lata współpracy z producentami na arenie
międzynarodowej pozwalają nam stale poszerzać wachlarz oferowanych przez nas produktów, dzięki czemu
jesteśmy w stanie zrealizować niemal każde Państwa zamówienie.

nas ograniczenia językowe i kulturowe. Często obszary dla innych niedostępne, dla nas nie stanowią
żadnego problemu. Niektóre surowce dostępne są wyłącznie u nas (np. olej z dzikiej róży o jakości
spożywczej, suszony i cięty liść mirtu cytrynowego). Jesteśmy w stanie zorganizować dla Państwa
dostawę z każdego zakątka globu.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Naturo & Orgo the best cosmetic manufacturer in India? +

Naturo & Orgo is a GMP-certified and ISO-certified cosmetic manufacturer in India with over 1,500+
base formulations, a 30-day turnaround time, and 150+ satisfied global clients. We specialize in
private label cosmetics, contract manufacturing, custom formulations, and custom packaging for
personal care and beauty brands — from startups to established D2C brands.

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for private label cosmetic manufacturing? +

Our MOQ for private label cosmetic manufacturing varies by product category — typically starting
from 500–1,000 units for ready formulations. We offer low MOQ cosmetic manufacturing to support
startups, D2C entrepreneurs, salon owners, and new beauty brands entering the market with minimal
investment.

Do you offer third-party cosmetic manufacturing services in India? +

Yes. We are a leading third party cosmetic manufacturer in India, offering end-to-end solutions
including formulation, production, quality testing, and packaging — all under your brand name. Our
OEM and ODM cosmetic manufacturing services are available for both domestic brands and global export
markets.

Can I launch my own skincare or haircare brand without a factory? +

Absolutely. Through our private label skincare manufacturing and private label haircare
manufacturing services, you can launch your own beauty brand without any manufacturing setup. We
handle everything from custom skincare formulations and hair care product development to labeling
and packaging — you focus on branding and sales.

What types of cosmetic and personal care products do you manufacture? +

We manufacture a wide range of personal care and cosmetic products including face serums,
moisturizers, sunscreens, shampoos, conditioners, hair oils, body lotions, soaps, hand washes, beard
serums, baby care products, and men's grooming products. Our herbal, organic, and natural cosmetic
formulations meet global safety and efficacy standards.

Are your products compliant with international quality and safety standards? +

Yes. Our manufacturing facility is GMP-certified and ISO-certified, ensuring all products comply
with international cosmetic regulatory standards. We also support FDA-compliant cosmetic
manufacturing for export-ready products, making us a trusted partner for brands targeting markets in
the USA, Europe, the Middle East, and beyond.

What is the difference between OEM, ODM, private label, and contract manufacturing? +

OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturing) means we produce products to your exact formula. ODM
(Original Design Manufacturing) means you choose from our ready formulations and customize the
packaging. Private label means products are manufactured and sold under your brand name. Contract
manufacturing refers to full-scale production based on your or our formulations. We offer all four
models.

How long does the product development and manufacturing process take? +

For ready-to-market private label formulations, production is completed within 30 days. For custom
cosmetic formulations developed from scratch, the timeline is typically 60–90 days, covering R&D,
stability testing, packaging design, and regulatory compliance. Repeat orders are fulfilled faster.

Do you support D2C beauty brands, startups, and entrepreneurs launching new brands? +

Yes. We are a preferred manufacturing partner for D2C beauty brands, beauty startups, salon owners

## Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Naturo & Orgo the best cosmetic manufacturer in India? +

Naturo & Orgo is a GMP-certified and ISO-certified cosmetic manufacturer in India with over 1,500+
base formulations, a 30-day turnaround time, and 150+ satisfied global clients. We specialize in
private label cosmetics, contract manufacturing, custom formulations, and custom packaging for
personal care and beauty brands — from startups to established D2C brands.

What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) for private label cosmetic manufacturing? +

Our MOQ for private label cosmetic manufacturing varies by product category — typically starting
from 500–1,000 units for ready formulations. We offer low MOQ cosmetic manufacturing to support
startups, D2C entrepreneurs, salon owners, and new beauty brands entering the market with minimal
investment.

Do you offer third-party cosmetic manufacturing services in India? +

Yes. We are a leading third party cosmetic manufacturer in India, offering end-to-end solutions
including formulation, production, quality testing, and packaging — all under your brand name. Our
OEM and ODM cosmetic manufacturing services are available for both domestic brands and global export
markets.

Can I launch my own skincare or haircare brand without a factory? +

Absolutely. Through our private label skincare manufacturing and private label haircare
manufacturing services, you can launch your own beauty brand without any manufacturing setup. We
handle everything from custom skincare formulations and hair care product development to labeling
and packaging — you focus on branding and sales.

What types of cosmetic and personal care products do you manufacture? +

We manufacture a wide range of personal care and cosmetic products including face serums,
moisturizers, sunscreens, shampoos, conditioners, hair oils, body lotions, soaps, hand washes, beard
serums, baby care products, and men's grooming products. Our herbal, organic, and natural cosmetic
formulations meet global safety and efficacy standards.

Are your products compliant with international quality and safety standards? +

Yes. Our manufacturing facility is GMP-certified and ISO-certified, ensuring all products comply
with international cosmetic regulatory standards. We also support FDA-compliant cosmetic
manufacturing for export-ready products, making us a trusted partner for brands targeting markets in
the USA, Europe, the Middle East, and beyond.

What is the difference between OEM, ODM, private label, and contract manufacturing? +

OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturing) means we produce products to your exact formula. ODM
(Original Design Manufacturing) means you choose from our ready formulations and customize the
packaging. Private label means products are manufactured and sold under your brand name. Contract
manufacturing refers to full-scale production based on your or our formulations. We offer all four
models.

How long does the product development and manufacturing process take? +

For ready-to-market private label formulations, production is completed within 30 days. For custom
cosmetic formulations developed from scratch, the timeline is typically 60–90 days, covering R&D,
stability testing, packaging design, and regulatory compliance. Repeat orders are fulfilled faster.

Do you support D2C beauty brands, startups, and entrepreneurs launching new brands? +

Yes. We are a preferred manufacturing partner for D2C beauty brands, beauty startups, salon owners

Get professionally crafted, bankable project reports tailored to your business needs. Each report
includes detailed market analysis, techno-economic feasibility, manufacturing process, machinery
planning, investment estimates, and regulatory insights which is ideal for start-ups, entrepreneurs,
and expanding industries. Our DPRs (Detailed Project Reports) are research-driven,

Make confident decisions with accurate, practical, and industry-focused documentation designed to

#### While expanding a current business or while venturing into new business, entrepreneurs are
#### often faced with the dilemma of zeroing in on a suitable product/line.

The report provides an expansive market analysis by covering areas like: growth drivers, trends
prevailing in the industry, Demand-Supply Situation, Foreign Trade, Porters 5 Forces Analysis,
regulatory framework as well as comprehensive SWOT analysis of the sector.

The report further establishes the regulatory framework of the industry. It encapsulates the status
of the current legislation in the industry as well as the recent changes and developments in the
regulations. The report also provides key player profiles along with key financials and comparison.
The market research report shares vital information like shareholding pattern, revenue mix, plant
location and financial summary of the key companies.

[Learn More ][82]
[Market Research Illustration]

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw
material availability, suitable location, payback period, costs involved and breakeven point.

[Learn More ][83]
[Entrepreneur India Illustration]

#### Select and Choose the Right Business Startup for You

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

Finding the right startup business is one of the most popular subject today. Starting a business is
no easy endeavour, but the time, effort, and challenges can be worth it if you succeed. To give
yourself the best chance to be successful, take your time to carefully find the right business for
you.

We, at Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS), endeavour to make business selection a simple and
convenient step for any entrepreneur/startup. Our expert team, by capitalizing on its dexterity and
decade's long experience in the field, has created a list of profitable ventures for entrepreneurs
who wish to diversify or venture. The list so mentioned is updated regularly to give you a regular
dose of new emerging opportunities.

[Learn More ][84]

Project Introduction, Brief History of the Product, Properties, BIS (Bureau of Indian Standard)

Formulae Detailed Process of Manufacture, Flow Sheet Diagram.

[Market Survey]

#### Market Survey

Present Market Position, Expected Future Demand, Statistics of Imports & Exports, Export Prospect,
Names and Addresses of Existing Units (Present Manufactures).

[Personnel Requirement]

#### Personnel Requirement

Requirement of Staff & Labour, Personnel Management, Skilled & Unskilled Labour.

[Plant & Machinery]

#### Plant & Machinery

List of Plant & Machineries, Miscellaneous Items and Accessories, Instruments, Laboratory
Equipment's and Accessories, Plant Location, Electrification, Electric Load and Water, Maintenance,
Suppliers / Manufacturers of Plant and Machineries.

[Land & Building]

#### Land & Building

Requirement of Land Area, Rates of the Land, Built up Area, Construction Schedule, Plant Layout.

[Raw Material]

#### Raw Material

List of Raw Materials, Properties of Raw Materials, Availability of Raw Materials, Required Quality
of Raw Materials, Cost / Rates of Raw Materials.

[Financial Aspects]

#### Financial Aspects

Cost of Raw Materials, Cost of Land & Building, Cost of Plant & Machineries, Fixed Capital
Investment, Working Capital, Project Cost, Capital Formation, Cost of Production, Profitability
Analysis, Break Even Point, Cash Flow Statement for 5 to 10 Years, Depreciation Chart, Conclusion,
Projected Balance Sheet, Land Man Ratio.

women entrepreneurs, investors, NRIs, startups, and professionals, providing crucial information on
viable projects. It's the ideal resource for identifying sound investment opportunities.

#### While expanding a current business or while venturing into new business, entrepreneurs are
#### often faced with the dilemma of zeroing in on a suitable product/line.

The report provides an expansive market analysis by covering areas like: growth drivers, trends
prevailing in the industry, Demand-Supply Situation, Foreign Trade, Porters 5 Forces Analysis,
regulatory framework as well as comprehensive SWOT analysis of the sector.

The report further establishes the regulatory framework of the industry. It encapsulates the status
of the current legislation in the industry as well as the recent changes and developments in the
regulations. The report also provides key player profiles along with key financials and comparison.
The market research report shares vital information like shareholding pattern, revenue mix, plant
location and financial summary of the key companies.

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right
investment' studies various aspects of investment like product demand, market potential, raw
material availability, suitable location, payback period, costs involved and breakeven point.

[Learn More ][83]
[Entrepreneur India Illustration]

#### Select and Choose the Right Business Startup for You

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

(Instant Online Project Identification and Selection)

Finding the right startup business is one of the most popular subject today. Starting a business is
no easy endeavour, but the time, effort, and challenges can be worth it if you succeed. To give
yourself the best chance to be successful, take your time to carefully find the right business for
you.

We, at Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS), endeavour to make business selection a simple and
convenient step for any entrepreneur/startup. Our expert team, by capitalizing on its dexterity and
decade's long experience in the field, has created a list of profitable ventures for entrepreneurs
who wish to diversify or venture. The list so mentioned is updated regularly to give you a regular
dose of new emerging opportunities.

## Knowledge is key >

# Leading International Chemical Suppliers

Norkem is a leading international chemical supplier and distributor and our Head Office is based in
Knutsford, Cheshire in the UK.  We source and stock the highest quality speciality and industrial
chemicals with offices in many parts of the world and are active across six continents.  We obtain
and supply chemicals for a broad spectrum of uses; including the agrochemical, animal feed, food and
drink, industrial, and pharmaceutical industries.  We also produce a range of suspensions and stains
which are primarily used in the brick and building industries.  Our products can be supplied in
various types and sizes of packaging, including bulk deliveries. Due to our global reach as a
chemical distributor, we are effectively able to minimise both the lead and delivery times to
expedite supply to our customers.

At Norkem, we pride ourselves upon our excellent industry knowledge, our highly experienced and
professional sales teams fully understand the products and markets in which we work.  This expertise
means that we are perfectly placed to assist with your enquiries and requirements.

We have excellent long-standing relationships with fully-accredited suppliers and you can depend on
us to reliably source the chemicals that you need at a competitive price.  For further security, we
keep a very close eye on the chemical supply pipelines and have contingency plans in place to ensure
the continuity of supply in our endeavour not to let our customers down.

As a chemical supplier, Norkem is firmly committed to meeting the highest environmental and health
and safety standards. We are also thoroughly dedicated to working towards a more sustainable future
for the chemical distribution industry.

If you would like any further information or assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. You
will find our full contact details available here on our website and a member of staff from one of
our sales teams will be only too pleased to help you. [Contact us now.][59]

# Leading International Chemical Suppliers

Norkem is a leading international chemical supplier and distributor and our Head Office is based in
Knutsford, Cheshire in the UK.  We source and stock the highest quality speciality and industrial
chemicals with offices in many parts of the world and are active across six continents.  We obtain
and supply chemicals for a broad spectrum of uses; including the agrochemical, animal feed, food and
drink, industrial, and pharmaceutical industries.  We also produce a range of suspensions and stains
which are primarily used in the brick and building industries.  Our products can be supplied in
various types and sizes of packaging, including bulk deliveries. Due to our global reach as a
chemical distributor, we are effectively able to minimise both the lead and delivery times to
expedite supply to our customers.

At Norkem, we pride ourselves upon our excellent industry knowledge, our highly experienced and
professional sales teams fully understand the products and markets in which we work.  This expertise
means that we are perfectly placed to assist with your enquiries and requirements.

We have excellent long-standing relationships with fully-accredited suppliers and you can depend on
us to reliably source the chemicals that you need at a competitive price.  For further security, we
keep a very close eye on the chemical supply pipelines and have contingency plans in place to ensure
the continuity of supply in our endeavour not to let our customers down.

As a chemical supplier, Norkem is firmly committed to meeting the highest environmental and health
and safety standards. We are also thoroughly dedicated to working towards a more sustainable future
for the chemical distribution industry.

If you would like any further information or assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. You
will find our full contact details available here on our website and a member of staff from one of
our sales teams will be only too pleased to help you. [Contact us now.][59]

# Your Home for Wholesale Natural Ingredients

In Search of the Perfect Ingredient for Your Formulation?

[Help Me Choose][58]

## Natural Oil Sourcing Made Simple

O&3 is a trusted provider of high-quality, ethically sourced natural oils for a wide range of
applications.

From skin care to culinary use, we have the perfect ingredient to meet your requirements.

[Browse All Products][59]
Cold-Pressed Oils

Natural oil extraction method preserving nutrients without heat or chemicals for a greener future.

[Find Out More ][60]
Essential Oils

Concentrated plant extracts, often used for therapeutic benefits, anti-inflammatory, antibacterial,
and antioxidant properties.

[Find Out More ][61]
Infused Oils

Carrier oils infused with plant materials, enhancing properties and fragrance for various
formulations.

[Find Out More ][62]
Butters

Moisturising and protective natural butters derived from plants, offering a range of benefits.

[Find Out More ][63]
Refined Oils

Clean and neutral oils vital for formulations, offering versatility, typically odourless, and
colourless.

[Find Out More ][64]
Soap Bases

From new indie brands to established manufacturers, soap bases are an essential ingredient for
creating innovative soap products.

[Find Out More ][65]
Extracts

Concentrated plant, herb, and fruit essences with unique properties for culinary, cosmetic, and
pharmaceutical use.

[Find Out More ][66]
Exfoliants

Sustainable scrubs made from raw plant materials, providing a natural and effective solution for
dead skin cell removal.

[Find Out More ][67]
Waters

Waters are gaining popularity in cosmetics and haircare for natural therapeutic properties in
formulations.

[Find Out More ][68]
Waxes

Versatile waxes enriched with vitamins for stability, used in lip care, hair wax, candles, face
masks.

[Find Out More ][69]
Absolutes

Concentrated plant essences, great for perfumery and cosmetics, adding depth, richness, and lasting
power.

[Find Out More ][70]

## Finding the Perfect Ingredient

Use our product finder to discover unique ingredients with specific functionality, aroma and colour
from our extensive product range – find the perfect ingredients to enhance your formulations now.

[Find Products][71]

## Empowering Industries

From beauty and personal care to pharmaceuticals, animal and pet care, harness our expertise to fuel
your success and become market leaders in your industry.

[Industries We Serve][72]

Our new free annual report for product developers & formulators highlights six key product
development trends shaping 2026, informed by formulation behaviour, consumer usage patterns and
ingredient sourcing dynamics.

Die OW400 w-inox ist eine kompakte und vielseitige Ölpresse, basierend auf der bewährten
OW500s-inox. Diese einfache Ölpresse ermöglicht die schonende Verarbeitung von über 50 verschiedenen
Saaten und ist perfekt geeignet für kleine und mittlere Betriebe, Märkte, Hofläden, Bauern und
Landwirte. Die gesamte Presseinheit der OW400 w-inox ist aus Edelstahl gefertigt, was nicht nur eine
einfache Reinigung in der Geschirrspülmaschine ermöglicht, sondern auch eine lange Lebensdauer
gewährleistet. Mit ihrem Direktantrieb und spezieller Verzahnung arbeitet die Maschine zuverlässig
und energieeffizient. Die Drehzahl ist stufenlos regelbar, um optimale Pressergebnisse mit hoher
Ölqualität und -ausbeute zu erzielen. Zudem verfügt die Maschine über eine variable
Pressspaltverstellung. Die Elektroinstallation der OW400 w-inox ist wasserdicht und kann bei Bedarf
gereinigt werden, was den Einsatz in hygienischen Umgebungen ermöglicht. Das robuste Material macht
die Maschine widerstandsfähig gegenüber mechanischen Belastungen und somit ideal für industrielle
Anwendungen. Mit der Schneckenpresse kann das gereinigte, ungeschälte Saatgut schonend kaltgepresst
werden, wodurch alle Inhaltsstoffe erhalten bleiben. Je nach Art, Reinheit und Dichte der Saat
können mit der OW400 w-inox bis zu 20 kg Pressgut pro Stunde verarbeitet werden. Dank des
freitragenden Designs ohne Bodenplatte hat die Maschine eine schmale Breite von nur 32 cm, was eine
einfache Reinigung und eine platzsparende Aufstellung ermöglicht. Insgesamt überzeugt die OW400
w-inox durch ihre Mobilität, Vielseitigkeit und Robustheit - genau das Richtige für Landwirte und
Kleinunternehmer, die Wert auf schonende Kaltpressung mit maximaler Ertragsquote legen.

Revolutionieren Sie Ihre Ölproduktion mit der OW500s-inox Ölpresse – Ein Meisterwerk der
Flexibilität, Effizienz und Qualität Entfalten Sie das volle Potenzial Ihrer Ölproduktion mit der
fortschrittlichen Ölpresse OW500s-inox. Für anspruchsvolle Verarbeitungsaufgaben konzipiert, widmet
sich dieses leistungsstarke Gerät der Verarbeitung einer beeindruckenden Vielfalt von über 100
verschiedenen Ölsaaten. Die OW500s-inox ist der ideale Partner für kleine bis mittelgroße
Unternehmen, Marktstände und Hofläden und bietet eine außergewöhnliche Kombination aus
Leistungsfähigkeit und Benutzerfreundlichkeit.   Vollständig aus hochwertigem Edelstahl gefertigt,
gewährleistet die Ölpresse nicht nur eine robuste Langlebigkeit, sondern auch eine problemlose
Reinigung – sie ist sogar spülmaschinenfest. Der innovative Direktantrieb mit spezieller Verzahnung
sichert einen energieeffizienten Betrieb und liefert hervorragende Pressergebnisse bei minimalem
Stromverbrauch.   Die OW500s-inox erhöht Ihre Kontrolle über den Pressprozess mit Funktionen wie der
variablen Pressspaltverstellung für ein hochpräzises Kaltpressverfahren, das die wertvollen
Eigenschaften des Öls bewahrt. Selbst in kühleren Arbeitsumgebungen sorgt die integrierte
Presskopfheizung und digitale Temperaturüberwachung für eine konstant hohe Ölqualität.   Die
Temperatur der OW500s-inox ist individuell einstellbar, sodass jeder Pressvorgang perfekt auf den
jeweiligen Saattyp abgestimmt werden kann. Mit der Kapazität, bis zu 25 kg Saatgut pro Stunde zu
verarbeiten (abhängig von Saatart und -reinheit), ist diese Ölpresse bereit für intensive Einsätze.
Ihr kompaktes Design sorgt für eine platzsparende Aufstellung und ihre leichte Zugänglichkeit
erleichtert die schnelle Reinigung.   Für Betriebe, die eine höhere Presskapazität benötigen, steht
ein optionales Silosystem mit einer Kapazität von rund 100 kg zur Verfügung, das einen

Silosystem bei Betriebspausen abgeriegelt werden.   Bei kontinuierlicher Verarbeitung kann die
OW500s-inox Ölpresse in einem 24-Stunden-Betrieb einen potenziellen Tagesdurchsatz von bis zu 600 kg
erreichen. Dies setzt natürlich eine konstante Saatzufuhr, durchgehende Betriebsbereitschaft der
Maschine und regelmäßige Wartung voraus, um einen reibungslosen Rund-um-die-Uhr-Betrieb zu
gewährleisten.   Für die Verarbeitung harter Saaten wie Hanf kann die OW500s-inox zusätzlich mit
einer optionalen Wasserkühlung ausgestattet werden, um die Temperatur des Öls während des
Extraktionsprozesses weiter zu senken und so die Qualität und den Nährwert des Öls zu bewahren.  
Weitere Personalisierungsoptionen, wie ein optionaler Öltemperaturfühler, bieten Ihnen genaue

Kunden auf Wochenmärkten zu beeindrucken und konsequent die beste Ölqualität sicherzustellen.

Die OW400 w-inox ist eine kompakte und vielseitige Ölpresse, basierend auf der bewährten
OW500s-inox. Diese einfache Ölpresse ermöglicht die schonende Verarbeitung von über 50 verschiedenen
Saaten und ist perfekt geeignet für kleine und mittlere Betriebe, Märkte, Hofläden, Bauern und
Landwirte. Die gesamte Presseinheit der OW400 w-inox ist aus Edelstahl gefertigt, was nicht nur eine
einfache Reinigung in der Geschirrspülmaschine ermöglicht, sondern auch eine lange Lebensdauer
gewährleistet. Mit ihrem Direktantrieb und spezieller Verzahnung arbeitet die Maschine zuverlässig
und energieeffizient. Die Drehzahl ist stufenlos regelbar, um optimale Pressergebnisse mit hoher
Ölqualität und -ausbeute zu erzielen. Zudem verfügt die Maschine über eine variable
Pressspaltverstellung. Die Elektroinstallation der OW400 w-inox ist wasserdicht und kann bei Bedarf
gereinigt werden, was den Einsatz in hygienischen Umgebungen ermöglicht. Das robuste Material macht
die Maschine widerstandsfähig gegenüber mechanischen Belastungen und somit ideal für industrielle
Anwendungen. Mit der Schneckenpresse kann das gereinigte, ungeschälte Saatgut schonend kaltgepresst
werden, wodurch alle Inhaltsstoffe erhalten bleiben. Je nach Art, Reinheit und Dichte der Saat
können mit der OW400 w-inox bis zu 20 kg Pressgut pro Stunde verarbeitet werden. Dank des
freitragenden Designs ohne Bodenplatte hat die Maschine eine schmale Breite von nur 32 cm, was eine
einfache Reinigung und eine platzsparende Aufstellung ermöglicht. Insgesamt überzeugt die OW400
w-inox durch ihre Mobilität, Vielseitigkeit und Robustheit - genau das Richtige für Landwirte und
Kleinunternehmer, die Wert auf schonende Kaltpressung mit maximaler Ertragsquote legen.

technology, and more. Each project is carefully selected to provide viable and sustainable

# OLVEA Vegetable Oils

OLVEA offers a wide range of **pure and natural vegetable oils** ([**COSMOS Approved**][85],
**[organic][86]**, **[upcycled][87] **or **[fair trade][88]**) for **cosmetics and nutrition**.

## Shorten the distance from Nature to Brands

In order to maintain the highest standards regarding the quality, traceability and consistency of
its raw materials, [OLVEA][89] has set up [**sustainable supply chains**][90] in Africa:

**• **In **[Morocco][91]**, for the production of OLVE’True™ **[Argan oil][92]** and OLVE’True™
**[Hazelnut oil][93]**,

• In [**Burkina Faso**][94], for the production of OLVE’True™ [**Shea** **butter**][95],

• In [**Kenya**][96], for the production of OLVE’True™ [**Avocado** **oil**][97], OLVE’True™
[**Macadamia oil**][98] and OLVE’True™**[Sesame oil][99]**.

### [Our vegetable oils and butters][100]

##### Sustainability for OLVEA

[OLVEA][111] is committed in promoting sustainable development, not only **environmentally**, but

# OLVEA Vegetable Oils

OLVEA offers a wide range of **pure and natural vegetable oils** ([**COSMOS Approved**][85],
**[organic][86]**, **[upcycled][87] **or **[fair trade][88]**) for **cosmetics and nutrition**.

## Shorten the distance from Nature to Brands

In order to maintain the highest standards regarding the quality, traceability and consistency of
its raw materials, [OLVEA][89] has set up [**sustainable supply chains**][90] in Africa:

**• **In **[Morocco][91]**, for the production of OLVE’True™ **[Argan oil][92]** and OLVE’True™
**[Hazelnut oil][93]**,

• In [**Burkina Faso**][94], for the production of OLVE’True™ [**Shea** **butter**][95],

• In [**Kenya**][96], for the production of OLVE’True™ [**Avocado** **oil**][97], OLVE’True™
[**Macadamia oil**][98] and OLVE’True™**[Sesame oil][99]**.

supply chains.

its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) approach, with dedicated leading employees, through a
**policy and an action plan**, accompanied by **ambitious and quantifiable goals** with the horizon
of **OLVEA’s 100th anniversary**, in 2029. 

Since 2020, OLVEA goes further by publishing annually its CSR performance report, [**OLVEAct

[OLVEA][111] is committed in promoting sustainable development, not only **environmentally**, but
also by [**adding real social and economic values**][112] to the actors of our eco-responsible
supply chains.

Sustainability has always been one of OLVEA’s core values. Since 2018, OLVEA formalizes
its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) approach, with dedicated leading employees, through a
**policy and an action plan**, accompanied by **ambitious and quantifiable goals** with the horizon
of **OLVEA’s 100th anniversary**, in 2029. 

Since 2020, OLVEA goes further by publishing annually its CSR performance report, [**OLVEAct
Now**][113], which is also shared with the **United Nations **as part of our **membership to the
[Global Compact][114]**.

[OLVEAct Now - 2025][115]

###### Our previous CSR reports:

[OLVEAct Now - 2020][116]
[OLVEAct Now - 2021][117]
[OLVEAct Now - 2022][118]
[OLVEAct Now - 2023][119]
[OLVEAct Now - 2024][120]

“We are continually investing for the quality of our oils, the satisfaction of our customers and our
commitment to sustainable development. While maintaining our family identity, we aim at developing
our people and creating a safe environment for our people and the planet.”

“We are committed to apply daily the sustainable development principles while respecting local
resources, and adding real social and economic values to local communities. The local transformation
ofour raw materials allows us to participate in the development of these countries and reduce the
carbon footprint of our productions.”

***Arnauld Daudruy**, President *

***Emmanuel Petiot**, Managing Director Vegetable Oils Business Unit
**Jean-François Vollier**, Managing Director Fish Oils Business Unit*

sits on, and the foundation that enriches the customer experience. At Nutra Food Ingredients, we
carry that responsibility proudly. We understand that as a Nutra Food customer, not only does your

20 Years
From the very first ingredient sourced in 2004 to today, we celebrate the accomplishments not only
of our business, but most importantly, we celebrate all of the exceptional products, brands, and
people that have been an integral part of our journey. Looking forward to the next 20!
Mission
Our mission is to maintain a trusted status by being a fully integrated supplier of quality
materials using a business-to-business model while always providing a 100% guarantee on
satisfaction.
Quality System

*The Highest International Standards. *As a trusted partner of the food, pharmaceutical and cosmetic
industries, we take the importance of quality and safety very seriously.
* Our production facilities are HACCP, ISO & GMP certified meeting the highest quality international
  standard.
* We ensure full traceability through every single step of the production process.
* Our raw ingredients are 100% natural, safe, and free from preservatives or extra additives.
* GFSI Certified and Third party Audited.

About us

Nutra Food Ingredients, LLC is a professional ingredient supplier since 2004.  Providing solution
provider for the Nutrition, Pharmaceutical and Food & Beverage industries. Our goal is to always
supply the highest-quality ingredients to our customers, and to satisfy the end user’s needs to a
quality healthy life.

We specialize in: Collagen, Gelatin, Collagen Protein Peptides, Bovine Bone Broth, Veggie Protein,
Polyol Sweeteners such as Xylitol, Erythritol, Maltitol and Sorbitol, Fiber Ingredients such as;
Inulin, Pea and Soy Fiber, and an array of Intensive Sweeteners. The majority of ingredients are
offered in both conventional and/or USDA/NOP certified Organic versions, as well as Gluten-Free and
NON-GMO Project Verified.

As a trusted supplier to the Pharmaceutical, Nutraceutical and Food & Beverage industries, we
customize our products to meet customer specifications. We guarantee the highest level of quality,
always consistent materials and the most competitive price for our clients.

With so many distribution points and key ties to manufacturing around the world, we ensure on-time
delivery to our customers.

Our offices and warehouses are located in Grand Rapids, Michigan; Santa Fe Springs & Carson,
California; Edison, New Jersey; Bolingbrook, IL; and Montreal, Canada.

No matter what industry you operate in, our dedicated technical service and sales professionals can
serve you.

We have experience in supporting: Nutritional Bar Manufacturers, Cosmetic Manufacturers, Food and
Beverage Processors, Pharmaceutical and Supplement Processors, and many more.

Nutra Food Ingredients is unique because we’re with you every step of the way: From identifying and
qualifying suppliers, to quality control, placing the order, shipping and delivery- but it doesn’t
end there. We’ll work with you until you’re 100% satisfied with the end result of your product.

Bryon Yang, President

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

[Do you offer samples?][30]

We do offer samples in order to have a 100% customer satisfaction. You can try out, test, decide and
then give order. We are sure you will be satisfied with the quality of our oils and other natural
products.

[What is a liquid herbal extract?][31]

A liquid herbal extract is a concentrated solution of active substances with desirable
pharmacological properties that is removed (extracted) from tissues of plants by treating it with a
solvent, in our case organic grain alcohol.

[What ailments does aromatherapy address?][32]

Whether you’re seeking peace and calming, want more energy and to be more alert, improved immunity,
sinus decongestion, improved sleep, improved mood and focus, there is an oil blend for you.

[What is the difference between Esseitial Oil and Carrier Oil?][33]

**An essential oil** is a concentrated hydrophobic liquid that occurs naturally and is volatile in
nature.

**Carrier Oils**, on the other hand, are used to dilute the concentrated essential oils so they can
be applied to the skin without any side effect.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

[Do you offer samples?][30]

We do offer samples in order to have a 100% customer satisfaction. You can try out, test, decide and
then give order. We are sure you will be satisfied with the quality of our oils and other natural
products.

[What is a liquid herbal extract?][31]

A liquid herbal extract is a concentrated solution of active substances with desirable
pharmacological properties that is removed (extracted) from tissues of plants by treating it with a
solvent, in our case organic grain alcohol.

[What ailments does aromatherapy address?][32]

Whether you’re seeking peace and calming, want more energy and to be more alert, improved immunity,
sinus decongestion, improved sleep, improved mood and focus, there is an oil blend for you.

[What is the difference between Esseitial Oil and Carrier Oil?][33]

**An essential oil** is a concentrated hydrophobic liquid that occurs naturally and is volatile in
nature.

**Carrier Oils**, on the other hand, are used to dilute the concentrated essential oils so they can
be applied to the skin without any side effect.

[Mission & Vision ][69]. Statements

###### Mission
###### Promoting the use of organic and natural products while supporting small scale farmers and
###### producers who practice sustainable organic farming in Ghana to protect biodiversity and
###### improve people’s livelihoods. 
######  
###### Vision
###### To encourage consumers to buy organically grown and produced products and to make choices
###### that will improve their health, the lives of farmers and producers, and protect our
###### environment. To serve as a reliable resource for commodity exchange between the farmer,
###### producer and the consumer by combining agribusiness with technology.

## 100% organic products made by the indigenous people of the land, using traditional methods for
