### Production

Our company takes pride in our carefully cultivated coffee beans sourced from Sidama, South
Ethiopia, and Oromia regions, known for their exceptional coffee growing conditions. We employ
traditional techniques to ensure superior quality from seed to cup. Our skilled team of coffee
experts oversees every step of the production process.
Our company utilizes state of the art technology and carefully selected avocados to extract oil of
the highest standard. Our manufacturing facility adheres to strict hygiene and safety regulations to
ensure the production of
safe and top-quality avocado oil.

### Why Choose Siz Agro Plc

#### Quality Assurance

We maintain stringent quality control measures throughout the production process. Our beans as well
as Each batch of avocado oil undergoes rigorous testing to ensure it meets our exacting standards.

#### Export Services

As a reliable exporter, we specialize in facilitating seamless international trade. We have
established strong partnerships with green coffee and avocado oil buyers worldwide, enabling us to
reach in various markets.

#### Unique Selling Proposition

Siz Agro Plc is a distinguished exporter from Ethiopia, uniquely managing the entire coffee
production process from farm to export. With a commitment to quality and sustainability, we oversee
every step, ensuring that our coffee meets the highest standards from cultivation to your warehouse.
Additionally, we are proud producers and exporters of premium avocado oil, delivering excellence to
your business.

#### Growth

Growth is part of our DNA. Our potential to grow is immeasurable. We focus on business opportunities
with a view to create volume with quality and cost efficiencies in our operations. Our business has
grown significantly in the last 7 years, and we continue to invest to build a scalable business.

### NATURAL  COLD-PRESSED OILS FROM AFRICA


###### All our oils are cold-pressed, and many of our raw materials are wild harvested where
###### communities in rural villages benefit.

[EMAIL US][8]

## Welcome to So African Natural Oils

Since 2007, So African Natural Oils (SANO) has been at the forefront of the vegetable and seed oil
industry, proudly supplying the global food and cosmetics markets with the highest quality
cold-pressed natural oils.

Today, we export to over 12 countries worldwide and stand as South Africa’s largest exporter of
grape seed oil, while also offering premium avocado oil and macadamia oil in 24 ton bulk flexitanks.
Alongside these, our portfolio extends to a wide range of exotic cosmetic seed oils, tailored to
meet the needs of international partners.


## Who We Are

SANO is more than a supplier – we are a network of growers, harvesters, and processors, representing
the country’s largest cooperative of local seed oil farmers.

We are committed to sustainability, responsibility, and community empowerment. Our partnerships with
municipalities, NGOs, and rural cooperatives create opportunities for impoverished communities by
purchasing wild-harvested seeds and fruits – transforming local resources into global value.


## Our Commitment

At SANO, we believe that natural oils should benefit people and planet alike. We take pride in
delivering bulk oils of uncompromising quality to the international Food and Cosmetics Industries,
while operating in a way that respects the environment, supports our employees, and uplifts our
suppliers.

 

[[Screenshot 2025-08-21 at 05.35.51.png]][9]

## Sustainability through Innovation

Sustainability is at the heart of everything we do. From empowering rural communities through
wild-harvested seeds to ensuring responsible processing across our facilities, we are dedicated to
operating in harmony with people and planet.


As part of this vision, we developed LOGGI Eco Fire Logs – an innovative by-product of our oil
pressing process. Made entirely from natural grape seed press-cake that would otherwise go to waste,
Loggi offers a cleaner, greener alternative to traditional firewood.

By transforming production residues into a valuable energy source, we close the loop in our
operations and proudly contribute to the circular economy – reducing waste, conserving forests, and
creating sustainable value at every step.

# Samen Sterker

Onze ambitie is om als Sligro Food Group de onbetwiste marktleider in foodservice en de referentie
op Good Food in de Benelux te zijn. Door onze intense focus op de klant te combineren met een
excellente uitvoering, willen wij iedere professional in food écht verder brengen. Vanuit onze
kernwaarden, de kracht van onze mensen, infrastructuur en samenwerking met onze partners voegen wij
langetermijnwaarde toe voor alle stakeholders.

[Klik hier voor gedetailleerde informatie over het programma en transactie-updates][51]

# Samen Sterker

Onze ambitie is om als Sligro Food Group de onbetwiste marktleider in foodservice en de referentie
op Good Food in de Benelux te zijn. Door onze intense focus op de klant te combineren met een
excellente uitvoering, willen wij iedere professional in food écht verder brengen. Vanuit onze
kernwaarden, de kracht van onze mensen, infrastructuur en samenwerking met onze partners voegen wij
langetermijnwaarde toe voor alle stakeholders.

Buyer FAQs

## Frequently Asked *Questions*

What products does SV Botanica export?

We are a B2B exporter of standardised herbal extracts, natural and essential oils, spices and
oleoresins, and nutraceutical ingredients sourced from India. Our catalogue spans 150+ botanical
ingredients supplied in bulk to manufacturers and brands worldwide.

Do you ship to the US and EU?

Yes. We regularly supply buyers in the United States, the European Union and global markets, with
export documentation, phytosanitary certificates and customs paperwork handled for each destination.

Can you meet EU import requirements for Indian botanicals?

Yes. For EU-bound consignments we arrange pesticide residue (MRL) panels, heavy-metal and
microbiological testing, and ethylene oxide (ETO) screening through accredited third-party
laboratories, and prepare the documentation EU importers need for consignments subject to increased
official controls.

What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

MOQs vary by product, typically starting at 25 kg for extracts and oleoresins and scaling to
full-container loads. Contact us with your target specification and volume for an exact quote.

Which certifications do you hold?

Our supply chain is backed by GMP, ISO, USDA Organic, Halal, Kosher, FSSAI and APEDA registrations.
Product-specific Certificates of Analysis (CoA) and regulatory documentation are provided with every
shipment.

Can I request samples before placing a bulk order?

Yes. We provide pre-shipment samples with full CoA so your QC and R&D teams can validate identity,
assay and purity before committing to a production-scale order.

What are typical lead times for bulk orders?

Lead times depend on product and volume — stocked extracts typically dispatch within 2–3 weeks of
order confirmation, while custom standardisations or large volumes may take longer. Exact lead time
is confirmed in every quote.

Do you offer private labelling and custom packaging?

Yes. We support private labelling, custom pack sizes and packaging formats for bulk buyers, along
with the freight and export documentation to match.

Buyer FAQs

## Frequently Asked *Questions*

What products does SV Botanica export?

We are a B2B exporter of standardised herbal extracts, natural and essential oils, spices and
oleoresins, and nutraceutical ingredients sourced from India. Our catalogue spans 150+ botanical
ingredients supplied in bulk to manufacturers and brands worldwide.

Do you ship to the US and EU?

Yes. We regularly supply buyers in the United States, the European Union and global markets, with
export documentation, phytosanitary certificates and customs paperwork handled for each destination.

Can you meet EU import requirements for Indian botanicals?

Yes. For EU-bound consignments we arrange pesticide residue (MRL) panels, heavy-metal and
microbiological testing, and ethylene oxide (ETO) screening through accredited third-party
laboratories, and prepare the documentation EU importers need for consignments subject to increased
official controls.

What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

MOQs vary by product, typically starting at 25 kg for extracts and oleoresins and scaling to
full-container loads. Contact us with your target specification and volume for an exact quote.

Which certifications do you hold?

Our supply chain is backed by GMP, ISO, USDA Organic, Halal, Kosher, FSSAI and APEDA registrations.
Product-specific Certificates of Analysis (CoA) and regulatory documentation are provided with every
shipment.

Can I request samples before placing a bulk order?

Yes. We provide pre-shipment samples with full CoA so your QC and R&D teams can validate identity,
assay and purity before committing to a production-scale order.

What are typical lead times for bulk orders?

Lead times depend on product and volume — stocked extracts typically dispatch within 2–3 weeks of
order confirmation, while custom standardisations or large volumes may take longer. Exact lead time
is confirmed in every quote.

Do you offer private labelling and custom packaging?

Yes. We support private labelling, custom pack sizes and packaging formats for bulk buyers, along
with the freight and export documentation to match.

###### Rooted in Canada

### Are you a Foodie? Order Now!

From coast to coast, Sysco has thousands of foodservice products in stock. From top quality protein
to fresh produce and all of your grocery needs, start ordering today for delivery or pick up as
early as tomorrow and become a Sysco Foodie!

Are you already a customer?

Are you looking to buy foodservice products for your business?
* [Order Now][62]

### Sustaining Our Future

Sysco has a passion for helping others. We proudly partner with more local ranchers, growers, and
producers than any distributor in the industry. We support farm to table initiatives to deliver the
best products from anywhere, to everywhere. Sysco has partnerships with food banks and other hunger
relief organizations to invest in the needs of diverse communities around the world. Fighting hunger
is a vital part of Sysco’s heart
* [Learn More][63]
* [View Sustainability Reports][64]

## Our Locations

Sysco operates approximately 343 distribution facilities serving more than 650,000 customer
locations around the world.

[Get In Touch][65]
Sysco is the global leader in selling, marketing and distributing food and related products to
customers who prepare meals away from home. This includes restaurants, healthcare and educational
facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues, and more. Sysco operates 340 distribution

### Did you know?

## The oil that does
## more than cook.

Currently, our avocado oil is made in Spain with Spanish-grown avocados.

Avocado oil is pressed from the fruit flesh - not seeds.

Avocados don’t ripen on the tree. They mature first - then ripen after harvest.

Light is one of the biggest enemies of fresh oil - that’s why we chose tin.

"If we say '100% Pure' then our oil is never blended with other oils."

Avocado trees can live over 100 years. The oldest recorded tree at UC Berkeley was planted in 1879.

Heat stability depends on fat structure - not just smoke point.

Avocado oil naturally stays liquid in the refrigerator.

We provide a variety of products such as dates, nuts, fresh fruits and vegetables, foodstuffs and
oils, minerals and petrochemicals.

## Guaranteed Quality

At Taj Mahal, we care about providing the best products in the market. We assure you that every
product we offer is selected with the utmost care and guided to meet the highest quality standards.

## Global Network

Thanks to our global network and strong partnerships, we can meet the needs of our customers around
the world. We provide a complete solution to seamlessly import and export goods.

Taj Mahal is a leading general trading company in Kazakhstan, specialized in providing a wide range
of wholesale products to all countries of the world, including dates, nuts, dried fruits, fresh
fruits and vegetables, foodstuffs, oils, minerals and petrochemicals.

We are committed to providing high quality products and competitive prices to our customers. We have
a team of experienced professionals who will help you find the products you need.

## About Us

**Meet the Owners**



Roy and Chelsie Carter, lifelong Southwest Oklahoma natives, recently became the owners of The
Verdant Mercantile & Refillery, continuing the store’s mission of serving and enriching the Altus
community. Their commitment to sustainability, wellness, and local craftsmanship guides every aspect
of the shop’s evolving vision.



Chelsie, a registered nurse with a deep passion for natural wellness, brings both professional
insight and creative expression to the shop. Her dedication to clean, thoughtful living shapes the
store’s product selection, while her handcrafted pottery—made with care and intention—adds an
artistic dimension that reflects the heart of the region.



Roy, a United States Marine Corps combat veteran, continues his service to the community through his
work as a real estate agent with Cole Properties and as an aircraft mechanic for the KC‑46 at Altus
Air Force Base. His commitment to hard work, integrity, and supporting local makers is woven into
the mission of the store.



Together, Roy and Chelsie —and Lillie, the beloved shop beagle—are building a business centered on
connection, sustainability, and hometown pride. The Verdant Mercantile & Refillery exists to offer
natural products, refillable essentials, and locally sourced goods that empower residents to invest
in their health, their homes, and their community.

Featured Story

## The Avocado Company
## *of Uganda*

Established in 2019 in Western Uganda, we were founded with a bold ambition: to build a complete,
sustainable avocado value chain — from a 100-acre nucleus farm in Hapuyo to the tables and bathroom
cabinets of the world.

Our nucleus farm serves as both a production centre and a living reference model, demonstrating best
practices that 1,000 partner outgrower farmers can learn from and replicate across Kyegegwa
District.

[ Read the Full Story  → ][8]
What We Stand For

## Three Pillars of *Everything We Do*

01
🌱
Organic Farming

Organic practices from seed to shelf, minimising our environmental footprint across the entire value
chain — from cultivation to cold-press production.

02
🫙
Cold Pressed Avoil™

Extra virgin, unrefined, cold pressed. Every bottle preserves the natural goodness, vivid colour,
and full nutritional profile of Uganda's finest Hass avocados.

03
🤝
Fair Trade

We bypass middlemen entirely to guarantee fair, transparent prices directly to our 1,000 partner
outgrower farmers — building genuine rural prosperity.

What We Produce

## From the Branch *to the Bottle*

[Premium Hass avocados hanging on the branch, ready for harvest]
For Export · Fresh Fruit
Fresh Hass Avocados

Export-grade Hass avocados grown organically on our nucleus farm and by our outgrower network —
harvested at peak ripeness for international markets.

[Avoil™ extra virgin avocado oil bottles lined up, cold pressed and unrefined, made in Uganda]
Domestic Market · Avoil™
Avoil™ Avocado Oil

Cold pressed, unrefined, 100% pure. 280 ml per bottle — for culinary and cosmetic use, with export
scale planned.

[Avocados growing on the tree at the Kyegegwa nucleus farm]
Cosmetics · Byproduct
Cosmetic Avocado Oil

Byproduct oil rich in antioxidants, sterolin, and vitamin E — processed into cosmetic-grade oil for
skin and beauty applications.

[Rows of Avoil™ bottles — 100% pure, natural, age-defying cold pressed avocado oil from Uganda]
Our Flagship Product

## Introducing *Avoil™*

Avoil™ is our extra virgin avocado oil — cold pressed and unrefined to lock in all the nutrients,
flavour, and natural colour of Uganda's finest Hass avocados.

Currently available in Uganda for culinary and cosmetic use, with plans to scale to international
export markets.

Cold Pressed Unrefined 100% Organic Age Defying 280 ml
[Order Avoil™ →][9]
How It Works

## From Seedling to *Zero Waste*

01
🌱
Nucleus Farm & Nursery

100 acres in Kyegegwa producing free seedlings for 1,000 outgrowers and training extension workers.

02
🤝
Outgrower Network

1,000 partner farmers each cultivating at least one acre, supported with best practices and field
extension.

03
💰
Fair Trade Purchasing

Buying directly from farmers, bypassing middlemen to guarantee a decent, reliable income.

04
📦
Export & Processing

Premium fruit exported fresh; remainder cold pressed into Avoil™ extra virgin oil.

05
♻️
Zero-Waste Biogas

Oil waste powers the factory via biogas and creates organic fertiliser returned to outgrowers.

Our Commitment

## Farming in *Harmony with Nature*

From the first seedling to the final drop of oil, sustainability is woven into everything we do — a
circular model where every input is used and nothing is wasted.

We're building a community of 1,000 partner farmers — offering free seedlings, training, and
guaranteed fair-trade purchasing for every harvest.

🌱
**Free Seedlings**Quality Hass avocado seedlings from our nursery supplied to all outgrowers at no
cost.
📚
**Training & Extension**In-house extension workers visit outgrowers directly to support best
practices and maximise yields.
💰
**Fair Trade Purchasing**We buy directly, bypassing middlemen to guarantee a fair and reliable
income for every farmer.
🌾

supporting organic farming.

### **Transgourmet – der Profi im Lebensmittelgroßhandel**

Im Rahmen der Dachmarke "Transgourmet Deutschland" sind die beiden **Großhandel Spezialisten**
"Transgourmet" für den Belieferungsgroßhandel und "Selgros" für den Abholgroßhandel vertreten. Neben
diesen gibt es weitere spezialisierte Unternehmen mit einem breiten Leistungsangebot. In Deutschland
ist Transgourmet führend im Belieferungsgroßhandel für Kunden aus **Gastronomie, Hotellerie,
Betriebsverpflegung, sozialen Einrichtungen, Einzelhandel **und anderen Gewerben. Der Firmensitz
befindet sich in Riedstadt, Hessen.

**Vielseitige und nachhaltige Sortimente**

Als Profipartner sichert Transgourmet Ihnen eine vollständige Warenversorgung und bietet umfassende
Unterstützung in allen Kernprozessen. Die Priorität liegt dabei auf** Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit**.
In Zusammenarbeit mit sorgfältig ausgewählten Lieferanten sorgt Transgourmet für frische,
hochwertige Produkte aus regionaler Herkunft und internationalen Märkten. Von frischem Obst und
Gemüse über hochwertiges Fleisch, erlesene Weine bis hin zu innovativen Food-Konzepten – hier finden
Sie alles, was Sie für Ihre Küche und Ihren Betrieb benötigen.

**Fachkompetenz für Ihren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg**

Mit persönlicher und kompetenter Fachberatung, ganzheitlichen Konzepten und innovativen Lösungen
unterstützt Transgourmet Sie nachhaltig dabei, effizienter und besser zu werden. Dazu gehören sowohl
eine individuelle Beratung und ein effizientes Bestell- und Liefersystem als auch Schulungen und
Workshops, um Ihnen wichtige Themen der Branche zu vermitteln, neue Inspirationen zu setzen und Ihre
kulinarischen Visionen in die Realität umzusetzen.

## Transgourmet Natura

Transgourmet Natura steht für zertifizierte Bio-Lebensmittel aus kontrolliertem Anbau. Nachhaltig,
natürlich und genussvoll – für Küchen mit Anspruch an Umwelt & Qualität.

## Transgourmet Ursprung

Ursprung steht für Transparenz, Regionalität und Tierwohl. Entdecken Sie nachhaltige Produkte mit
nachvollziehbarer Herkunft – für Profis, die Wert auf Qualität, Geschmack und Verantwortung legen.

[ Mehr erfahren ][115]

## Transgourmet Premium

Erleben Sie Genuss auf Spitzenniveau mit Transgourmet Premium. Feinste Zutaten, höchste Qualität und
handverlesene Spezialitäten für die gehobene Gastronomie.

[ Mehr erfahren ][116]

## Transgourmet Quality

Transgourmet Quality vereint zuverlässige Qualität mit breiter Produktauswahl – von Basics bis
Spezialitäten.

Transgourmet Economy bietet zuverlässige Basisprodukte mit attraktivem Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis.
Ideal für den effizienten Einsatz in Großküchen und Gemeinschaftsverpflegung.

"Transgourmet" für den Belieferungsgroßhandel und "Selgros" für den Abholgroßhandel vertreten. Neben
diesen gibt es weitere spezialisierte Unternehmen mit einem breiten Leistungsangebot. In Deutschland
ist Transgourmet führend im Belieferungsgroßhandel für Kunden aus **Gastronomie, Hotellerie,
Betriebsverpflegung, sozialen Einrichtungen, Einzelhandel **und anderen Gewerben. Der Firmensitz
befindet sich in Riedstadt, Hessen.

**Vielseitige und nachhaltige Sortimente**

Als Profipartner sichert Transgourmet Ihnen eine vollständige Warenversorgung und bietet umfassende
Unterstützung in allen Kernprozessen. Die Priorität liegt dabei auf** Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit**.
In Zusammenarbeit mit sorgfältig ausgewählten Lieferanten sorgt Transgourmet für frische,
hochwertige Produkte aus regionaler Herkunft und internationalen Märkten. Von frischem Obst und
Gemüse über hochwertiges Fleisch, erlesene Weine bis hin zu innovativen Food-Konzepten – hier finden
Sie alles, was Sie für Ihre Küche und Ihren Betrieb benötigen.

**Fachkompetenz für Ihren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg**

Mit persönlicher und kompetenter Fachberatung, ganzheitlichen Konzepten und innovativen Lösungen
unterstützt Transgourmet Sie nachhaltig dabei, effizienter und besser zu werden. Dazu gehören sowohl
eine individuelle Beratung und ein effizientes Bestell- und Liefersystem als auch Schulungen und
Workshops, um Ihnen wichtige Themen der Branche zu vermitteln, neue Inspirationen zu setzen und Ihre
kulinarischen Visionen in die Realität umzusetzen.

Cookies are text files which are stored in a dedicated area of your device’s hard drive (such as
your smart phone, computer, laptop or tablet) when you visit or browse a website, download an app or
otherwise when you make use of the web.

Cookies are an essential part of web-users experience as they track your browsing patterns, record
your preferences, better your online experience and help us boost our platforms.

experience on our website

greater flexibility and more responsive service through a range of delivery options.

Flexible delivery customized to meet your specific needs.

resources–
allowing you to maximize coverage and enable flexibility as you grow.

# UPC Lookup Database

With over **711 million** unique UPC/EAN numbers, **UPCitemdb.com** is the largest UPC lookup
database where you can search a broad range of UPC numbers to find related product information,
images, barcodes, online shopping guide and more.

and more by product names.

Reverse ISBN Lookup by Book Title

UPCitemdb.com carries over 27 million unique ISBN numbers. Enter book title to find related ISBNs
along with barcodes, product images and shopping info.

UPC Validator

Enter your code without the last digit. It not only calculates the check digit, but also finds the
product if the check digit matches the last digit in the code. It also validates ISBN, GTIN, EAN.

y como cooperativa reafirmamos nuestro compromiso con el planeta y con las futuras generaciones.
Para nosotros, cuidar el medio ambiente es cuidar de nosotros mismos. Dentro de nuestro compromiso
con el @pactomundial de nacionesunidas, cumplimos con sus 10 principios fundamentales, incluyendo
por supuesto los 3 principios medioambientales que guían nuestras acciones diarias: ♻️ Principio 7:
Mantenemos un enfoque preventivo que favorece el medioambiente. 🌱 Principio 8: Fomentamos
iniciativas que promueven una mayor responsabilidad ambiental. 🔬 Principio 9: Favorecemos el
desarrollo y la difusión de las tecnologías respetuosas con el medioambiente. 🌿 Cada decisión que
tomamos está alineada con estos principios, desde nuestras prácticas agrícolas sostenibles hasta la
comercialización responsable de nuestros aguacates y mangos. Porque creemos que la sostenibilidad no
es una opción, es el camino. 💚 Hoy más que nunca, sigamos cultivando un futuro verde.

temporadas más como patrocinador principal del @cbmciudaddemalaga. Así, tanto el primer equipo como
los de categorías base del club, seguirán compitiendo bajo la denominación de ‘TROPS Málaga’. Sin
duda, ¡un auténtico orgullo para nuestra cooperativa! El director general de TROPS, Víctor Luque, y
el Presidente del Club, Alberto Camas, sellaron hace unos días la renovación de este acuerdo en las
propias instalaciones de TROPS en Vélez-Málaga. La renovación de nuestro patrocinio con el club
malagueño es una excelente noticia para nuestra cooperativa, una reafirmación de nuestro compromiso
con los valores que compartimos: el trabajo en equipo, el esfuerzo, la constancia y la búsqueda de
la excelencia. Tal y como afirma nuestro director general: “En TROPS creemos firmemente que el
deporte es una herramienta fundamental para la formación de valores y para impulsar un estilo de
vida saludable, contribuyendo al desarrollo de una sociedad más sana y fuerte”. Noticia completa en

**Engineered** for Strength. Crafted for Expression.

[ Join us now ][113]

At Virgo ACP, a leading ACP sheets manufacturer in India, innovation meets artistry. Our aluminium
composite panels are crafted to elevate facades, interiors, and signage with the perfect balance of
performance and design. With more than 300+ distinct shades, state-of-the-art manufacturing, and
internationally certified fireretardant cores, every panel reflects precision, resilience, and
refined aesthetics. From skylinedefining architecture to bespoke interiors, Virgo ACP empowers
creators to build spaces that endure and inspire.

[ View More ][114]

Managing Directors

Surinder Arora

Managing Director** (VIRGO GROUP)**

the living skin of iconic structures worldwide. Powered by advanced PVDF coatings and Anti-Fading
Technology (AFT), our panels combine exceptional strength, fire safety, and weather resistance with
vibrant, long-lasting finishes that inspire confidence among architects and builders globally.

* Backed by 33+ years of Virgo Group legacy with proven performance across the building materials

Common questions

## What wholesale buyers ask us

What is the minimum order quantity for wholesale?+

Our minimum order quantity depends on the product category and destination. For oils, the minimum is
typically one pallet (mixed or single SKU). For preserves, sauces, and cellar products, minimums
start at one case per reference. Please contact us directly for a tailored quote — we work with
importers, distributors, hotels, and retail buyers across Europe and the UK.

Are your products EU Organic certified?+

Yes. The majority of our range carries the EU Organic (Euro-leaf) certification, audited and issued
by CAEM (Comite de Agricultura Ecologica de la Comunidad de Madrid). This covers the entire supply
chain from field to bottle. Our refined avocado oil is the exception — while made from the same
groves, the refining process means it carries Non-GMO and Vegan certifications rather than EU
Organic.

Do you ship internationally?+

We ship throughout the European Union and the United Kingdom from our warehouse in Madrid. For
destinations outside the EU, we work with specialist food logistics partners to ensure
temperature-controlled transit. Shipping costs and lead times vary by destination and volume —
contact us for a detailed quote including customs documentation support.

Can I request samples before placing an order?+

Absolutely. We encourage buyers to taste before they commit. We offer a complimentary sample box for
qualified trade enquiries — typically including one oil, one preserve, and one sauce or cellar
product. Samples ship from Madrid within 48 hours. Use our contact form or email info@wearebio.es
with your business details and the products you are interested in.

What does cold extraction mean for your oils?+

Cold extraction means the oil is pressed at temperatures below 27°C (the EU legal threshold). Our
olive oil is pressed at 24°C, and our avocado oils below 40°C. Lower temperatures preserve the
volatile aromatics, polyphenols, and antioxidants that heat would destroy. The result is an oil with
more character, more nutrition, and a shorter shelf life — a trade we make gladly.

What sweetener do you use in your preserves?+

Our preserves are made with organic fruit, organic agave syrup, lemon juice and apple pectin. We use
no refined sugar, no glucose syrup, no fructose concentrates and no artificial sweeteners. Agave
syrup provides a lower glycaemic index than cane sugar while allowing the fruit flavour to lead. The
result is a preserve with less sweetness than conventional jam but far more fruit character. They
pair beautifully with cheese, toast, and charcuterie.

within two working days.

more character, more nutrition, and a shorter shelf life — a trade we make gladly.

What sweetener do you use in your preserves?+

Our preserves are made with organic fruit, organic agave syrup, lemon juice and apple pectin. We use
no refined sugar, no glucose syrup, no fructose concentrates and no artificial sweeteners. Agave
syrup provides a lower glycaemic index than cane sugar while allowing the fruit flavour to lead. The
result is a preserve with less sweetness than conventional jam but far more fruit character. They
pair beautifully with cheese, toast, and charcuterie.

Get in touch

## Start a conversation

Whether you are sourcing organic Spanish food for a retail chain, building a distribution portfolio
or stocking a hotel kitchen, we would like to hear from you. Request our wholesale catalogue, ask
for a tailored quote, or tell us what you are looking for — we respond to every enquiry personally
within two working days.

With a rich heritage spanning generations, Pravat Timbers specializes in sawing and veneer
manufacturing. Here, I learned the intricacies of the craft, from operating machinery to maximizing
log yields.

This experience instilled in me a deep appreciation for precision and quality, values that we carry
forward at WGC Exports.

## Ingredients That Support Your Healthy Lifestyle From the Inside Out

As your trusted organic store, we go above and beyond to ensure you feel good about your food
choices. That’s why we supply a wide range of products that help nourish healthy bodies and
wholesome lives. We believe that food is most nutritious when it is closest to its natural form, and
we work hard to make sure our products are, whenever possible:
* USDA Certified Organic
* FairTrade Certified & Sustainably-Sourced
* Crafted From Whole, Non-GMO Ingredients
* Certified Kosher
* Raw, Vegan, and Gluten-Free Diet-Friendly
* Minimally-Processed to Ensure Nutritionally-Rich Products You’ll Love

But our products are only half of why we’re the [**best online health food store**][142]! We want
you to feel good about your Wildly Organic purchase, so we offer a [**Satisfaction
Guarantee**][143] that allows you to return anything you don’t love within 30 days.

## RAW ORGANIC NUTS & SEEDS

][144]

Nuts and seeds are a staple in many healthy lifestyles. Great for vegan, keto, and many other
specialty diets, nuts are naturally filling and packed with essential nutrients and micronutrients.
Many of the nuts featured in our organic store are “activated,” meaning they’ve been soaked to begin
the germination process and then dehydrated at low temperatures to lend them a distinct crunch.
Raw-diet friendly and full of all-natural goodness, our activation process eliminates the nut’s
naturally occurring phytates that inhibit your body’s ability to fully absorb the nut’s nutrients
for a product that makes for an even better addition to your family’s pantry.

# More Than Just Products. Partners in Growth.

Vistar, a division of Performance Food Group, is a leading candy, snack, and beverage distributor
focused on being the preferred choice for customers, suppliers, and employees. We make it simple and
convenient to keep your business stocked and your communities happy.

[Become a Customer]

## Become a
## Customer

[Products & Resources]

## Products
## & Resources

[Serving Communities]

## Serving
## Communities

[Join Our Team]

## Join Our Team

### The Partner You Deserve

No two customers have the same specific needs which is why we’re well-equipped to serve diverse
industries through 13 unique channels and provide tailored solutions to suit your short and
long-term business efforts.

[Learn More][63]

### Expansive Product Lines and Unmatched Resources

Across our 24 nationwide distribution centers, we provide an extensive range of well-known candy,
snack, and beverage brands, along with unique and innovative products. To enhance the user
experience, we also offer data-driven insights, specialized programs, and a streamlined, automated
ordering process.

[Learn More][64]

### Making a Difference

We are committed to supporting and empowering the communities we serve through active partnerships
with organizations like St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, Truckers Against Trafficking, and
local community initiatives. By living up to this commitment, we make a significant contribution to
the betterment of real communities everywhere.

[Learn More][65]

### Every Person Matters

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion allows us to foster an environment where all
employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. By investing in our workforce and providing
essential resources, we cultivate a strong and engaged team that guarantees customer satisfaction
and propels growth.

[Learn More][66]
[Sustainability]
[Sustainability]

# Responsible Growth

As a part of PFG, we've made significant progress in tackling issues that impact both our planet and
society. Our 2024 Sustainability Report explores the ways in which we're making a meaningful impact
on the world. We are pioneering new sustainable products and processes and empowering our team
members to reach their full potential all while setting the stage for our initiatives in 2025 and
shaping the future of the industry.

[View Our Recent Report][67]
[Celebrating 50 Years of Excellence]
[Celebrating 50 Years of Excellence]

# Women of PFG

Ensuring our workforce mirrors the diversity of the communities we serve is vital. The introduction
of Women of PFG signifies a positive stride toward fostering an inclusive workplace where women feel
valued and empowered. As we chart the path for future growth, this Associate Resource Group will
play a pivotal role in cultivating a high-performing, innovative, and inclusive culture, making PFG
a better and more productive place for all associates.

[Fuel Cell Truck]
[Fuel Cell Truck]

# Driving Sustainability

Reducing emissions and advancing low-carbon technologies are key to our ESG strategy. In 2024, we
introduced zero-emission vehicles at our Vistar - Southern California facility. These vehicles will
deliver products across Southern California, supporting our sustainability goals alongside our
fleet.

society. Our 2024 Sustainability Report explores the ways in which we're making a meaningful impact

shaping the future of the industry.

Ensuring our workforce mirrors the diversity of the communities we serve is vital. The introduction
of Women of PFG signifies a positive stride toward fostering an inclusive workplace where women feel
valued and empowered. As we chart the path for future growth, this Associate Resource Group will
play a pivotal role in cultivating a high-performing, innovative, and inclusive culture, making PFG
a better and more productive place for all associates.

focused on being the preferred choice for customers, suppliers, and employees. We make it simple and

## Join Our Team

### The Partner You Deserve

No two customers have the same specific needs which is why we’re well-equipped to serve diverse
industries through 13 unique channels and provide tailored solutions to suit your short and
long-term business efforts.

[Learn More][63]

### Expansive Product Lines and Unmatched Resources

Across our 24 nationwide distribution centers, we provide an extensive range of well-known candy,
snack, and beverage brands, along with unique and innovative products. To enhance the user
experience, we also offer data-driven insights, specialized programs, and a streamlined, automated
ordering process.

[Learn More][64]

### Making a Difference

We are committed to supporting and empowering the communities we serve through active partnerships
with organizations like St. Jude Children's Research Hospital, Truckers Against Trafficking, and
local community initiatives. By living up to this commitment, we make a significant contribution to
the betterment of real communities everywhere.

[Learn More][65]

### Every Person Matters

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion allows us to foster an environment where all
employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. By investing in our workforce and providing
essential resources, we cultivate a strong and engaged team that guarantees customer satisfaction
and propels growth.
